jobs.title: Backend Engineer, GenAI Platform
jobs.description:
Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on!

What will you do?

As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by:

  • Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform.

  • Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting.

  • Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows.

  • Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development.

Who are we?

We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting.

What makes you the ideal candidate?

For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring:

  • Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself.

  • Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies.

  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view.

  • Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes.

  • Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build.

Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage.

How do you work?

You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind.

Our stack

  • Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs.

  • Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD.

  • Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry.

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions.

At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. And that fits very well with us as an organisation. We are curious about who you are and what qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment, click here!

What do we offer?

At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving. You will collaborate with colleagues who think in possibilities and you will have every opportunity to continue developing yourself through your work and the DPG Academy.

  • 💰 A competitive salary based on your work experience.

  • 📝 A 36-hour work week in the Netherlands or a 38-hour work week in Belgium.

  • 💰 8% holiday allowance and 4% personal choice budget.

  • 💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media's performance.

  • 🎓 Opportunities to develop yourself both on the job and through the DPG Academy / DPG Campus.

  • 🎉 The possibility to personalise your cultural public holidays.

  • 🏢 Hybrid working, with office days agreed together with your team.

Even more reasons to join DPG Media

At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 leading news brands, magazines, television programmes, radio stations and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM and many more. Every month we reach more than 90% of people in the Netherlands and 8 out of 10 people in Flanders. We offer a professional working environment where freedom and personal development are highly valued. Through workshops and training, you are given every opportunity to invest in your future. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player and, above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media.

Discover everything we have to offer. And while you're at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Applying, what's next?

Are you ready to get started? Apply directly. You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days and hear whether you have been selected for the first interview. The recruitment process consists of:

  • HR screening.

  • Interview with the Head of GenAI Platform.

  • Technical interview with engineers from the team.

Amsterdam - Voor het B2B Marketing team van DPG Media zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste stagiair(e) vanaf beginfebruari 2027, voor een periode van minimaal 5 maanden. Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende stage waarin je écht impact kunt maken?

Wie ben jij?
Ben jij op de hoogte van de laatste marketing ontwikkelingen? En ben jij eager om meer te weten te komen over de media-en marketingwereld? Heb je een passie voor marketing, events en communicatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! We zoeken een enthousiaste en proactieve stagiair die kansen ziet én pakt, graag samenwerkt maar ook zelfstandig projecten kan oppakken.

Wat ga je doen?
Binnen ons B2B marketingteam krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan uiteenlopende marketingcampagnes en B2B evenementen. Je ondersteunt je bij het bedenken, organiseren en uitvoeren van evenementen en marketingactiviteiten. Dit doe je onder andere door:
● Te ondersteunen bij het coördineren en organiseren van evenementen en activaties.
● Content te creeëren ten behoeve van externe communicatie.
● Ondersteuning van sales d.m.v. hospitality & goodies.

Wie zijn wij?
Het team is verantwoordelijk voor de positionering van DPG Media in de B2B markt en houdt zich bezig met business to business ontwikkelingen binnen de mediawereld. We ontwikkelen verschillende merkverhalen, signaleren en produceren nieuwe cases, onderhouden (content) partnerships, zijn verantwoordelijk voor de interne en externe (B2B) communicatie en organiseren verschillende events. Ons team werkt nauw samen met sales, het onderzoeksteam en het digital marketingteam.

Wat krijg je van ons?
● Een leuke omgeving, goede begeleiding, borrels en de gezelligste collega’s.
● Een unieke stage om ervaring op te doen en te werken voor mooie, sterke merken.
● Een 40 urige stageweek voor minimaal 5 maanden.
● Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van €400,- per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
● En een laptop van de zaak.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
● Een relevante HBO-opleiding of WO studie (richting communicatie, journalistiek, marketing of commerciële economie).
● Affiniteit met media in de breedste zin van het woord (print, online, mobiel, etc).
● Je beschikt over een aanpakmentaliteit en je bent zelfstandig, proactief, commercieel, nieuwsgierig en een echte teamplayer.

Stagelopen bij DPG Media
Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv!

Over DPG Media
DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werkenwe met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl, Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onzemerken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat?

Interesse, en dan?
Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan nu en uiterlijk 31 december. Stuur je motivatiebrief en je cv mee met je sollicitatie. Meer weten over de stage? Neem dan contact op met Wanda Voskuilen via

jobs.description:

Onze redactie zoekt een stagiar(e) voor deperiode februari 2027 tot en met juni 2027!

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig. 

  • Je schrijft foutloos Nederlands.

  • Je staat open voor feedback.

  • Je hebt interesse in de belevingswereld van kinderen.

  • Je bent digitaal vaardig en voelt je thuis in de wereld van TikTok.

    Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een mooie plek in ons spiksplinternieuwe duurzame kantoor in Amsterdam.

jobs.title: Advertising Data Specialist
jobs.description:
Amsterdam/Hilversum - Bereik 91% van alle Nederlanders met jouw werk! Als Advertising Data Specialist maak jij elke dag impact door middel van onze nieuwsmedia, magazines, online services, radio en TV. Je vertaalt de advertising doelstellingen van adverteerders naar slimme, datagedreven audience-oplossingen en draagt zo direct bij aan succesvolle campagnes. Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en onze mediaproducties versterken? Lees dan snel verder! 

Wat ga je doen?
Als Advertising Data Specialist vertaal je de targeted advertising-doelstellingen van adverteerders naar de praktische implementatie binnen onze data- en advertentieplatformen. Met jouw technische inzicht en commerciële affiniteit ontwikkel en optimaliseer je audiences en dataproposities, zodat adverteerders hun doelgroepen effectief kunnen bereiken. Je neemt eigenaarschap over onze data offering, je volgt de prestaties, signaleert verbeterkansen en werkt continu aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om met eigen ideeën te komen en initiatief te nemen.  Zonder jouw expertise worden kansen op het gebied van doelgroepdata, automatisering en campagneprestaties niet optimaal benut. Dit doe je onder andere door:

  • Verantwoordelijk te zijn voor het functioneel beheer en de optimalisatie van het Data Management Platform, inclusief de juiste inrichting, incidentmanagement en ondersteuning via verschillende kanalen.

  • Segmenten en dataproposities te ontwikkelen, beheren en optimaliseren, zodat adverteerders gerichte campagnes kunnen inkopen op al onze titels, op (mobile) web, in-app en via connected audio & TV.  

  • Interne stakeholders te adviseren over de beschikbaarheid, mogelijkheden en inzet van doelgroepdata, audiences en privacyvraagstukken.

  • Ontwikkelingen in de markt, nieuwe databronnen en AI-toepassingen te vertalen naar innovatieve audiences, producten en geautomatiseerde processen.

  • Samen te werken aan projecten die de effectiviteit van onze data aantonen, analyses uitvoeren op audience prestaties en continu zoeken naar verbeteringen van onze data offering.

Wie zijn wij?
Je wordt onderdeel van het Advertising Data (BENE)-team binnen de afdeling Digital Sales Development. Vanuit Amsterdam of het Mediapark in Hilversum werk je in een omgeving die continu in ontwikkeling is. Ons team bestaat uit 17 collega's uit Nederland en België en richt zich op het ontwikkelen van nieuwe dataproposities, het aansluiten van nieuwe partners, het bouwen van eigen tools, het ontwikkelen van slimme AI-oplossingen en het aantonen van de kracht van onze data. Je werkt intensief samen met Product- en Innovatieteams, Ontwikkelteams en collega's binnen je eigen team om onze datagedreven advertentieoplossingen verder te ontwikkelen. 

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
Voor deze rol zoeken wij een gedreven mediaprofessional. Jij bent optimistisch, betrokken, gedreven en creatief. Daarnaast bezit jij:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

  • Bij voorkeur 1 tot 2 jaar ervaring binnen digital advertising.

  • Affiniteit met data, technologie en het ontwikkelen van datagedreven proposities, gecombineerd met een commerciële instelling.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, ruimdenkend en proactief. Je neemt initiatief, onderzoekt wat wél mogelijk is en vertaalt jouw analytische blik naar verbeteringen, automatiseringsmogelijkheden, innovatieve oplossingen en nieuwe proposities.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, interesse in AI en het vermogen om collega's en sales te adviseren en enthousiasmeren over nieuwe mogelijkheden op het gebied van audiences en data.

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor al het talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier!

Wat krijg je van ons?
Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Campus/ DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

💰Een salaris tussen de €3.100,- en €4.000,-, passend bij jouw werkervaring

📝Een 36-urige werkweek 

💰8 % vakantiegeld en 4% persoonlijk keuzebudget

💰Jaarlijkse winstdeling op basis van de prestaties van DPG Media

🎓Ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, zowel op de job als online via onze DPG Academy/ DPG Campus

🎉Mogelijkheid om je eigen culturele feestdagen af te stemmen!

🏢Een geweldig nieuw kantoor in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). Van ons legendarische personeelsfeest tot de Iftar tot samen de Dam tot Dam loop rennen. Er zijn tal van mogelijkheden voor verbinding met collega’s en om je bij ons thuis te voelen.

Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken
Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, RTL en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen. We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquiz team of een sportteam is.

Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben. En, als je toch bezig bent, vind je ons ook op Instagram, LinkedIn en X.

Solliciteren, en dan?
Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct! Je krijgt binnen 10 werkdagen een reactie op je sollicitatie en te horen of je bij de eerste selectie zit. Zit je bij de eerste selectie, dan zullen we telefonisch contact met je opnemen om een afspraak in te plannen op ons kantoor in Amsterdam. Meer weten, neem dan contact op met Jan Rep via

jobs.title: Teamleider Inbound
jobs.description:
Stuur jij ons inbound-team aan en zorg je dat elke zending binnen no-time op de juiste plek ligt?

Krijg jij energie van een strak georganiseerd magazijn? Bij All4running draait alles om snelheid en nauwkeurigheid. Wij zoeken een meewerkend voorman/vrouw die de volledige controle neemt over onze goederenontvangst. Als Teamleider Inbound zorg jij dat de voorraad altijd klopt en dat jouw team elke dag met plezier de targets haalt.


Wat ga je doen?

In deze rol ben je het aanspreekpunt op de vloer voor de goederenontvangst. Je rapporteert aan onze Warehouse Manager en werkt nauw samen met je collega-Teamleiders van Outbound en Retouren om de dagelijkse operatie soepel te laten verlopen.

• Aansturing op de vloer: Je coacht, motiveert en begeleidt jouw team van 4 tot 8 medewerkers. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig en werkt waar nodig mee.

• WMS-beheer (Picqer): Je zorgt voor een foutloze inslag. Je ziet toe op een strikte scan-discipline en lost administratieve verschillen in het systeem direct op.

• Planning & Forecast: Je maakt de personeelsplanning (via Dyflexis), waarbij je 4 tot 6 weken vooruitkijkt om drukke periodes op te vangen.

• Procesbewaking: Je schakelt snel met de afdeling Inkoop en zorgt dat de fysieke binnenkomst van orders naadloos aansluit op de administratieve afhandeling.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een praktische leider die van aanpakken weet, rust brengt in de hectiek en het overzicht bewaart tussen de stellingen.

• Ervaring: Je hebt ervaring in een logistieke omgeving en bent toe aan een tweede stap in je carrière of je hebt al ervaring als (assistent) teamleider.

• Niveau: Je beschikt over MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau.

• Hand-on mentaliteit: Je bent analytisch genoeg om een planning te maken, maar je vindt het heerlijk om het grootste deel van je dag fysiek in het magazijn aanwezig te zijn.

• Communicatie: Je bent een teamplayer die makkelijk communiceert met zowel je eigen team als je collega-teamleads.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een uitdagende leidinggevende rol in een groeiende, sportieve organisatie.

• Een marktconform salaris dat aansluit bij jouw ervaring. De functie is ingeschaald in Schaalgroep D van de CAO Retail Non-Food, met een salarisrange van € 2.638 tot € 3.196 bruto per maand (vanaf 21 jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek).

• Veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid: jij bent de 'eigenaar' van jouw inbound-proces.

• Werken in een gepassioneerd team in een splinternieuw/dynamisch magazijn.

• Gebruik van de eigen All4running gym, korting op ons assortiment en gratis startbewijzen voor hardloopevenementen.

• Reiskostenvergoeding (vanaf 12,5 km) en een thuiswerkvergoeding (voor de momenten dat je de planning maakt).

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Data die het verschil maakt

Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

De uitdaging

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je plek binnen LINKIT

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.


Wat we vragen

  • 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

  • Sterke programmeervaardigheden in talen zoals Python, Scala en SQL.

  • Kennis van of ervaring met distributed data processing frameworks/datalakes/orchestrators zoals Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Airflow, dbt, etc.

  • Ruime ervaring met production ELT/ETL-pipelines.

  • Ervaring met batch/streaming dataverwerking.

  • Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

  • Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

  • Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

  • Pré: ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric of BigQuery.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €5.700-€7.400 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  3. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Tabea Hensel via

Over ons

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Senior Data Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

jobs.title: Senior Mendix Developer
jobs.description:
Je kunt uitstekend bouwen. Maar bepaal jij ook de koers?

Er zijn genoeg developers die Mendix beheersen. De vraag is of jij degene bent die de architectuur neerzet, een businessanalist uitdaagt op haalbaarheid, en daarna de developer naast je meeneemt in de realisatie. Dat is een ander niveau. En precies wat wij zoeken.

De uitdaging

Ze komen met vraagstukken waarbij schaal, integratie en technische complexiteit van nature botsen met tijdsdruk en ambitie. Jij bent de senior die daarin navigeert. In de praktijk betekent dat: native B2B apps bouwen, custom widgets ontwikkelen voor complexe visualisaties zoals Gantt Charts, Java actions schrijven en architectuurkeuzes verdedigen die over meerdere sprints standhouden.

Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en werkt op opdracht bij klanten. Die combinatie geeft je technische diepgang én breedte: of het nu gaat om verkeersdoorstroming verbeteren of waterkwaliteit monitoren, jouw werk heeft tastbare impact. Af en toe schuif je aan bij presales of een haalbaarheidsanalyse. Niet als verplicht onderdeel, maar omdat jouw technisch oordeel de klantgesprekken beter maakt.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Chief of Staff to the CRO is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role within the Chaos revenue organization, working directly with the Chief Revenue Officer to drive key business priorities, accelerate strategic initiatives and ensure effective execution across the global revenue organization.

Acting as a senior advisor and trusted partner and extended arm of the CRO, this role translates strategic priorities into actionable projects, drives cross-functional initiatives and brings additional execution capacity to high-impact business challenges. The role offers close exposure to executive leadership and to all areas of a global revenue organisation.

This role requires a senior, commercially minded, analytical professional with experience in revenue strategy and operations, and a track record of independently owning cross-functional projects in fast-paced environments and the credibility to work with senior leaders.

Main Responsibilities

  • Strategic projects: Lead high-impact strategic and operational initiatives on behalf of the CRO, from problem definition and analysis through to implementation and measurable results.

  • Cross-functional execution: Drive projects across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, ensuring alignment, accountability and delivery.

  • Business performance: Analyze commercial performance, identify growth opportunities and translate data-driven insights into actionable recommendations; starting with identifying and executing growth opportunities in our channel business.

  • Executive support & decision-making: Act as a strategic thought partner to the CRO, preparing business cases, identify gaps and opportunities, executive presentations and decision frameworks, and identifying gaps and opportunities.

  • Board & executive reporting: Prepare the revenue organization's contribution to board materials, executive business reviews and strategic performance updates, in coordination with the CEO's office and Finance, ensuring clear communication of results, priorities and growth initiatives.

  • Operational excellence: Identify inefficiencies, challenge existing processes and implement scalable improvements across the revenue organization. Drive revenue All Hands and OKR processes.

  • Special initiatives: Take ownership of ad hoc business priorities, emerging opportunities and complex challenges requiring focused execution and entrepreneurial problem-solving.


  • Established commercial and revenue-related experience in top-tier strategy consulting, high-growth scale-ups or technology companies.

  • Entrepreneurial, results-oriented mindset paired with intellectual curiosity, adaptability and willingness to roll up your sleeves.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt  powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Berlin  team. In this role, you'll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact. 

We're hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Data Science Organisation

We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.

Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers. 

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not. 

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Our humble expectations

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.
  • Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.
  • Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.
  • Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the locations above 💙 
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via -----

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer (12 month FTC)
jobs.description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

We're looking for a brilliant Brand Designer who knows B2B SaaS, moves fast, and can make great work happen without a lot of fuss.

What that looks like day to day

We're looking for an experienced Brand Designer to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave.

Our brand design function was built from scratch over the last two years and the foundations are strong - a visual identity, an events design system, SEV0, a rolling drumbeat of launches and campaigns. This isn't a holding-pattern role. You'll take what we've built and run with it, across our website, social, events, launches and our flagship conference. Where you see something that should be better, you'll be trusted to make it better.

We're looking for someone who's done this kind of work before, ideally for ambitious B2B SaaS startups or established software brands. You'll have great creative instincts, an eye for the details and, crucially, the ability to get brilliant work out the door quickly. We move fast, priorities can change, and there's always something new around the corner. You'll know when to sweat the small stuff and when to just get things done.

You'll sit day-to-day in Marketing and be part of the wider Design team, alongside experienced Product Designers who'll be on hand to partner on web-native work.

  • Own brand design across all touchpoints - website, social, ads, guides, reports, events and swag - keeping quality and consistency high through a busy launch and campaign calendar.

  • Design and roll out launch creative for product launches, including launch video animation and campaign assets, partnering with Product Designers on product-screen work.

  • Lead the design for our events programme, including our flagship conference SEV0 - booths, banners, printed collateral, swag and the event design system.

  • Keep things moving - juggle multiple projects, turn around great work quickly and know how to prioritise when everything feels important. We're a fast-moving startup, and we need someone who can keep up without compromising on craft.

  • Be an advocate for consistency and craft as we scale and grow the incident.io brand. You'll have the judgement to know when something needs more attention and when it's ready to go.

  • Partner with the marketing team on both tactical and long-term projects, bringing your own perspective on how we should develop our brand.

  • Collaborate with the wider design team as we know an amazing product is the foundation for a great brand, and compelling design can be the foundation for both.

Who you are

  • You've got solid B2B SaaS experience. You've designed for B2B software companies before, whether in-house, freelance or on a contract basis. Ideally, you've worked with established SaaS brands or fast-growing startups, and you understand how to make complex, technical products feel exciting and accessible.

  • Your portfolio speaks for itself. You've got exceptional brand and marketing design work to show us, including websites, campaigns, launches, guides and presentations for B2B SaaS audiences. You care about the little details and know how to make a brand feel brilliant across every touchpoint.

  • You move fast and get stuff done. You've worked in fast-paced environments, ideally startups, and know how to balance speed with quality. You're pragmatic, comfortable juggling competing priorities and don't need everything perfectly mapped out before getting started.

  • You're confident picking up an established brand. You don't need to rebuild things from first principles to make an impact. You can get up to speed quickly, understand what's working and find ways to make it even better.

  • You've got strong digital design skills. You're brilliant in Figma, comfortable with Adobe tools for print, and care just as much about the quality of a one-pager or piece of swag as you do a big campaign.

  • You're a natural collaborator. You enjoy working closely with Marketing, Product Designers and engineers, sharing work early, taking feedback on board and sweating the details to make sure the finished thing is as good as it can be.

  • You're organised and comfortable with ambiguity. Startups can (occasionally!) be chaotic. You can figure things out as you go, make good decisions independently and keep things moving without needing lots of direction.

Bonus points

  • You have experience with motion design / animation.

  • You've designed booths, installations or other creative for conferences and events.

  • You're comfortable working with frontend engineers and getting hands-on with HTML/CSS where needed.

  • You've covered a role on an FTC or contract basis before and know how to get productive fast.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £80K – £115K

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.
We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers.


Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. The systems handle complex permissions, legacy integrations, high transaction volumes, and business processes where reliability and data correctness matter.


AI-assisted, spec-driven development is part of normal engineering practice at Plentific. The Senior Backend Engineer turns product requirements into implementation-ready specifications, uses agentic coding tools across implementation, testing, review, and documentation, and remains accountable for the resulting software. AI-generated output is held to the same standard as human-written code. Success means delivering reliable services, improving the codebase and engineering practice around the role, and enabling the wider team to ship confidently at pace.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering

  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, and related platform tooling.

  • Design service boundaries, API contracts, relational data models, and integration flows for complex property operations. Produce ERDs and other technical diagrams where they make relationships, ownership, and system behaviour easier to review.

  • Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows using technologies such as Celery and Redis.

  • Write complex SQL, evolve PostgreSQL schemas safely, and optimise database performance where customer experience or operational throughput depends on it.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it remains readable, testable, maintainable, and suitable for new product requirements.

Quality, Reliability, and Operations

  • Write automated tests at the appropriate level and integrate them into CI/CD so changes can be released with clear evidence of quality.

  • Instrument services with logs, metrics, traces, and alerts that make production behaviour and failures easy to understand.

  • Diagnose and resolve production incidents across services, databases, queues, integrations, and infrastructure.

  • Design for security, resilience, performance, and data integrity across business-critical workflows.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Partner with product managers, frontend engineers, and quality engineers to turn agreed product behaviour into implementation-ready technical solution designs covering assumptions, alternatives, service interactions, data and schema changes, failure modes, security, observability, rollout, rollback, and tests.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, review, and document code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Break specifications into small, reviewable changes and validate each change against its intended behaviour before release.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable patterns, review checklists, examples, and concise documentation.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers from problem framing through release and production operation.

  • Surface technical risks and trade-offs early, and propose pragmatic changes to scope, design, or delivery plans.

  • Review code and technical designs, setting a high bar while giving feedback that helps other engineers improve.

  • Coach mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, code review, debugging, and design discussion.

Requirements

  • Expert-level Python and Django, with strong object-oriented design and software engineering fundamentals.

  • Strong command of API design, service-oriented architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous processing.

  • Expert-level relational data modelling, including the ability to produce clear ERDs, define entities, relationships, constraints, and ownership, and design PostgreSQL schemas that balance correctness, performance, and safe evolution.

  • Demonstrable ability to turn incomplete product requirements into clear technical solution designs for complex backend changes, identifying assumptions and resolving ambiguity with product and engineering colleagues through concise written analysis and appropriate architecture, sequence, data-flow, and entity-relationship diagrams.

  • Sound judgement around automated testing, observability, production reliability, security, and data integrity.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Demonstrable ability to review technical designs and code, explain trade-offs, and coach less-experienced engineers.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and delivery risks in plain English.

  • Pragmatic delivery judgement, balancing immediate product needs with the maintainability and scalability of a long-lived platform.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial commercial experience in Python and Django.

  • Experience building and operating Django-based services in production on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Django REST Framework or FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Track record of designing and safely evolving complex relational data models in a large, long-lived production codebase, using ERDs and written technical designs to align engineers and stakeholders while preserving design quality, testability, maintainability, and safe evolution.

  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams with shared ownership of customer outcomes and production operation.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

jobs.title: Head of DACH
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a sales leader who wants to build, lead and win in a fast growing startup that’s changing how legal research is done. You’ll take ownership of our DACH sales team, help us move upmarket and play a key role in shaping the next stage of Pandektes’ growth.

About Pandektes

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

Pandektes has raised more than €17.5 million and most recently closed a €13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

About the role

As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets.

You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. A big part of the role will be helping the team move further upmarket and win larger, more complex customers. You’ll stay close to the team and the deals, coaching regularly, joining important customer conversations and helping your AEs progress and close opportunities.

This is a role for building, not maintaining. We recently closed our €13.5M Series A, and you’ll have the backing to hire, grow the team and take it upmarket. With 500+ customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland, customers already pay for the product, the team is in place, and there’s a lot of room to go bigger.

Our processes and playbooks are still being built, so you’ll have a real say in how we sell. How you run pipeline, coaching and hiring will become how sales works at Pandektes as we scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our DACH Account Executive team

  • Coach the team through regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal reviews

  • Own team targets, pipeline and forecasting across the DACH market

  • Help the team win larger and more complex customers as we continue to move upmarket

  • Get involved in key deals and support the team with customer meetings, objections, negotiations and closing

  • Help Account Executives improve their discovery, pitching and ability to work with multiple stakeholders

  • Make sure we have a healthy pipeline and a clear view of where revenue is coming from

  • Look at where deals are progressing, where they are getting stuck and what we can do differently

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and the wider commercial team to improve how we find and win customers across our global target market

  • Improve our sales processes and playbooks as the team grows

  • Hire and onboard new Account Executives as we continue to build the DACH team

The experience you bring

  • Experience leading a B2B SaaS sales team, ideally with Account Executives selling into the DACH market

  • A strong sales background and a track record of delivering against team revenue targets

  • Experience working across different deal sizes, including larger opportunities with longer sales cycles and multiple decision makers

  • Experience helping a team move upmarket and win larger customers

  • You enjoy coaching and know how to help salespeople improve rather than simply telling them what to do

  • You’re comfortable getting involved in deals and working alongside your team when needed

  • You understand what good pipeline management and forecasting looks like

  • You’re confident using CRM data to understand performance and where the team needs support

  • You’re comfortable joining a growing company where processes are still being built and improved

  • You’re able to balance hitting the number today with building a stronger sales team for the future

  • Professional fluency in German and English

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

What we offer

You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, pension and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We have offices in Copenhagen, London and Hamburg. This role will be based in Germany with some travels to our offices to meet the team.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work - you can expect social events, opportunity to travel to our different locations to visit the teams, and offsites - our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Compensation: €100K – €120K • Offers Equity • €100K – €120K Commission

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. We're seeking a highly motivated, English-speaking AI-native Static Ad Designer with experience in designing static ads for performance marketing campaigns to join our team full-time (in San Francisco or Berlin on-site, hybrid or remote). Your creatives will reach millions of people across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok.

  • Uplane is the best place to learn how to design ads with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years.

jobs.description:
Retire the ERP

At Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.

In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.

You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.

The Role

  • Own the data migration practice end to end: every customer moving to Light from Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage or spreadsheets goes through you and your team.

  • Lead, coach and grow a small team of migration specialists, setting priorities across a pipeline of concurrent customer migrations and keeping go-live dates on track.

  • Run migrations hands-on when it matters: extracting legacy data, mapping charts of accounts, business partners, open invoices and balances, and reconciling the result back to the source system.

  • Build and maintain the source-system connectors and migration flows that power our Zero Day Implementation offering, so a new customer’s records can be converted into Light in hours, not weeks.

  • Use AI and automation to speed up mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, and turn repeated manual work into productised, self-serve tooling with Engineering and Product.

  • Set the standards: migration methodology, mapping templates, reconciliation checks, data quality rules, and clear scope boundaries (what we migrate, what we don’t, and what’s billable, such as historical documents and attachments).

  • Be the expert voice with customers’ finance leaders on migration questions, including multi-entity, consolidation, FX and VAT treatment, and be clear with them when a request would put accuracy or timelines at risk.

  • Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with migration scoping, effort estimates and sample migrations for prospects.

  • Track and report on migration throughput, time to go-live and data accuracy, and use them to decide where to automate next.

How You Fit Into The Team

As Team Lead, Data Migration Services, you sit at the front door of every Light customer relationship. Implementation Managers own the customer journey; you own getting their history into Light accurately and fast. You’ll partner daily with Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering and Sales, and report directly to the Head of Services.

This is a player-coach role: you’ll lead a small team and still roll up your sleeves on the hardest migrations and connector builds. Your biggest mandate is making “zero day conversion” real: run the records first, then run the processes.

Your Qualifications Could Be

  • You have personally delivered at least one full accounting system migration through go-live and sign-off (for example Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or NetSuite into a new platform). This is a must.

  • Around 5 years in ERP data migration, finance systems implementation or accounting technology, including some time leading people or a workstream.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of Xero, QuickBooks Online, NetSuite or Sage as a source system.

  • Strong accounting fundamentals: you understand double entry, trial balances, AR/AP subledgers, multi-entity, multi-currency and UK VAT, and can reconcile to the penny.

  • Technical depth to build, not just configure: comfortable with REST APIs, OAuth, SQL, and scripting (Python or TypeScript) for extraction and transformation.

  • Practical, evidenced experience using AI tools to speed up data mapping, cleansing or migration work.

  • Experience designing repeatable ETL processes, mapping templates and data validation checks.

  • A clear, confident communicator with finance leaders, who can explain when a request isn’t sound and suggest a better way.

  • Able to manage many concurrent migrations while keeping quality high, with the support of a team you’ll shape.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • A background as an accountant, auditor or finance systems consultant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar).

  • Experience building or maintaining integrations with accounting platform APIs (Xero, QBO, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteQL).

  • Exposure to IFRS, UK GAAP, consolidations, intercompany and revenue recognition.

  • Experience at a SaaS or fintech company turning services work into product.

  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools like n8n.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary plus equity.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Final Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

 

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo, Senior Recruiter : 30 minutes

  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert, Responsable de l’équipe : 1 heure

  • Test pratique en allemand : lecture d’un message client et rédaction d’une réponse

  • Dernier échange en visio avec Nathan Robinet, Senior Team Lead Customer Support, Financial Services : 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información
