jobs.title: OP Assistans söker personliga assistenter i Sandviken
jobs.description: Har du ett stort engagemang för andra människor och söker ett givande arbete där du verkligen får göra skillnad i någon annans vardag? Då kan du vara den vi söker!Vi letar nu efter engagerade och trygga personliga assistenter till några av våra kunder. Hos oss arbetar du inte i ett flödande schema mellan många olika personer – du blir istället en viktig del av ett specifikt team hos en enskild kund. Det ger dig möjlighet att bygga en stark relation, skapa trygghet och verkligen lära känna personen du assisterar.Alla våra assistenter börjar som timvikarier, vilket ger en perfekt möjlighet att lära känna kunden och arbetet. För rätt person finns det hos flera av våra kunder goda möjligheter till en fast schemarad på deltid framöver.Vad innebär rollen som personlig assistent?Att arbeta som personlig assistent handlar i grunden om att göra det möjligt för en annan människa att leva ett så självständigt och aktivt liv som möjligt, utifrån sina egna förutsättningar och önskemål. Du blir kundens förlängda armar och ben i vardagen.Exempel på vad du kan få hjälpa till med:    Vardagliga rutiner: Matlagning, städning, tvätt och planering i hemmet.    Personlig omvårdnad: Hjälp med hygien, av- och påklädning samt måltider.    Aktiviteter och fritid: Följa med på utflykter, träning, bio, besöka vänner eller delta i andra intressen och evenemang.    Förflyttningar och hjälpmedel: Stöd i rörelse och hantering av eventuella tekniska hjälpmedel i vardagen.    Socialt stöd: Vara ett tryggt och uppmuntrande sällskap.Arbetstiderna varierar beroende på kundens behov och kan innefatta dag, kväll, dygn med väntetid samt vaken natt. Både vardagar och helger.Vem är du?Eftersom personkemi är avgörande i detta yrke lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Vi söker dig som:    Är lyhörd, ödmjuk och har en stark känsla för service och personlig integritet.    Är ansvarsfull, punktlig och trygg i dig själv.    Har god förmåga att kommunicera och uttrycka dig väl på svenska.    Är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig efter kundens dagsform och önskemål.Tidigare erfarenhet inom vård och omsorg eller personlig assistans är meriterande, men inget absolut krav. Det viktigaste är dina personliga egenskaper och dina värderingar.Vad erbjuder vi dig?    Ett meningsfullt och varierat arbete där du gör stor skillnad varje dag.    En trygg anställning och introduktion anpassad efter kunden du ska arbeta hos.    Möjlighet till utveckling och schemarad på deltid för rätt person.    Nära stöd från din uppdragschef.AnsökanLåter detta som en tjänst för dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så skicka in ditt CV och personliga brev redan idag.Rekryteringsprocessen Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdagen. Vid eventuell anställning En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling. För att säkerställa att alla kandidater som går vidare kan styrka sin rätt att arbeta i Sverige, ber vi även om personbevis från samtliga.  Personbeviset beställer du kostnadsfritt via Skatteverkets webbplats och kan laddas ner direkt med BankID här. På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år för att jobba som personlig assistent hos oss.OP Assistans erbjuder trygg och respektfull personlig assistans.  Vi bygger nära och långsiktiga relationer som ett mindre bolag, men har samtidigt tryggheten och resurserna från vår större koncern, Team Olivia. Många av våra chefer har egen erfarenhet som personliga assistenter, vilket ger en djup förståelse för yrket.  Vi följer kollektivavtal mellan Kommunal/Vårdföretagarna.

jobs.title: Chef, Restaurant Aihki, Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description: **Join the team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**We are looking for a **Chef** to join Restaurant Aihki for the winter season 2026 - 2027, as part of Sunday Morning Resort in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.Restaurant Aihki is known for its high-quality modern Nordic cuisine, where pure, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).As a Chef at Restaurant Aihki, you will work as part of our professional kitchen team and take an active role in daily food preparation and service. You will work with high-quality ingredients and help ensure that every dish leaving the kitchen meets Aihki's high standards.This position is ideal for a chef with a few years of professional kitchen experience who is looking to develop their skills in a high-quality restaurant environment. Experience in à la carte, fine dining or Nordic cuisine is considered an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for a professional attitude, a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for great food.**Your responsibilities include:**- Preparing and presenting dishes according to Restaurant Aihki's standards - Working across different kitchen stations during daily service - Preparing and handling ingredients - Following Aihki's recipes, procedures and quality standards - Ensuring the quality, proper storage and rotation of ingredients - Following kitchen hygiene, food safety and self-monitoring procedures - Keeping your workstation clean, organised and ready for service - Working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams **We are looking for someone who has:**- Approximately 2-3 years of professional kitchen experience - A relevant culinary qualification or equivalent practical experience - Experience in an à la carte restaurant; fine dining or Nordic cuisine experience is considered an advantage - Strong fundamental cooking skills and an interest in high-quality ingredients - An organised, responsible and proactive approach to work - The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment - Good teamwork and communication skills - Good spoken English; Finnish and other languages are considered an advantage - Motivation to learn and continue developing professionally - Above all, a positive attitude and genuine passion for high-quality food **We offer you:**- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's highly regarded restaurants - The opportunity to develop your skills in modern Nordic cuisine - An inspiring working environment surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland - The support of a welcoming, professional and international team - Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins - The possibility of staff accommodation close to the workplace - Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits - Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort - Employee benefits for selected activities - The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company - An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services - A competitive salary based on your experience and skills, with the MARA collective agreement as the basis for salary **Employment**The position begins in **mid-November 2026** and continues until the **end of March 2027**.This is a **full-time seasonal position**, approximately **40 hours per week**, with two days off per week. Shifts are mainly scheduled in the afternoon and evening.Working a winter season in Pyhä also means experiencing the Arctic winter, snowy fells and the unique atmosphere of Finnish Lapland right outside your workplace.**About us****Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned tourism company** offering high-quality accommodation, dining and activity experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park.Sustainability is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to developing tourism responsibly, respecting the unique nature of Lapland and working closely with local businesses and partners.As an employer, we believe in a positive working atmosphere, open communication, strong team spirit and opportunities for professional growth. With us, you'll work with international guests in the beautiful surroundings of Pyhätunturi as part of a skilled and close-knit team.Restaurant Aihki is the restaurant of Sunday Morning Resort, combining the flavours and local ingredients of Lapland with contemporary Scandinavian influences. Throughout the season, we also organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings.Discover Restaurant Aihki on Instagram **@restaurantaihki** and at **sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**.**Interested?**Please send your application with the subject line **Chef Aihki / \[Your Name\]**, together with your CV and salary expectation.Tell us about your background, professional experience and why you would like to spend the upcoming winter season as part of the Aihki team.We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply early.**Applications and enquiries:**- rekry@sundaymorning.fi - sundaymorning.fi

Afdelingen er placeret ved byens bedste strand, Malagueta, og beskæftiger ca. 35 glade danske kollegaer, der løser forskellige opgaver, som primært er rettet imod det danske marked. Afdelingen har eksisteret siden 2015, og har fået opbygget den samme respekt og troværdig som vores danske afdelinger. 

5R People er et kontaktcenter, og vi ønsker at skille os ud fra mængden, ved at levere en oplevelse udover det sædvanlige for både medarbejdere, kunder og kundernes kunder. Vi leverer et professionelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor trivsel og udvikling er i fokus, og hvor opgaven er, at sikre den bedste oplevelse ud i mod vores kunder og deres kunder. 

Vi tilbyder: 

  • Fuldtid 

  • Fast timeløn + fordelagtig provisionsordning uden loft 

  • Beliggenhed ved byens bedste strand 

  • Tryg og sikker udstationering med særdeles ordnede forhold 

  • Hjælp til arbejds- og opholdstilladelse 

  • Professionel oplæring 

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling 

  • Et udvidet netværk bestående af 500+ engagerede kollegaer 

  • Intern eller ekstern karriereudvikling 

  • Arbejdsopgaver indenfor salg 

  • Medspillende og motiverede ledere 

Hvorfor skal du være vores nye kollega?

jobs.title: Betongarbetare
jobs.description: Om tjänstenVi söker dig med bakgrund inom snickeri, betong eller bygg till vår kund strax utanför Eskilstuna. Du kommer att arbeta med tillverkning av prefabricerade stommar och betongelement, där arbetsuppgifterna bland annat består av armering, gjutning, formning och ritningsläsning.Hos vår kund tillverkas prefabricerade stommar i egen produktion, med både stålstommar och betongelement. Du blir en viktig del av produktionen och arbetar tillsammans med ett engagerat team där kvalitet, säkerhet och noggrannhet står i fokus.Tjänsten inleds med en provanställning, med målsättningen att den ska övergå till en tillsvidareanställning för rätt person. Vi söker därför dig som är intresserad av en långsiktig arbetsplats och vill utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.Varför ska du söka tjänsten?Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en verksamhet där hantverk, kvalitet och lagarbete står i centrum. Du får utveckla dina kunskaper inom betong och bygg samt arbeta med tillverkning av prefabricerade konstruktioner.Vi söker dig som vill ha en långsiktig arbetsplats, är engagerad i ditt arbete och vill utvecklas i din roll. Visar du framfötterna under provanställningen finns goda möjligheter till en fortsatt tillsvidareanställning.Din profilDu kommer bland annat att arbeta med tillverkningen av prefabricerade betongelement. Det innebär att du färdigställer väggar och andra betongelement inför leverans och montage.Som betongarbetare arbetar du huvudsakligen med att:    Forma, armera och gjuta väggar i betong utifrån tillverkningsunderlag och instruktioner.    Arbeta med ett gediget hantverk där stor noggrannhet och precision är viktigt.    Säkerställa att rätt ingjutningsgods placeras och gjuts in på rätt plats i produkterna.    Arbeta tillsammans med ditt team för att nå de uppsatta målen för dagen.    Arbeta med stort fokus på kvalitet och säkerhet.    Läsa och förstå ritningar samt tillverkningsunderlag.Vi söker dig som har gymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har ett logiskt tänkande, är noggrann och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.Det är meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat med betong, armering, snickeri eller liknande arbetsuppgifter inom bygg.Som person har du lätt för att lära dig nya saker och är driven, ansvarstagande och noggrann. Du kan leverera god kvalitet även i ett högt arbetstempo och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra.Eftersom arbetet utförs i team är det viktigt att du har en positiv inställning och bidrar till ett bra samarbete på arbetsplatsen.AnställningsformTjänsten inleds med en provanställning, med målsättningen att anställningen därefter ska övergå till en tillsvidareanställning.Under provanställningen får du möjlighet att komma in i arbetsuppgifterna, lära känna arbetsplatsen och visa vad du går för. För oss är det viktigt att hitta rätt person för rollen och för dig som visar engagemang, tar ansvar och levererar arbete med god kvalitet finns goda möjligheter till en långsiktig anställning.Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och ber om ursäkt på förhand om det kan ta lite tid med återkoppling. Målet är att alla sökande ska få återkoppling via telefon eller mejl.Om verksamhetenFiks Group AB erbjuder inhyrning av personal under korta eller längre perioder.Fiks skall upplevas som en naturlig samarbetspartner i Sverige när behov av personal uppstår.Genom en nära relation mellan företag och personal arbetar vi tillsammans för att nå våra uppsatta mål. Vi vill skapa nöjda kunder och nöjd personal.Vi rekryterar kompetent personal, utvecklar och bemannar kundens verksamhet.Vår snabbhet och kompetens är vår styrka och er möjlighet.Fiks Group är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag i ALMEGA.Vi har funnits sedan 1997 i Eskilstuna men är nu runt hela Sverige. Vi bemannar era behov!

jobs.title: Strategic Product Manager | Early Career Program
jobs.description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   About this opportunity   Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research & Development, Market Area, and Product Management contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. Your journey within the Innovate Program will start as Strategic Product Manager.     What you will do   Would you like to build on your technical experience and explore how technology turns into products, customer value and new business opportunities? In this role, you will join our RAN Software Product Management team, working with new service capabilities and security in RAN. You will learn how we shape our portfolio, understand emerging market and customer needs for 5G and 6G, and translate technology into clear value for our customers. We are looking for an early-career professional who wants to build on a strong technical foundation and grow towards strategic product management. You will work alongside experienced Strategic Product Managers and gain exposure to both the technical, marketing and commercial sides of RAN Software. Your initial focus will be on Differentiated Connectivity, supporting work around new connectivity capabilities and services, including network slicing, service awareness and time critical applications.      Work alongside Strategic Product Managers to support the development of our RAN Software portfolio.     Explore how advanced RAN and 5G capabilities can address customer needs and enable new services and business opportunities     Develop stories and proof points that helps our presales and sales teams globally to translate technical capabilities into clear value propositions and customer benefits     Support customer engagements together with product managers, Market Areas and other teams across Ericsson     Analyse market developments, customer needs and emerging services to provide relevant insights to the team     Build your understanding of RAN Software product management, while gaining exposure to our broader portfolio.      You will bring        2–5 years of relevant professional experience, ideally within RAN, telecom technology, systems engineering, research, technical presales or a related area     A strong technical foundation and understanding of mobile networks, ideally with experience or knowledge of RAN     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand new and complex topics quickly     The ability to communicate technical topics clearly and work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders     Curiosity about customers, markets and the business opportunities created by new technology     A collaborative mindset and the ability to build relationships across different teams and areas     Strong personal drive, accountability and a willingness to learn and take on new challenges

Performance \& Emissions Engineer Defense (m/f/x)
=================================================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You plan and perform performance and emissions (P\&E) testing and calibration on test benches and powerpacks
* You support certification testing, including test execution, first\-level result checks and preparation of certification reports
* You perform engine calibration for performance and emissions, including calibration for durability runs and P\&E\-related labels
* You conduct thermodynamic simulations of combustion processes and air/exhaust systems, and analyse the results
* You support software validation activities, troubleshooting and application engineering, providing technical expertise on performance\-related topics
* You coordinate testing activities with internal teams, OEMs and authorities, including test planning, test requests and engine bill of materials alignment
* You monitor and report testing progress, technical issues and P\&E status to technical leads and platform leaders
* You contribute to continuous improvement by developing calibration and simulation tools, improving test procedures and maintaining team workflows


Your Profile
------------

* You hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related technical field
* You have solid experience and knowledge of combustion engines, engine performance and emissions development. Experience in Defense applications is an advantage
* You are familiar with engine testing processes, calibration methodologies and technical reporting
* You are proactive, structured and analytical, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams
* You are willing and able to travel regularly (approximately 25%)
* You are fluent in English, French and/or German is an advantage


Our Offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

*This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent.*

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chef de Partie---Chef de Partie============== **Chef de Partie** **Permanent contract** / Crans\-Montana, SwitzerlandLes Roches, part of Sommet Education group, is a globally renowned institution shaping the future of hospitality and the experience economy through transformative and experiential education in 3 campuses: Crans\-Montana (Switzerland), Marbella (Spain) and Dhabi (UAE).2nd in the 2026 QS World University Ranking in Hospitality and Leisure Management and 2nd in employer reputation category.Accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE) and Swiss Accreditation Council (SAC) as a University of Applied Sciences Institute.Les Roches Marbella, certified ISO\-14001 and ISO\-9001\.Our values, *Development, Distinctiveness, Joint Commitment, Openness and Sense of Service*, are the foundation of our actions. We offer an innovative, collaborative and thriving environment. **Mission**  The Chef de Partie is responsible for the preparation, production, and presentation of food within an assigned kitchen section. Working under the supervision of the Executive Sous\-Chef and Kitchen Sous\-Chef, the role ensures the consistent application of culinary standards, food safety requirements, and operational procedures.  As part of Les Roches' experiential learning environment, the Chef de Partie supports students during practical sessions by demonstrating professional culinary techniques and fostering a culture of excellence, professionalism, and hospitality. **Main Responsibilities  1\. Execute Food Production Activities**  \- Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to established recipes, production plans, and quality standards.  \- Ensure consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control.  \- Contribute to the smooth operation of daily kitchen activities within the assigned section.   **2\. Support Student Practical Training**  \- Assist students during practical kitchen sessions and operational service periods.  \- Demonstrate culinary techniques, kitchen organization, and professional work methods.  \- Promote discipline, teamwork, and compliance with operational standards.   **3\. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. jobs.title: Sous Chef  100% ohne Zimmerstunde
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Sous Chef (m/w/d) 100% ohne Zimmerstunde--- Sous Chef (m/w/d) 100% ohne Zimmerstunde========================================**Lust auf Gastronomie mit Adrenalin?**  Vergiss verstaubte Gastro\-Standards: Bei der  **Hospitality AG** mit Sitz in Arlesheim BL kreieren wir Erlebnisse, die im Gedächtnis bleiben! Als eines der schweizweit führenden Event\-Cateringunternehmen erwecken wir einzigartige Konzepte zum Leben – von stilvollen Galas und exklusiven Corporate Events über bebende Grossveranstaltungen mit bis zu 6'500 Gästen bis hin zu coolen Streetfood\-Projekten. Ob in unseren eigenen Eventlocations oder bei unseren Kunden vor Ort.  Wir verbinden die Stärke eines Marktführers mit der Freiheit und Dynamik eines modernen Lifestyle\-Betriebs. Bei uns erwartet dich kein starrer Trott, sondern ein junges, ambitioniertes Team mit echter Hands\-on\-Mentalität: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, denken anders und bringen Spitzenleistung dorthin, wo gefeiert wird. Du suchst einen Ort, an dem du deine Energie voll einbringen, aktiv mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit uns über dich hinauswachsen kannst? Willkommen in der Welt von !  Die  **Hospitality** gehört zur  **Enterprise AG**. Unter deren Dach sind zwei weitere Unternehmen tätig. Neben dem Eventbereich sind wir auch im Backoffice stark:  **Treuhand****GmbH** betreut Mandate aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und sorgt für Ordnung und Durchblick – von der Finanzbuchhaltung über das Controlling bis zum Personalwesen.   **Konzepte GmbH** agiert als strategischer Impulsgeber, unterstützt Unternehmen beim Business Development und entwickelt innovative Gastro\-Konzepte, die weit über den Tellerrand hinausreichen.  ***Du willst nicht nur am Herd stehen, sondern die kulinarische Zukunft der Schweizer Eventbranche aktiv mitgestalten?***  In unserer Küche erwartet dich keine verstaubte Routine: Wir tüfteln an innovativen Food\-Konzepten, rocken gemeinsam die grössten Events des Landes und schaffen Momente, die in Erinnerung bleiben.  Du bist eine Sous\-Chef\-Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Führungs\-, Organisations\- und Executive\-Erfahrung, hast tiefes Gourmet\-Verständnis und suchst eine echte Schlüsselrolle als rechte Hand unseres Chef de Cuisine – und das ganz ohne mühsame Zimmerstunde? Dann bist du bei der Hospitality genau richtig!  Als   **Sous Chef / Sous Chef (m/w/d)****100 %** bildest du gemeinsam mit einem zweiten Sous Chef das starke Führungsduo direkt an der Seite unseres Chef de Cuisine. Du übernimmst Mitverantwortung für die operative Küchenleitung, die administrative Planung und die Führung unseres Kernteams sowie der variablen Saison\-Crew.  **Deine Aufgaben bei uns:**  * **Rechte Hand des Chef de Cuisine:** Du unterstützt unseren Küchenchef aktiv bei der Planung, Organisation und Konzeptentwicklung. Bei seiner Abwesenheit übernimmst du die Gesamtleitung in Vertretung des Küchenchef.  * **Operative Unterstützung \& Team\-Anleitung**: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Küchenchef und dem zweiten Sous Chef zusammen. Gemeinsam leitet ihr unser festes Kernteam von 6 Mitarbeitenden (davon 2 Lernende) in der der Cateringproduktion und an Eventeinsätzen.  * **Flexibles Saison\-Team**: Je nach Saison, Event\-Volumen und Auslastung packst du stärker im Operativen Geschäft mit an und stellst die Einarbeitung und Anleitung unserer variablen Mitarbeitenden sicher.  * **Qualität \& Gourmet\-Gefühl:** Du stellst sicher, dass jedes Gericht – von exklusiven Business\-Caterings bis hin zu eindrucksvollen Grossveranstaltungen – geschmacklich und optisch höchsten Gourmet\-Ansprüchen genügt.  * **Planung \& Admin:** Du hast die administrativen Abläufe im Griff (Dienstplanung, Produktionsplanung, Rezeptur\-Standardisierung, Einhaltung von HACCP\- und Hygiene\-Richtlinien usw.) und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe vor Ort.  * **Event\- \& Catering\-Einsätze:** Du packst bei Caterings und Events in der ganzen Schweiz aktiv mit an – in unseren eigenen Locations und bei unseren Kunden vor Ort.  ### Voraussetzungen* **Ausbildung \& Praxis:** Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Koch EFZ sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Gourmet/Sternegastronomie.  * **Catering\- \& Event\-Erfahrung:** Optimalerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus dem Event\-Cateringbereich mit und behältst auch bei hoher Dynamik den kühlen .  * **Leadership \& Organisation:** Du bringst umfassende Führungserfahrung mit, hast bereits grössere Teams geleitet und die administrative Planung und Organisation eigenständig verantwortet. Du hast Erfahrung darin, variable Mitarbeitende bei saisonalen Spitzen als Verstärkung des Stammteams klar anzuleiten und einheitliche Standards sicherzustellen.  * **Aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit:** Du bist eine mitreissende, kommunikative und gewinnende Persönlichkeit – kurz: eine echte Macher\-Natur, die gerne vorne steht, ihr Team begeistert und nicht im Hintergrund verschwindet.  * **Sprachkompetenz:** Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse für die reibungslose Kommunikation im multinationalen Team.  ### Vorteile* **Keine Zimmerstunde:** Bei uns arbeitest du in durchgehenden Einsätzen statt gestückelten Arbeitstagen. Kein stundenlanges Warten zwischen den Schichten – damit deine freie Zeit auch wirklich deine Zeit bleibt.  * **Betriebsferien:** Zwei Wochen Betriebsferien im sowie zwei Wochen über Weihnachten und Neujahr für deine Erholung sind immer gesetzt.  * **Top\- \& Infrastruktur:** Moderner Arbeitsplatz auf dem dynamischen Areal in Arlesheim direkt am Naherholungsgebiet der Birs (perfekt für die Pause am ). Genügend Parkplätze vor Ort und beste ÖV\-Anbindung.  * **Starker Teamgeist:** Dynamisches Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Du\-Kultur und Teamevents, die zusammenschweissen.     **Bereit, an der Spitze unserer Küche mitzugestalten?**  uns deine ***vollständige*** Bewerbung und bring deine Erfahrung bei Hospitality ein!  ![ Enterprise AG]()* Enterprise AG  Hauptstrasse 23  4142 Münchenstein*jid53c9acdjm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Floor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)
jobs.description: ab sofort oder nach VereinbarungFloor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n:  Diese Aufgabe umfasst die Gewährleistung der Sauberkeit und Werterhaltung im ganzen Haus, die Kontrolle der Zimmer sowie der öffentlichen Räume und die Koordination aller anfallenden Arbeiten im Housekeeping. Sie sind zuständig für die Einweisung der Mitarbeitenden, Sie unterstützen durch laufende Schulungen und stellen somit die Gästezufriedenheit her.  Sie haben die Ausbildung zur Hotelfachfrau EFZ oder Fachfrau Hauswirtschaft erfolgreich abgeschlossen, sprechen Deutsch, sind dienstleistungsorientiert und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig und effizient. Sie zeigen hohes Bewusstsein für Sauberkeit und Ordnung, sind zuverlässig und arbeiten gerne im Team. Wenn Sie ausserdem noch den Berufsbildnerkurs besucht haben und Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position mitbringen, so ist dies von Vorteil. Wir erwarten ein gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten. Fremdsprachen sind ein zusätzliches Plus im Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und Gästen.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. jobs.title: Planificateur PDP
jobs.description: Ref 2591467 \| Date: 16 Nov 2026![ValJob Genève]( )![]( )![]( ) **Vous êtes à la recherche d’un nouveau challenge ? ValJob, active depuis 1995 dans le placement et les services en Ressources Humaines, est une société suisse leader, reconnue et appréciée pour la qualité de ses services et la haute performance de ses collaborateurs. Nous recherchons pour l’un de nos clients le profil suivant :****Planificateur PDP (H/F)**===========================**Votre mission :  Votre prochain défi  Vous avez une solide compréhension des enjeux de planification industrielle et souhaitez contribuer à la performance d'un environnement de production exigeant ?  Pour accompagner notre client dans le développement et le pilotage de ses activités, ValJob recherche un(e) Planificateur PDP (H/F) pour sa division Production.  Au cœur des flux industriels, vous serez responsable de la construction des programmes directeurs de production et du suivi de leur exécution. Votre capacité à anticiper les besoins, coordonner les différents interlocuteurs et optimiser les ressources sera essentielle pour garantir le respect des objectifs de livraison.    Vos tâches / responsabilités  • Construire, ajuster et faire valider les programmes directeurs de production, puis contrôler leur bonne exécution.  • Planifier et suivre les capacités industrielles ainsi que les niveaux de stocks, en tenant compte des orientations stratégiques et des contraintes opérationnelles.  • Définir et déployer des indicateurs de performance afin d'assurer le suivi et la communication des activités de planification.  • Veiller à l'application des processus de gestion pour garantir la cohérence, la qualité et la fiabilité des plans établis.  • Intégrer les variations de la demande client ainsi que les évolutions liées aux nouveaux produits et aux nouveaux processus.  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents services de production afin de maintenir les objectifs de livraison.  • Repérer les écarts par rapport aux prévisions, analyser leurs conséquences et proposer des mesures d'ajustement adaptées.****Votre profil :  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur HES ou EPF, avec une spécialisation en logistique de production, ou disposez d'une formation équivalente. (Impératif)  • Vous possédez idéalement une première expérience ou une expérience confirmée dans les domaines de la planification ou de la Supply Chain.  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et savez instaurer des relations professionnelles fondées sur la confiance.  • Vous faites preuve d'écoute, de leadership et d'un excellent esprit de collaboration.  • Votre communication est claire et structurée, et vous savez défendre vos propositions avec pertinence.    Vos compétences  • Bonne maîtrise d'un ERP.  • Bonnes connaissances d'un outil décisionnel.  • Capacité à analyser les données de planification, identifier les écarts et évaluer leurs impacts.  • Aptitude à construire et exploiter des indicateurs de suivi et de performance.  • Excellente capacité de synthèse pour traiter et communiquer les informations essentielles.  • Maîtrise de la gestion des priorités dans un environnement impliquant plusieurs contraintes de production.  • Capacité à coordonner les interfaces entre les services et à proposer des solutions correctives adaptées.    De préférence, être domicilié(e) en Suisse.    Votre expérience dans un autre secteur ?  Vous avez acquis votre expérience en planification au sein d'un autre environnement industriel, tel que l'aéronautique, l'automobile, les industries pharmaceutique et médicale, l'industrie de pointe ou encore le secteur technologique ? Vous avez également évolué dans une organisation Supply Chain différente ? Votre parcours peut tout à fait correspondre à nos attentes !  Votre expérience en gestion des capacités, pilotage des stocks, coordination des flux et suivi des programmes de production peut représenter un véritable atout. Les compétences acquises dans d'autres secteurs industriels peuvent parfaitement être valorisées dans cette fonction.    Nous vous proposons  • L'opportunité d'occuper une fonction transversale au sein d'une division Production.  • Un rôle impliquant des responsabilités directes dans le pilotage des programmes de production et le respect des engagements de livraison.    Intéressé(e) ?  Vous souhaitez mettre vos connaissances en planification industrielle au service d'un environnement de production stimulant et contribuer à la maîtrise des flux et des capacités ?  N'attendez plus pour nous transmettre votre candidature et saisir cette opportunité professionnelle !    ValJob – Votre partenaire pour les métiers de la production et de la Supply Chain.** **jpid1f74e46jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm**

Swiss or EU qualification Experience as a legal professional (lawyer, counsel, advisor or similar) in-house, law firm, or consultancy Relevant professional experience in IT related legal topics, privacy, digital law, AI governance is an advantage  Strong attention to detail and preference for an operational, process-driven legal work. jobs.title: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager
jobs.description: Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. Hoffmann\-La Roche AG in Basel, we are looking for a**Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager****Background:**As part of PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, the Production Enablement function ensures that packaging operations can produce material required by Roche’s clinical trials seamlessly, on\-time, and while optimizing cost/quality.Within Production Enablement the Global CMO Clinical Packaging Management team is responsible for overseeing the manufacturing outsourced portion of the Clinical Packaging portfolio. Contract Manufacturing Site Managers work closely with contract manufacturers (CMOs) worldwide, Procurement, Clinical Planning, Quality and other operations functions to develop and negotiate supply contracts and ensure product delivery from external manufacturing partners with optimal cost, quality and speed. CMO Site Managers also drive the evolution and implementation of new systems and efficient internal and external processes, in support of CMO production and the Pharma Vision to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden between 2020 and 2029\.**Tasks \& Responsibilities:*** You serve as the primary communication bridge between internal clinical stakeholders (such as study managers, clinical planning, and quality) and Roche’s global network of external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).* You monitor external clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly production to ensure everything runs according to plan, while staying flexible and reactive enough to rapidly liaise with CMOs, secure extra capacity, and scale up supply when unexpected events occur—such as sudden spikes in patient enrollment or extended quality deviations.* You create, revise, and oversee Purchase Orders (POs), work orders, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs). Manage pre\- and post\-production orders in SAP, own the budgeting process for CMO variable costs, and review/approve CMO invoices.* You partner with Procurement to negotiate supply agreements and select external packaging vendors, while leading ongoing Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) and tracking KPIs to guarantee predictable, on\-time, and cost\-effective delivery.* You champion internal and external process improvements as the clinical portfolio evolves, represent the CMO function in Clinical Demand \& Operations Planning (CD\&OP), and help define supply strategies for non\-standard product supply chains.**Must Haves:*** You have 5\+ years in the pharmaceutical industry with deep experience in contract manufacturing management or clinical drug manufacturing, backed by a strong understanding of GMP standards.* You have advanced proficiency in SAP S/4HANA and P1S to handle order management, budgeting, and invoicing accurately.* You have a BA/BS degree in a technical, business, or related field (Master’s, PMP, APICS/SCOR, or Six Sigma/Lean certifications are strong pluses).* You are fluent in English (basic German is beneficial), high cultural awareness, and schedule flexibility to collaborate seamlessly across North American (SSF, Mississauga) and European (Switzerland) time zones.**Nice to Have:*** You have direct experience in clinical drug manufacturing, clinical supply chains, or contract manufacturing management is strongly preferred (beyond general pharma or manufacturing experience).* You speak fluent German* You have finished a Master’s degree or any other training or certifications in PMP, Operational Excellence, Six Sigma, or Lean.* You hold APICS and/or SCOR certifications.**What you will be offered:*** An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas* Central location in Basel* Varied job profile* Further training opportunities through temptraining* Working in a dynamic and motivated teamIf you are interested please send your application documents addressed to Ms Marianne Buser.Basel\-Stadt PMP APICS SCOR Six jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Director/Senior Director, Contracts and Transactions--- Director/Senior Director, Contracts and Transactions====================================================**Company Profile**  Genevant is a technology\-focused nucleic acid delivery company with world class platforms, the industry’s most robust and expansive lipid nanoparticle (LNP) patent portfolio, and decades of experience and expertise in nucleic acid drug delivery and development.  We leverage our innovative delivery systems and related technologies to bring new medicines to patients who need them. We do this by selectively collaborating with leading pharma and biotech companies and fostering a culture of innovation that allows us to maintain our leadership position in the space. If you find that inspiring, we want to work with you!  **Position Summary**  Genevant has an opportunity for an experienced, practical and commercially minded Director/Senior Director, Contracts and Transactions, to join our Legal team. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO), this role will provide legal and transactional support across the organization, with a particular focus on research and development\-related contracts and technology licenses and collaborations. The ideal candidate will thrive working independently to manage and execute on the day\-to\-day contracting required to keep a biopharma business moving, with the ability to grow into a leadership role for complex business negotiations.  The successful candidate will work closely with the CLO, senior leadership, Business Development, R\&D, Procurement, Finance, and other functional leaders and is comfortable participating in and guiding executive level business/legal discussions. The position is available at our office in Basel, Switzerland, and will work collaboratively with our other offices in Canada (Vancouver) and the United States (Boston).  **Responsibilities:*** Draft, review, negotiate and otherwise manage the contracting process for a wide variety of contracts, including research and development\-related agreements, software licenses and other G\&A agreements, to align with Genevant’s objectives.* Support the CLO and other members of senior leadership and grow into a leadership role in the negotiation and preparation of complex technology licenses and collaborations.* Maintain a well functioning contract management system.* Support contract lifecycle management, including tracking agreements, renewals, amendments, extension and key dates.* Act as a trusted legal business partner who provides practical, business\-oriented legal advice and explains complex legal issues in clear, understandable terms.* Help internal teams understand contractual commitments, risks, and negotiation priorities.* Manage other legal\-related responsibilities as assigned by the CLO.**Requirements, Knowledge, skills, and abilities:*** Juris Doctor from a recognized law school.* 2\-6 years of relevant experience in\-house / law firm experience in a contracts or general corporate role, preferably within the life sciences industry.* Experience with complex pharma collaborations is a plus.* Strong communication and executive presence, with credibility at the senior leadership level.* Proven experience in contract negotiation and management, with the ability to lead the process independently end\-to\-end.* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in fast\-paced, dynamic environments.* Strong business acumen with sound judgment in integrating legal advice with business objectives.* Admitted to practice law in Switzerland and in good standing with the competent cantonal Bar Association.* Need to interact with colleagues in Eastern Time Zone (6\-hour time difference) and Pacific Time Zone (9\-hour time difference); may require worktime travel may be required.**Benefits \& Compensation**  We’ve worked to create an environment at Genevant that makes our people feel empowered, supported and appreciated so they can focus on doing incredible work that can change the future. To that end, we offer competitive salaries, performance bonus opportunity, good social benefits as well as the opportunity to work on a cooperative corporate culture, flexible working time, remote position and generous vacation package.![Genevant Sciences GmbH]()* Genevant Sciences GmbH  Viaduktstrasse 8  4051 Basel*jid6716c41jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description: Legal CounselPurpose of the role Serve as the primary legal advisor to VAT’s global Supply Chain and Procurement organization, providing pragmatic and commercially focused legal support across the entire supplier relationship lifecycle. The role supports VAT in securing reliable, competitive and legally robust supply arrangements while identifying and managing contractual, commercial and compliance risks. It acts as a business partner to Supply Chain, enabling commercially sound decisions rather than merely providing contract review.Responsibilities:  *  Act as the primary Legal &amp; Compliance contact for Global Supply Chain Management and Procurement, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice across the supplier relationship lifecycle  *  Draft, review and negotiate international supply-chain contracts, including master supply agreements, purchasing terms, long-term and capacity agreements, consignment and inventory arrangements, tooling, logistics, services, development agreements and NDAs  *  Advise on key contractual and commercial matters, including pricing, forecasts, volume and purchase commitments, capacity, delivery, lead times, quality, warranty, liability, indemnities, intellectual property, termination and continuity of supply  *  Support strategic sourcing, supplier selection, dual-sourcing, localization, outsourcing and other strategic Supply Chain initiatives  *  Advise on critical supplier situations and manage related claims and disputes, including shortages, capacity constraints, price increases, delivery failures, quality issues, supplier distress, breach notices, contractual remedies, settlements and termination  *  Protect VAT’s intellectual property, know-how, drawings, specifications, tooling, equipment and materials, and advise on relevant supply-chain compliance matters, including anti-corruption, competition law, sanctions and export controls, responsible sourcing and supplier compliance requirements  *  Develop and maintain standard agreements, contractual fallback positions and procurement playbooks, and provide practical contracting training to Supply Chain and ProcurementQualifications:   *  Law degree from a recognized university; bar admission is an advantage  *  Ideally 5–8+ years of relevant legal experience gained in-house and/or with a commercial law firm  *  Strong experience in international B2B commercial contracts, supplier negotiations and cross-border matters  *  Experience supporting Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Operations  *  Experience in the semiconductor, semiconductor equipment, advanced manufacturing, machinery, automotive or comparable technology industry is strongly preferred  *  Good understanding of contractual intellectual-property protection; experience with complex supplier disputes and critical supply situations is an advantage  *  Fluent English and German with excellent drafting and negotiation skills; other languages are advantageousKey Competencies:  *  Strong commercial judgment and ability to balance legal risk with operational and business requirements  *  Excellent negotiation and contract-drafting skills  *  Pragmatic, solution-oriented and able to provide clear recommendations under time pressure  *  Strong ownership and ability to independently lead complex supplier matters  *  Ability to build trusted relationships with Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering and Quality  *  Comfortable operating in an international, cross-functional and technology-driven environment; high ethical standards and integritySuccess in the RoleSuccess means that Legal is recognized as a proactive Supply Chain business partner that helps VAT secure supply, protect its technology and commercial interests, manage supplier risks early and establish robust, scalable contractual standards across the global supplier base.

Sales Representative
====================

**Introduction de la société**

Longines \- famous for the elegance of its timepieces \- is a member of the Swatch Group Ltd, the world's leading manufacturer of horological products. Based in Saint\-Imier, Switzerland since 1832, Longines watchmakers enjoy an expertise steeped in tradition, elegance and performance. With generations of experience as Official Timekeeper of World Championships and as a partner of international sports federations, Longines has created lasting and durable links to the world of sport.

**Description du poste**

For our Zurich Boutique, we are seeking a Sales Representative (60%) to join our team. This position requires fixed availability on Fridays and Saturdays.

Provide exceptional customer service to all boutique clients. Sell and promote all boutique products to end consumers. Achieve all sales objectives and contribute to the boutique's overall goals.

In this role, your main tasks will be to :

Sales

* Welcome and serve all customers with a friendly attitude, offering a comprehensive and memorable experience
* Develop familiarity with the product range, both past and present, to provide customers with detailed and accurate information
* Maintain a thorough understanding of the features of watches and other brand products
* Offer reliable information to customers regarding sales and customer service inquiries
* Assist in the presentation of merchandise according to guidelines
* Contribute to achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets
* Provide exceptional customer service across all channels, including email, phone, and in\-person interactions


Security

* Assist in controlling stock shrinkage and losses through careful handling and attentive actions within the boutique
* Adhere to administrative policies and procedures, particularly regarding cash handling
* Maintain general awareness of product security and potential risks
* Follow company procedures for opening and closing the store
* Ensure proper handling of all deliveries


Cash Handling and Payment Operations

* Manage all transactions responsibly and securely
* Perform cashier duties, including payment processing and handling international currencies
* Ensure accurate cash handling, credit card processing, and related tasks


Store Maintenance

* Ensure the boutique always remains clean and presentable, including the sales floor and back office
* Maintain awareness of health and safety standards
* Ensure proper implementation of visual merchandising standards


Communication

* Comply with company policies and regulations
* Attend briefings as instructed by supervisors
* Present yourself professionally to both customers and colleagues
* Handle international clients with an understanding of their customs and culture


Product Knowledge

* Regularly participate in training sessions
* Take responsibility for proactively learning about new products and applying training effectively
* Provide customers with thorough product knowledge


**Profil**

Vocational training in sales (CFC) with a few years of experience in luxury boutiques, ideally in watchmaking

Preferably from a watchmaking/jewelry background

Experience working with an international clientele

A passion for luxury retail or watches, with a natural enthusiasm for the products

**Compétences requises**

Strong sales and negotiation skills

Business acumen and customer\-oriented mindset

Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Excellent interpersonal skills

Strong planning and organizational abilities

Flexible with working hours

 

**Langues**

Fluency in German and English is essential

Knowledge of other languages is an advantage

**Lieu de travail**

Zürich

**Personne de contact**

Julie Heimann

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %---PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %========================================================================Curious about the roles of households in the new Swiss Local Electricity Community regulation and how they evolve at the interface of politics and the energy sector? Then you've come to the right place!PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %======================================================================== **What you will be responsible for**  Since January 2026, so\-called Local Electricity Communities (LEG) enable Swiss households to buy and sell PV electricity within their neighbourhood. Whether LEGs will become established and make a substantial contribution to Switzerland's energy targets remains to be seen in the coming years. This is being investigated by the SFOE\-funded research project "LEAP" lead by the ZHAW in partnership with the University of Lausanne and Swisspower AG. The PhD position advertised focuses on the evolving roles, expectations and experiences of the key stakeholders in the LEGs (households, LEG service providers and energy suppliers), with a particular focus on the households who join an LEG.* Work towards a PhD (co\-supervised by the University of Lausanne) within the LEAP project* Plan and carry out surveys and interviews for your data collection* Analyse and present findings in the form of academic publications* Collaborate with the project team and beyond (e.g., communicating with partners, presenting research results at scientific conferences, etc.)* Provide ad hoc support to the Institute of Innovation \& Entrepreneurship in teaching (e.g. supervising student projects) or other research projects **What makes you a great fit*** You hold a an excellent Master's degree in Management, Environmental Sciences, Social Sciences, or similarly fitting field (e.g., renewable energy).* In addition to fluency in and/or French (a requirement for data collection), you have an excellent command of written and spoken English.* You have solid knowledge in quantitative and/or qualitative research methods (e.g. designing and analysing surveys or semi\-structured interviews).* You have a strong interest to do societally and scientifically relevant work.* You enjoy independence and autonomy, and can take responsibility for your own PhD thesis, as well as for the related project objectives. Nonetheless, you know the value of collaboration and are keen to contribute to the exchange of ideas and results with the project's research and practice partners.* Your have a clear and open communication style, and bring curiosity and enthusiasm to the team.* Practical experience in interdisciplinary or transdisciplinary project settings, as well as in the field of energy (particularly regarding energy communities), would be a welcome addition to your profile. **About your workplace**The ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences is the largest university of applied sciences in \-speaking Switzerland, with around 15,000 students, more than 11,000 continuing education participants and over 3,700 employees.  We are committed to building diverse teams in order to promote equality and inclusion. We offer a flexible working environment that can be adapted to your individual circumstances. **School of Management and Law**The ZHAW School of Management and Law (SML) is one of the largest business schools in Switzerland with around 9,500 students. It is the only university of applied sciences in the country that is included in renowned rankings published by the business newspaper "Financial Times" and is accredited by AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA \- labels for high quality standards in teaching, research and further education. The internationally recognized bachelor's and master's degree programs, cooperative PhD programs and the numerous continuing education offerings are scientifically sound, interdisciplinary and practice oriented. The SML maintains numerous collaborations with over 190 selected partner universities worldwide.The conducts research, teaches and provides consultancy in the key areas of business innovation, innovation systems and entrepreneurship. One of our key areas of focus is the transformation of the energy system, in close collaboration with various stakeholders at the interface of research, politics and society.  **Any questions? You'll find the answers here!** **Do you have any questions about the application process?**Recruiting Assistant **Do you have any questions about the advertised vacancy?**WemyssProject Lead ![ Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften]()*** ![ Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften]()***jid1e87062jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

You will also act as a key contact for regulatory authorities and take responsibility for batch review and release activities.This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing biotechnology company preparing for potential commercialization, with the chance to help establish and develop its European Quality function.### About the customer:* **Location:** Luzern, Switzerland* **Employment:** Permanent, full\-time* **Start Date:** ASAP, latest March 2027* **Working Model:** Hybrid* **Reporting :** Head of Quality### Requirements:* Lead Quality Assurance activities across Switzerland and the EU, ensuring compliance with GMP, GDP and applicable pharmaceutical regulations.* Act as the main Quality contact for regulatory authorities, including Swissmedic and EMA, as well as external stakeholders and customers.* Maintain inspection readiness and ensure compliance with applicable operating licence requirements.* Oversee external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), including quality\-related activities, supplier oversight and site audits.* Develop, maintain and improve the Quality Management System (QMS), including GxP training, local quality documentation and regulatory requirements.* Coordinate Quality Management Reviews, monitor quality processes and implement continuous improvements.* Perform batch review and release activities for clinical and commercial medicinal products.* Review, manage and approve deviations, change controls and other quality\-related documentation.* Exercise independent QRP/FvP decision\-making authority in accordance with Swiss medicinal product legislation, including the Medicinal Products Licensing Ordinance (MPLO), Swissmedic requirements and applicable cantonal regulations.* Independently determine the appropriate disposition of rejected, recalled, falsified or expired medicinal products.* Collaborate closely with global Quality, manufacturing and regulatory teams to support product development, clinical activities and commercial readiness.* Support the gradual development of the Quality function in Switzerland and Europe as the business expands.### Competences:* Bachelor's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Medicine, Biology, Microbiology or a related scientific discipline; Master's or PhD advantageous.* **Licensed QRP/FvP qualification**, with relevant Swiss and/or EU Qualified Person experience.* 10\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, Quality Assurance or Quality Control, including several years in a senior, supervisory or QA/QP position.* Strong knowledge of Swiss and EU GMP/GDP regulations, pharmaceutical quality systems and regulatory compliance.* understanding of Swissmedic requirements, with familiarity with FDA regulations, ICH guidelines and ISO standards.* Proven experience in batch certification/release, manufacturing processes, validation and pharmaceutical product development.* Experience with regulatory inspections, compliance audits and quality risk management.* understanding of clinical trial operations, drug development, laboratory testing and commercial pharmaceutical activities.* Previous experience overseeing external manufacturing partners and supporting QMS development is highly advantageous.* Strong project management, analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make independent decisions in a fast\-paced environment.* Excellent English communication skills; is an advantage.* Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe and collaborate with international teams.![Swisslinx AG]()* Swisslinx AG  Löwenstrasse 29  8001 Zürich*jidbf70d3bjm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI - Direction générale --- Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI \\- Direction générale ========================================================== \*\*Description de l'entreprise\*\* \*\*A l'Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève\*\* Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d'un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l'aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l'asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d'intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l'isolement des seniors. Nous sommes plus de 1'600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40' 000 personnes. En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance. Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l'inclusion, nous valorisons l'intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l'innovation et favorisons la prise d'initiative et l'expérimentation. \*\*Description du poste\*\* \*\*Votre mission\*\* À la tête de l'institution, vous donnez le cap et créez les conditions permettant à l'Hospice général de remplir durablement ses missions de service public. En lien étroit avec le Conseil d'administration, ainsi qu'avec le département de tutelle, vous traduisez les orientations stratégiques en priorités institutionnelles et veillez à leur réalisation. Vous conduisez la Direction générale, composée notamment de la Direction générale adjointe et du Secrétariat général, et vous vous appuyez sur le Comité de direction pour assurer la cohérence, la performance et la capacité d'adaptation de l'ensemble de l'institution, pour apporter une réponse adaptée et coordonnée aux besoins des personnes qui font appel à l'Hospice général. Vous représentez l'Hospice général auprès des autorités cantonales, de ses partenaires et des principales parties prenantes. Vous portez sa mission, ses positions, ses valeurs et ses enjeux dans un environnement social, politique et institutionnel en évolution permanente. \*\*Vos principales responsabilités\*\* Vous aurez notamment pour responsabilité de: \* élaborer les orientations stratégiques de l'Hospice général avec le Conseil d'administration, ainsi qu'avec le département de tutelle, et en assurer la mise en œuvre ; \* vous appuyer sur le Secrétariat général pour garantir une gouvernance solide, le fonctionnement des instances, la maîtrise des risques et la qualité des dispositifs de contrôle ; \* assurer, avec la Direction générale adjointe, le pilotage global de l'activité, la cohérence entre les directions et la mise en œuvre des décisions institutionnelles ; \* animer une Direction générale et un Comité de direction capables d'arbitrer, de prioriser et d'agir collectivement ; \* conduire l'institution dans une logique de service public, de qualité des prestations, d'efficience et de responsabilité ; \* anticiper les évolutions sociales, politiques, légales, économiques et technologiques susceptibles d'influencer ses missions ; \* créer les conditions permettant aux directions et aux équipes d'exercer leurs responsabilités avec autonomie, exigence et coopération ; \* garantir une allocation maîtrisée des ressources humaines, financières, immobilières et numériques ; \* entretenir une relation de confiance et de transparence avec le Conseil d'administration et ses comités ; \* représenter l'Hospice général dans ses relations avec le Conseil d'État, le Grand conseil, le département de tutelle, les communes, les institutions partenaires et les autres acteurs\\-trices du réseau ; \* porter la parole de l'institution dans les situations stratégiques, sensibles ou de crise ; \* accompagner les transformations nécessaires tout en préservant la continuité et la qualité des prestations aux personnes accompagnées. \*\*Qualifications\*\* \*\*Votre profil\*\* Vous disposez d'une formation universitaire supérieure ou d'un parcours jugé équivalent, complétée par une formation en management, gouvernance publique ou conduite d'organisation. Vous pouvez vous prévaloir d'une expérience confirmée de direction générale ou de direction exécutive au sein d'une organisation complexe, idéalement dans le secteur public, parapublic ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé. Votre parcours démontre votre capacité à : \* définir une vision et la traduire en décisions et résultats concrets ; \* piloter une organisation de grande taille et des transformations complexes ; \* travailler avec un Conseil d'administration et dans un environnement de gouvernance publique ; \* comprendre les enjeux politiques et institutionnels sans perdre de vue les réalités opérationnelles ; \* arbitrer et décider dans des situations comportant des intérêts ou contraintes parfois divergents ; \* fédérer des cadres dirigeant·es et développer une véritable responsabilité collective ; \* établir des relations solides avec des partenaires institutionnels et politiques ; \* communiquer avec clarté, y compris dans des contextes sensibles ; \* conjuguer exigence de performance, qualité du service public et attention portée aux personnes. Votre leadership repose sur la clarté, la confiance et la responsabilisation. Vous savez écouter et associer, mais également décider lorsque la situation l'exige. Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement exposé, où les décisions doivent pouvoir être expliquées, assumées et mises en œuvre. Une connaissance approfondie du fonctionnement des institutions publiques genevoises et des politiques sociales constitue un atout important. \*\*Informations supplémentaires\*\* \*\*Ce que nous vous proposons\*\* Une fonction au cœur des enjeux sociaux du canton de Genève, avec la possibilité d'agir concrètement sur l'évolution d'une institution publique majeure. Vous rejoindrez une organisation engagée dans une transformation de son fonctionnement, de ses pratiques et de ses outils, avec une ambition claire : renforcer son impact auprès des personnes accompagnées tout en développant une culture de collaboration, de responsabilité et d'amélioration continue. Taux d'activité : 100% Type de contrat : CDI Entrée en fonction : A convenir Délai de postulation : Le ou la directeur\\-trice général\\-e est nommé\\-e par le Conseil d'administration de l'Hospice général. Si vous êtes intéressé.e par cette opportunité professionnelle et que vous répondez aux exigences du poste, vous êtes invité.e à postuler à l'adresse Merci de bien attacher votre CV et votre lettre de motivation en un seul document PDF. En raison de l'importance stratégique de cette fonction, l'Hospice général a décidé de collaborer avec un partenaire externe spécialisé dans le recrutement de profils de cadres. M. Raphael Asseo (RaphaelAsseo@ et M. Anthony Adam (AnthonyAdam@ de Page Executive se tiennent à votre disposition pour répondre à vos questions. jobs.title: Planificateur PDP (H/F)
jobs.description: **Vous êtes à la recherche d’un nouveau challenge ? ValJob, active depuis 1995 dans le placement et les services en Ressources Humaines, est une société suisse leader, reconnue et appréciée pour la qualité de ses services et la haute performance de ses collaborateurs. Nous recherchons pour l’un de nos clients le profil suivant :****Planificateur PDP (H/F)**  **Votre mission :**  Votre prochain défi  Vous avez une solide compréhension des enjeux de planification industrielle et souhaitez contribuer à la performance d'un environnement de production exigeant ?  Pour accompagner notre client dans le développement et le pilotage de ses activités, ValJob recherche un(e) Planificateur PDP (H/F) pour sa division Production.  Au cœur des flux industriels, vous serez responsable de la construction des programmes directeurs de production et du suivi de leur exécution. Votre capacité à anticiper les besoins, coordonner les différents interlocuteurs et optimiser les ressources sera essentielle pour garantir le respect des objectifs de livraison.  Vos tâches / responsabilités  • Construire, ajuster et faire valider les programmes directeurs de production, puis contrôler leur bonne exécution.  • Planifier et suivre les capacités industrielles ainsi que les niveaux de stocks, en tenant compte des orientations stratégiques et des contraintes opérationnelles.  • Définir et déployer des indicateurs de performance afin d'assurer le suivi et la communication des activités de planification.  • Veiller à l'application des processus de gestion pour garantir la cohérence, la qualité et la fiabilité des plans établis.  • Intégrer les variations de la demande client ainsi que les évolutions liées aux nouveaux produits et aux nouveaux processus.  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents services de production afin de maintenir les objectifs de livraison.  • Repérer les écarts par rapport aux prévisions, analyser leurs conséquences et proposer des mesures d'ajustement adaptées.**Votre profil :**  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur HES ou EPF, avec une spécialisation en logistique de production, ou disposez d'une formation équivalente. (Impératif)  • Vous possédez idéalement une première expérience ou une expérience confirmée dans les domaines de la planification ou de la Supply Chain.  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et savez instaurer des relations professionnelles fondées sur la confiance.  • Vous faites preuve d'écoute, de leadership et d'un excellent esprit de collaboration.  • Votre communication est claire et structurée, et vous savez défendre vos propositions avec pertinence.  Vos compétences  • Bonne maîtrise d'un ERP.  • Bonnes connaissances d'un outil décisionnel.  • Capacité à analyser les données de planification, identifier les écarts et évaluer leurs impacts.  • Aptitude à construire et exploiter des indicateurs de suivi et de performance.  • Excellente capacité de synthèse pour traiter et communiquer les informations essentielles.  • Maîtrise de la gestion des priorités dans un environnement impliquant plusieurs contraintes de production.  • Capacité à coordonner les interfaces entre les services et à proposer des solutions correctives adaptées.  De préférence, être domicilié(e) en Suisse.  Votre expérience dans un autre secteur ?  Vous avez acquis votre expérience en planification au sein d'un autre environnement industriel, tel que l'aéronautique, l'automobile, les industries pharmaceutique et médicale, l'industrie de pointe ou encore le secteur technologique ? jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, Reinforcement Learning & Large-Scale Model Training
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: AI Research Engineer, Reinforcement Learning &amp; Large-Scale Model Training--- AI Research Engineer, Reinforcement Learning \& Large\-Scale Model Training===========================================================================Full\-time (100%), permanent  Location: Zurich, Switzerland  Employer: Tufa Labs AG  Start Date: 1 March 2027 or by agreementAbout Tufa Labs---------------Tufa Labs is building frontier AI systems with a focus on abstract reasoning, scalable model training, and reinforcement learning. We work on problems at the intersection of foundation models, reasoning benchmarks, distributed systems, and scientific experimentation. Our goal is to develop methods that improve the reasoning capabilities of AI systems while building the infrastructure required to train and evaluate them at scale.We are looking for an AI Research Engineer who enjoys moving fluidly between research and systems engineering: designing experiments, training models, analysing results, and building the tooling that makes large\-scale research possible.The Role--------You will contribute directly to our research on abstract reasoning benchmarks such as ARC\-AGI and related environments, develop pre\-training and reinforcement learning approaches for large language models, and improve the infrastructure used to train, evaluate, and deploy those models across GPU clusters. This role combines hands\-on research with practical engineering. A typical week may involve implementing a new reinforcement learning method, running large\-scale experiments, designing evaluation suites for reasoning tasks, profiling distributed training bottlenecks, or extending internal tooling used by researchers across the company.Responsibilities----------------* Conduct research on abstract reasoning and generalisation in AI systems, including work related to ARC\-AGI and successor benchmarks.* Design, implement, and evaluate novel training methods for large language models.* Develop reinforcement learning pipelines for post\-training and alignment.* Run large\-scale pre\-training, fine\-tuning, and evaluation experiments.* Build and maintain infrastructure for distributed training on GPU clusters.* Improve reliability, monitoring, scheduling, and observability of research workloads.* Collaborate with researchers and engineers to convert ideas into reproducible research systems.Essential Qualifications------------------------* Degree in computer science or at least 5 years of equivalent professional experience in Machine Learning or a related field.* Experience training, fine\-tuning, or evaluating large language models.* Practical experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or related optimization methods.* Experience working with distributed systems and multi\-GPU training environments.* Ability to independently design and execute research experiments.Desirable Qualifications------------------------* Experience operating GPU clusters and associated infrastructure.* Contributions to machine learning research, open\-source projects, or competitive benchmark efforts.* Strong interest in reasoning, abstraction, program synthesis, planning, or AGI evaluation.What We Offer-------------* Permanent full\-time position.* Opportunity to work on frontier research problems in reasoning and model training.* High degree of autonomy and ownership.* Access to substantial compute resources and research infrastructure.* Small, technically ambitious team with rapid decision\-making and minimal bureaucracy.* Opportunity to help shape the future direction of the company’s research agenda.To apply, please send your CV and a short description of relevant work.![Tufa Labs AG]()* Tufa Labs AG  6300 Zug*jid52d6cc7jm jit1147jm jiy26jm
