jobs.title: Head of HR M&A
jobs.description: Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.At Lonza, we are looking for a Head of HR M&A to lead the HR agenda across our global portfolio of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, restructurings, and other strategic corporate transactions. This highly visible leadership role will own the end-to-end people agenda, from early-stage exploration and due diligence through transaction execution, integration or separation, and post-close stabilization.Working closely with Corporate M&A, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, and the broader HR organization, you will shape the people strategy for complex transactions, lead cross-functional HR deal teams, and ensure successful execution against the overall deal strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, bringing deep HR M&A expertise to identify and mitigate people risks, accelerate decision-making, and enable successful value creation.Key Responsibilities:- Own the global HR M&A portfolio, setting strategy, priorities, governance, resources, and accountability across multiple concurrent transactions and strategic corporate programs- Lead and develop the HR M&A team, ensuring effective execution across acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, restructurings, and other complex transactions- Act as the senior HR deal lead for key transactions, from early-stage exploration and due diligence through close, integration or separation, and post-close stabilization- Provide strategic HR expertise on deal strategy, people risks, workforce implications, organizational design, employee experience, and value creation opportunities- Lead and coordinate cross-functional HR workstreams spanning Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Services, Digital HR, HR systems, payroll, benefits, talent, and employee communications- Partner with senior stakeholders across Corporate M&A, Strategy, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, and HR to drive alignment, resolve complex issues, and enable timely decisions- Oversee HR integration and separation activities, including workforce transitions, business continuity, HR services, systems, employee experience, and delivery against transaction objectives- Lead or oversee HR-related negotiations, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), cost modelling, external advisors, and relevant transaction documentation- Own portfolio-level risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, timelines, and escalations while ensuring compliance with employment law, regulatory, works council, union, and consultation requirements- Provide clear recommendations and executive-level reporting to senior leadership and steering committees, ensuring HR delivery supports successful transaction execution, performance, and value realizationRequired Qualifications: - 15+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant depth in HR M&A, ideally gained through consulting, project-driven environments, and/or an in-house M&A function within a multinational organization- Proven experience leading HR workstreams across complex acquisitions, divestitures, integrations, separations, restructurings, or other strategic corporate transactions- Broad expertise across HR M&A, Total Rewards, HR Operations, HR systems, workforce transitions, and complex cross-functional programme delivery- Strong understanding of the full M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, transaction planning, integration/separation, TSAs, people-related risk management, and post-close stabilization- Demonstrated ability to lead multiple complex transactions simultaneously and manage international, cross-functional project teams and external advisors- Exceptional business and financial acumen, with the ability to translate transaction strategy into pragmatic HR priorities, execution plans, and value creation opportunities- Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior leadership and external stakeholders- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, project management, and execution capabilities, with the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations and executive-level materials- Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, highly confidential, complex matrix environments, demonstrating sound judgment, resilience, adaptability, and a high degree of independenceEvery day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Head of Group Reporting
jobs.description: **Über WebPros**WebPros unterstützt Unternehmen weltweit mit innovativen Lösungen in den Bereichen Webhosting, Billing-Automatisierung, Infrastruktur, Serververwaltung und Online-Marketing. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2017 sind wir rasant zu einem globalen Marktführer gewachsen und haben unser starkes Portfolio um branchenprägende Marken wie cPanel & WHM, Plesk, WHMCS, SolusVM, XOVI, SocialBee, Sitejet und Comet Backup erweitert.Heute betreiben wir mit unseren Lösungen über 85 Millionen Websites auf mehr als 900 000 Servern weltweit. Dahinter steht ein Team von über 650 engagierten Fachleuten auf mehreren Kontinenten. Bei WebPros legen wir Wert auf Flexibilität, Eigenständigkeit und Work-Life-Balance. Je nach Land und Rolle bieten wir Remote- und Hybrid-Arbeitsmodelle an. Ob du lieber mitten im Trubel einer Stadt arbeitest oder im ruhigen Homeoffice: Wir ermöglichen unseren Teams, sich zu entfalten, und bleiben dank unserer ausgeprägten Zusammenarbeitskultur trotzdem eng verbunden.**Deine Rolle**Wir erstellen den Abschluss für eine Gruppe mit über 10 Marken und vielen Rechtseinheiten in mehreren Währungen, die grösstenteils durch Zukäufe entstanden ist. Heute hängt der Abschluss zu stark von ein paar wenigen Personen ab, die wissen, wo alles liegt. Diese Rolle soll das ändern: Du verantwortest die Konzernkonsolidierung, die gesetzliche Berichterstattung und die Revision durch KPMG und machst aus dem Abschluss einen dokumentierten, weitgehend automatisierten Prozess, dem auch eine externe Prüferin oder ein externer Prüfer folgen kann. Das ist wichtig, weil wir eine rückwirkend angepasste Dreijahreshistorie brauchen, die einer Due Diligence standhält, falls wir einmal eine Transaktion durchführen. Du arbeitest selbst tief in den Zahlen und führst unseren IFRS-Fachspezialisten.**Hauptaufgaben**Abschluss und KI: Führe den Konzernabschluss konsequent KI-gestützt: Automatisiere Abstimmungen, Reconciliations und Abweichungskommentare mit menschlicher Kontrolle des Ergebnisses. Nutze KI für fachliche Recherche, Memo-Entwürfe und die Vorbereitung von Prüfungsnachweisen, damit das Team seine Zeit für Beurteilung statt für manuelle Kontrollen einsetzt.Konsolidierung: Verantworte die Konsolidierung in LucaNet, die Eliminierung konzerninterner Transaktionen sowie die Konzern- und Einzelabschlüsse, damit das Unternehmen eine einzige verlässliche Datenbasis hat, die aufgeht.Berichterstattung: Liefere die monatliche, gesetzliche und Investorenberichterstattung termingerecht und automatisiere den Abschluss überall dort, wo es die Kontrolle stärkt, damit Geschäftsleitung und Investoren Zahlen erhalten, auf die sie sich verlassen können.Revision: Verantworte die Beziehung zu KPMG und die Abwicklung der Revision von der Planung bis zur Freigabe, damit Prüfungen termingerecht und mit wenigen Überraschungen abgeschlossen werden.IFRS: Steuere die fachliche IFRS-Arbeit und die Memos (IFRS 15, IFRS 18, IAS 38) und verantworte die IFRS-18-Bereitschaft inklusive Sonderposten und MPM-Darstellung, damit wir bereit sind, bevor der Standard gilt.Exit-Bereitschaft: Erstelle und verantworte die rückwirkend angepassten Zahlen der letzten drei Jahre sowie die QoE-/FDD-Unterlagen, damit die Historie glaubwürdig ist, wenn die Berater eines Käufers sie prüfen.Prozesse und Menschen: Ersetze die Abhängigkeit von Einzelpersonen durch dokumentierte, wiederholbare Prozesse und Kontrollen auf einem Niveau, das einer Due Diligence standhält. Führe den Fachspezialisten, setze Ziele und fördere Eigenverantwortung, damit die Funktion auch ohne einzelne Schlüsselpersonen funktioniert.**Deine Qualifikationen****Muss-Kriterien**Konzernkonsolidierung: Erfahrung in der Konzernberichterstattung und Konsolidierung auf Senior-Niveau in einer Gruppe mit mehreren Rechtseinheiten und Währungen.Revision und IFRS: Du hast eine Konzernrevision von Anfang bis Ende verantwortet, verfügst über fundierte IFRS- und Statutory-Kenntnisse und hast die Beziehung zu einer Big-4-Prüfgesellschaft geführt.Konsolidierungstools: Praktische Erfahrung mit einem Konsolidierungstool wie LucaNet oder einem vergleichbaren System.Transaktionserfahrung: Du hast eine Revision im Rahmen einer Transaktion oder der Transaktionsvorbereitung durchlaufen.Aufgebaut, nicht nur betrieben: Du hast eine Berichterstattungsfunktion verbessert oder professionalisiert, nicht nur weitergeführt, und kannst aufzeigen, was sich verändert hat.**Nice-to-haves**Abschluss als ACA / ACCA, Ausbildung in der Big-4-Revision.Erfahrung beim Einbau von KI oder Automatisierung in einen Finanzabschluss, über Excel-Makros hinaus.Praktische Erfahrung speziell mit LucaNet.Umsatzrealisierung für SaaS (IFRS 15) in einer Gruppe mit mehreren Marken.Erstellung von QoE-/FDD-Unterlagen oder Investoren-Reportings.Keines davon ist ein Ausschlusskriterium, wenn die Muss-Kriterien sitzen. Tiefe in Konsolidierung, Revision und technischer Rechnungslegung lässt sich schwerer ersetzen.**Deine Wirkung in den ersten 120 Tagen**30 Tage, ankommen und einarbeiten: Führe zusammen mit dem aktuellen Team einen vollständigen Monatsabschluss in LucaNet durch und halte jeden Schritt fest, der von einer einzelnen Person abhängt. Lies den Management Letter und die offenen Punkte der letzten Revision. Lerne KPMG, den Fachspezialisten und die Finanzansprechpersonen der Einheiten kennen.60 Tage, beitragen und zusammenarbeiten: Übernimm die Verantwortung für den Monatsabschluss und den Berichtskalender. Veröffentliche eine priorisierte Liste der manuellen Schritte mit Verantwortlichen. Bringe eine erste Automatisierung live (eine Abstimmung oder einen Abweichungskommentar) mit menschlicher Kontrolle. Vereinbare Ziele mit dem Fachspezialisten.90 Tage, Verantwortung übernehmen: Leite die Revisionsplanung mit KPMG. Präsentiere deine IFRS-18-Lückenanalyse und den Umsetzungsplan. Dokumentiere den Konsolidierungsprozess so gut, dass ihn jemand anderes durchführen könnte.120 Tage, Wachstum vorantreiben: Liefere einen ersten Entwurf der rückwirkend angepassten Dreijahreszahlen mit einem Plan für das QoE-/FDD-Paket. Hab mehrere Abschlussschritte automatisiert und termingerecht im Griff und zeige der Geschäftsleitung eine klare Liste der verbleibenden Abhängigkeiten von Schlüsselpersonen.**Unsere Kultur**WebPros basiert auf Vielfalt, nicht nur im Grundsatz, sondern von Anfang an. Wir sind durch den Zukauf branchenführender Marken gewachsen und haben so Teams aus über 42 Nationalitäten, über 20 Ländern und über 10 Marken zusammengebracht. Anstatt eine einheitliche Kultur für alle durchzusetzen, begrüssen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven, verschiedene Arbeitsweisen und lokales Fachwissen, um weltweit Innovation voranzutreiben.Wir sind ein vollständig remote arbeitendes Unternehmen, das asynchrone Zusammenarbeit fördert. Transparenz, offene Kommunikation und gemeinsames Lösen von Problemen prägen unsere Arbeitsweise. Ob du das hohe Tempo eines Start-ups bevorzugst oder die Stabilität eines etablierten Produkts: WebPros bietet dir einen dynamischen, sich entwickelnden Karriereweg, den du entsprechend deinen Stärken gestalten kannst.Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives, faires Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich jedes Teammitglied geschätzt, gehört und unterstützt fühlt, denn unsere Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke.**Vergütung und Benefits**Wir sind überzeugt, dass Benefits mehr sind als blosse Extras. Bei WebPros investieren wir in deine Entwicklung, Flexibilität und dein Wohlbefinden, damit du deine beste Arbeit leisten und eine sinnvolle Karriere aufbauen kannst. Wir bemühen uns, allen Teammitgliedern weltweit gleichwertige Benefits zu bieten. Einzelne können je nach Standort abweichen, und die Details klären wir im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses mit dir.Attraktives GehaltRemote-first-Flexibilität: Arbeite von überall in Europa aus (oder hybrid in den verfügbaren Büros).Weiterbildungsbudget: Jährliches Budget für deine persönliche Entwicklung.ÖV-Abo und Essensgutscheine: Standortabhängige Benefits.Ferien: Über 20 Tage Jahresurlaub.Teamkultur: Regelmässige Team- und Firmenevents vor Ort.**Unser Bekenntnis zu einer vielfältigen und inklusiven Kultur**Bei WebPros soll sich jedes Teammitglied darauf freuen, sein ganzes, authentisches Ich in die Arbeit einzubringen. Unsere Stärke liegt in der Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeitenden: Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen treiben Innovation an und machen uns gemeinsam stärker.Wir setzen uns für faire Chancen, faire Bezahlung und faire Unterstützung für alle Mitarbeitenden ein, unabhängig von Identität, Herkunft oder Lebensumständen. Wir pflegen eine Kultur der Zugehörigkeit, des Respekts und der psychologischen Sicherheit, in der sich alle geschätzt und gehört fühlen und ermutigt werden, sinnvoll beizutragen und zu wachsen.

jobs.title: Head of Admissions, Marketing & Experience - AMX
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Admissions, Marketing &amp; Experience - AMX (80% bis 100%)---Das Hochalpine Institut Ftan (HIF) ist ein traditionsreiches Schweizer Internat auf 1?700 m ü. M. mit massgeschneiderten Bildungswegen (zweisprachige Swiss Matura, internationales IGCSE\- \& A\-Level\-Programm), der renommierten HIF Sports Academy und saisonalen Camps. Wir gehören zu Education in Motion (EiM) – einer globalen Bildungsfamilie mit über 12?000 :innen weltweit.Für diese Schlüsselposition suchen wir eine strategisch wie operativ starke Führungspersönlichkeit, die das HIF weltweit positioniert, :innen gewinnt und die gesamte Experience prägt – mit regelmässiger Präsenz in Ftan, Engadin (Schweiz) und gelegentlichen internationalen Reisen.Head of Admissions, Marketing \& Experience \- AMX (80% bis 100%)=================================================================### Deine Mission – das bewegst du bei uns* Globales Enrollment: Strategische Steuerung des gesamten Aufnahmeprozesses für Matura und internationale Bildungsgänge – mit klaren, messbaren Einschreibungs\- und Conversion\-Zielen.* Marktidentifikation \& Entwicklung: Neue Quellmärkte weltweit identifizieren und erschliessen – neben der DACH\-Region, Europa und Asien aktiv auch in den Americas (Nord\- und Südamerika) sowie den Nachfolgestaaten der ehemaligen Sowjetunion / Osteuropa \& Zentralasien.* Agentennetzwerk: Ein tragfähiges internationales Agenten\- und Beraternetzwerk (Educational Consultants) aufbauen, mitbringen und/oder betreuen.* Marketing\-Mix analog \& digital: Integrierte Kampagnen konzipieren und steuern – Bildungsmessen, Events, Print, Roadshows sowie Website, SEO/SEA, Social Media, Content, PR und E\-Mail\-Marketing.* KI im Marketing der digitalen Ökonomie: Künstliche Intelligenz und moderne Digital\-Tools (Content\-Erstellung, Personalisierung, Automation, prädiktive Analysen) wirkungsvoll und zukunftsorientiert einsetzen.* Familienberatung: Eltern und Kinder persönlich, empathisch und kompetent durch den gesamten Entscheidungsprozess begleiten (Admissions\-Counselling, Campus\-Visits, Schnuppertage).* Experience\-Qualität: Die Qualität aller Berührungspunkte vom ersten Kontakt über Open Days bis zum Onboarding verantworten; enge Verzahnung mit den HIF\-Camps und der Sports Academy.* Teamführung \& CRM: Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des AMX\-Teams; Ownership für das CRM (HubSpot), PipelineSteuerung und regelmässiges Enrollment\-Forecasting mit der Schulleitung und EiM.### **Das bringst du mit – dein Profil*** Mehrjährige, nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in Marketing und Admissions (idealerweise im internationalen Schul\- oder Premiumbildungsumfeld); relevanter Hochschulabschluss.* Souveräne Beherrschung des gesamten Marketing\-Mix (analog \& digital) und tiefes Verständnis der digitalen Ökonomie.* Praktische Vertrautheit mit dem Einsatz von KI im Marketing und Offenheit für neue Technologien.* Freude und Fingerspitzengefühl bei der persönlichen Beratung von Eltern und Kindern. ? Nachgewiesene Stärke in der Marktidentifikation; idealerweise ein bestehendes internationales Agentennetzwerk, das du einbringst – oder das Talent, dieses schnell und nachhaltig aufzubauen.* Internationale Orientierung; Erfahrung/Kontakte in den Americas und/oder den Nachfolgestaaten der ehemaligen Sowjetunion sind ein grosses Plus.* Führungserfahrung, Teamplayer\-Mentalität und strukturierte Arbeitsweise; versierter Umgang mit CRM\-Systemen (HubSpot) und Digital\-Marketing\-Tools.* Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch (inkl. Schweizerdeutsch\-Verständnis) und Englisch (C1/C2\); Russisch oder Spanisch sind ein starker Vorteil.* Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen internationalen und nationalen Reisen sowie regelmässiger Präsenz auf unserem Campus in Ftan### **Was wir bieten*** Strategische Schlüsselrolle mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum und sichtbarem Impact in einer globalen Gruppe (EiM: 12?000\+ :innen).* Einzigartiger, familiärer Campus im Engadin – gesunder alpiner Lebensstil, Natur und Sport direkt vor der Tür.* Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung (Präsenz in Ftan, Remote\-Möglichkeiten, Reisephasen).* Schulplätze für deine deine eigenen Kinder (Matura oder IGCSE/A\-Level); Rabatte auf ÖV und Ski\-/Bergbahn\-Abonnemente, Nutzung der Sportanlagen### **So bewirbst du dich**Bitte ein vollständiges Dossier mit Lohnvorstellungen per E\-Mail einreichen an (z. Hd. Head of Admissions, Marketing \& Customer Experience)### **Bewerbungen von Drittstaatenangehörigen (nicht EU / EFTA)**Bitte beachte, dass Arbeitsbewilligungen für Drittstaatenangehörige (z. B. aus dem Vereinigten Königreich) ein längeres Verfahren und strengere Vorgaben erfordern als für EU\-/EFTA\-Bürger:innen. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen, bevorzugen jedoch Kandidat:innen mit bestehender Schweizer Aufenthaltsbewilligung oder einem EU\-/EFTA\-Pass.### **Safeguarding \& Professionalität**Das HIF setzt sich aktiv für den Schutz und das Wohlergehen von Kindern und Jugendlichen ein. Alle Mitarbeitenden sind verpflichtet, klare professionelle Grenzen sowie hohe Verhaltensstandards einzuhalten. Anstellungen erfolgen vorbehaltlich gründlicher Referenzprüfungen, Background\-Checks und weiterer Abklärungen gemäss internationaler Kinderschutzrichtlinien. ![Hochalpines Institut Ftan]()* Hochalpines Institut Ftan  Frau HIF Jobs  Recruiting** ![Hochalpines Institut Ftan]()* Hochalpines Institut Ftan  Frau HIF Jobs  Recruiting**jid8f311e9jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI - Direction générale--- Directeur général H/F, 100%, CDI \- Direction générale==========================================================**Description de l'entreprise****A l’Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève**Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d’un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l’aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l’asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d’intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l’isolement des seniors.Nous sommes plus de 1’600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40’ 000 personnes.En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance.Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l’inclusion, nous valorisons l’intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l’innovation et favorisons la prise d’initiative et l’expérimentation.**Description du poste****Votre mission**À la tête de l’institution, vous donnez le cap et créez les conditions permettant à l’Hospice général de remplir durablement ses missions de service public.En lien étroit avec le Conseil d’administration, ainsi qu’avec le département de tutelle, vous traduisez les orientations stratégiques en priorités institutionnelles et veillez à leur réalisation. Vous conduisez la Direction générale, composée notamment de la Direction générale adjointe et du Secrétariat général, et vous vous appuyez sur le Comité de direction pour assurer la cohérence, la performance et la capacité d’adaptation de l’ensemble de l’institution, pour apporter une réponse adaptée et coordonnée aux besoins des personnes qui font appel à l’Hospice général.Vous représentez l’Hospice général auprès des autorités cantonales, de ses partenaires et des principales parties prenantes. Vous portez sa mission, ses positions, ses valeurs et ses enjeux dans un environnement social, politique et institutionnel en évolution permanente.**Vos principales responsabilités**Vous aurez notamment pour responsabilité de:* élaborer les orientations stratégiques de l’Hospice général avec le Conseil d’administration, ainsi qu’avec le département de tutelle, et en assurer la mise en œuvre ;* vous appuyer sur le Secrétariat général pour garantir une gouvernance solide, le fonctionnement des instances, la maîtrise des risques et la qualité des dispositifs de contrôle ;* assurer, avec la Direction générale adjointe, le pilotage global de l’activité, la cohérence entre les directions et la mise en œuvre des décisions institutionnelles ;* animer une Direction générale et un Comité de direction capables d’arbitrer, de prioriser et d’agir collectivement ;* conduire l’institution dans une logique de service public, de qualité des prestations, d’efficience et de responsabilité ;* anticiper les évolutions sociales, politiques, légales, économiques et technologiques susceptibles d’influencer ses missions ;* créer les conditions permettant aux directions et aux équipes d’exercer leurs responsabilités avec autonomie, exigence et coopération ;* garantir une allocation maîtrisée des ressources humaines, financières, immobilières et numériques ;* entretenir une relation de confiance et de transparence avec le Conseil d’administration et ses comités ;* représenter l’Hospice général dans ses relations avec le Conseil d’État, le conseil, le département de tutelle, les communes, les institutions partenaires et les autres acteurs\-trices du réseau ;* porter la parole de l’institution dans les situations stratégiques, sensibles ou de crise ;* accompagner les transformations nécessaires tout en préservant la continuité et la qualité des prestations aux personnes accompagnées.**Qualifications****Votre profil**Vous disposez d’une formation universitaire supérieure ou d’un parcours jugé équivalent, complétée par une formation en management, gouvernance publique ou conduite d’organisation.Vous pouvez vous prévaloir d’une expérience confirmée de direction générale ou de direction exécutive au sein d’une organisation complexe, idéalement dans le secteur public, parapublic ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé.Votre parcours démontre votre capacité à :* définir une vision et la traduire en décisions et résultats concrets ;* piloter une organisation de grande taille et des transformations complexes ;* travailler avec un Conseil d’administration et dans un environnement de gouvernance publique ;* comprendre les enjeux politiques et institutionnels sans perdre de vue les réalités opérationnelles ;* arbitrer et décider dans des situations comportant des intérêts ou contraintes parfois divergents ;* fédérer des cadres dirigeant·es et développer une véritable responsabilité collective ;* établir des relations solides avec des partenaires institutionnels et politiques ;* communiquer avec clarté, y compris dans des contextes sensibles ;* conjuguer exigence de performance, qualité du service public et attention portée aux personnes.Votre leadership repose sur la clarté, la confiance et la responsabilisation. Vous savez écouter et associer, mais également décider lorsque la situation l’exige. Vous êtes à l’aise dans un environnement exposé, où les décisions doivent pouvoir être expliquées, assumées et mises en œuvre.Une connaissance approfondie du fonctionnement des institutions publiques genevoises et des politiques sociales constitue un atout important.**Informations supplémentaires****Ce que nous vous proposons**Une fonction au cœur des enjeux sociaux du canton de Genève, avec la possibilité d’agir concrètement sur l’évolution d’une institution publique majeure.Vous rejoindrez une organisation engagée dans une transformation de son fonctionnement, de ses pratiques et de ses outils, avec une ambition claire : renforcer son impact auprès des personnes accompagnées tout en développant une culture de collaboration, de responsabilité et d’amélioration continue.Taux d’activité : 100%Type de contrat : CDIEntrée en fonction : A convenirDélai de postulation : 18\.12\.2026Le ou la directeur\-trice général\-e est nommé\-e par le Conseil d’administration de l’Hospice général.Si vous êtes intéressé.e par cette opportunité professionnelle et que vous répondez aux exigences du poste, vous êtes invité.e à postuler à l’adresse . Merci de bien attacher votre CV et votre lettre de motivation en un seul document PDF.En raison de l’importance stratégique de cette fonction, l’Hospice général a décidé de collaborer avec un partenaire externe spécialisé dans le recrutement de profils de cadres. M. Asseo (RaphaelAsseo@ ) et M. (AnthonyAdam@ ) de Executive se tiennent à votre disposition pour répondre à vos questions.Pour de plus amples informations sur le cabinet Executive, consultez le site Executive Search \| Senior Leadership Recruitment. jobs.title: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager:
jobs.description: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager: Clinical Environments / Clinical Demand / Operations Planning / GMP / External Contract Manufacturing / continuous process improvements / Purchase Orders / SAP S/4HANA and P1S / SOW / English / DeutschBackground:As part of PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, the Production Enablement function ensures that packaging operations can produce material required by Roche’s clinical trials seamlessly, on-time, and while optimizing cost/quality.Within Production Enablement the Global CMO Clinical Packaging Management team is responsible for overseeing the manufacturing outsourced portion of the Clinical Packaging portfolio. Contract Manufacturing Site Managers work closely with contract manufacturers (CMOs) worldwide, Procurement, Clinical Planning, Quality and other operations functions to develop and negotiate supply contracts and ensure product delivery from external manufacturing partners with optimal cost, quality and speed. CMO Site Managers also drive the evolution and implementation of new systems and efficient internal and external processes, in support of CMO production and the Pharma Vision to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden between 2020 and 2029.The Perfect Candidate:The ideal candidate is an agile, highly communicative pharmaceutical CMO professional manager with 5+ years of industry experience and a strong grasp of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) who can act as the single point of contact bridging internal clinical study stakeholders and external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). Thriving in fast-paced, unpredictable clinical environments, this person is flexible and reactive enough to quickly pivot and scale up CMO production capacity when patient enrollment unexpectedly spikes or quality deviations delay timelines. On a tactical level, they bring hands-on expertise in overseeing external site production, driving continuous process improvements as the portfolio evolves, and managing end-to-end documentation, specifically creating, revising, and tracking Purchase Orders (POs), work orders, and Statements of Work (SOWs) using strong proficiency in SAP S/4HANA and P1S.Tasks & Responsibilities:•You serve as the primary communication bridge between internal clinical stakeholders (such as study managers, clinical planning, and quality) and Roche’s global network of external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).•You monitor external clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly production to ensure everything runs according to plan, while staying flexible and reactive enough to rapidly liaise with CMOs, secure extra capacity, and scale up supply when unexpected events occur—such as sudden spikes in patient enrollment or extended quality deviations.•You create, revise, and oversee Purchase Orders (POs), work orders, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs). Manage pre- and post-production orders in SAP, own the budgeting process for CMO variable costs, and review/approve CMO invoices.•You partner with Procurement to negotiate supply agreements and select external packaging vendors, while leading ongoing Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) and tracking KPIs to guarantee predictable, on-time, and cost-effective delivery.•You champion internal and external process improvements as the clinical portfolio evolves, represent the CMO function in Clinical Demand & Operations Planning (CD&OP), and help define supply strategies for non-standard product supply chains.Must Haves:•You have 5+ years in the pharmaceutical industry with deep experience in contract manufacturing management or clinical drug manufacturing, backed by a strong understanding of GMP standards.•You have advanced proficiency in SAP S/4HANA and P1S to handle order management, budgeting, and invoicing accurately.•You have a BA/BS degree in a technical, business, or related field (Master’s, PMP, APICS/SCOR, or Six Sigma/Lean certifications are strong pluses).•You are fluent in English (basic German is beneficial), high cultural awareness, and schedule flexibility to collaborate seamlessly across North American (SSF, Mississauga) and European (Switzerland) time zones.Nice to haves:•You have direct experience in clinical drug manufacturing, clinical supply chains, or contract manufacturing management is strongly preferred (beyond general pharma or manufacturing experience).•You speak fluent German•You have finished a Master’s degree or any other training or certifications in PMP, Operational Excellence, Six Sigma, or Lean.•You hold APICS and/or SCOR certifications.Reference Nr.: 925409 Rolle: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager Industrie: PharmaLocation: Basel /HybridPensum: 100%Start: 01.01.2027(01.02.2027) Duration: 12 MonthsDeadline: 21/11/2026If this position has piqued your interest, please send us your complete resume. If this position does not quite match your profile and you would like to receive other positions directly, you can also send us your resume via this ad or to jobs[at]itcag[dot]com.Contact us for more information about our company, our positions, or our attractive payroll-only program: +41 41 760 77 01.About us:ITech Consult is an ISO 9001:2015-certified Swiss company with offices in Germany and Ireland. ITech Consult specializes in placing highly qualified candidates for temporary staffing in the fields of IT, life sciences, and engineering. We offer temporary staffing and payroll services. This is free of charge for our candidates, and we do not charge any additional fees for payroll services.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Global Medical Manager Oncology - Biosimilars--- Global Medical Manager Oncology \- Biosimilars==============================================**Global Medical Manager Oncology – Biosimilars**--------------------------------------------------- **Location:** Basel, Switzerland \| **Division:** Established Pharmaceuticals (EPD) At **Abbott**, we believe people can live fuller lives through better health. Every day, our medicines and technologies help millions of people around the world manage health conditions, overcome barriers to care, and achieve better outcomes. Biologics have transformed cancer care—and biosimilars are making this breakthrough accessible to more people worldwide. By delivering high\-quality, affordable alternatives, biosimilars open the door to earlier treatment, reduce disease burden, and promote equity in healthcare. ### **About the Opportunity** Reporting to the Global Medical Director and working closely with the Oncology Biologics Core Team, this strategic global role is responsible for driving the medical affairs strategy across oncology biosimilar assets and multiple tumor indications. The position plays a key role in supporting global launches, evidence generation, scientific engagement, and medical excellence, with a particular focus on enabling success across Emerging Markets. readiness and life cycle planning, with specific accountability for Emerging Market* Serves as senior medical representative on global cross functional and brand teams **Scientific Leadership \& Strategic Insight*** Acts as a global scientific leader for the portfolio, identifying unmet needs, data gaps, and long‑term medical opportunities* Provides senior medical input into asset strategy, indication sequencing, and scientific differentiation **Evidence Generation \& Medical Governance*** Owns the Integrated Evidence Generation Strategy, including IIS, RWE, post‑marketing and observational studies* Chairs or represents Medical Affairs in IIS, publication, and governance forums* Ensures regional medical activities are aligned with global strategy and scientific priorities **Scientific Communication \& External Engagement*** Leads global publication planning and congress strategy for assigned assets* Engages and manages global and regional KOLs, scientific societies, and expert panels* Acts as a senior scientific ambassador for the portfolio **Regional \& Affiliate Medical Enablement (Emerging Markets Focus)*** Serves as the primary global medical interface for Emerging Markets* Provides strategic guidance, scientific materials, and training to regional and affiliate medical teams* Ensures consistency of medical messaging across diverse healthcare systems **Training, Compliance \& Regulatory Support*** Oversees development of global medical training materials and scientific platforms* Provides senior medical review of promotional and non‑promotional materials* Supports regulatory and safety documentation from a medical and scientific perspective **Portfolio Expansion \& Business Support*** Provides medical expertise to support licensing, acquisition, and in‑licensing evaluations* Contributes to due diligence and asset assessment from a senior medical standpoint ### **The profile** * Medical Doctor (MD) degree or an advanced scientific degree (PhD or .) in a relevant life sciences discipline.* 5–8 years of Medical Affairs experience within the pharmaceutical industry.* Strong experience as medical manager or medical lead of complex therapeutic areas as oncology, haematology, rheumatology, immunology, rare diseases, ideally with biologics or biosimilars.* Proven regional or global Medical Affairs experience and demonstrated success in launch and post\-launch environments.* Experience supporting Emerging Markets and working across diverse healthcare systems is highly preferred.* Solid understanding of clinical research, evidence generation, and medical governance processes.* Proven expertise in managing key opinion leaders and collaborating with scientific societies and external experts.* Demonstrated business acumen and strategic insight into the pharmaceutical industry.* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.* Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.* Ability to operate successfully in a highly matrixed, international environment and influence without direct authority. **Working at Abbott**At Abbott, you can do work jobs.title: Business Analyst International Strategy & Growth
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Analyst International Strategy &amp; Growth--- Business Analyst International Strategy \& Growth=================================================You work 100% primarily in Zug, with the possibility of working remotely up to one day per weekBusiness Analyst International Strategy \& Growth=================================================**V\-ZUG International Commercial Strategy \& Growth**Our International Commercial Strategy \& Growth team drives international commercial strategy, supports business planning and enables growth across V\-ZUG's international markets. We provide strategic and analytical decision support, identify new market opportunities and help translate commercial priorities into actionable initiatives. Working closely with international markets and HQ functions, we contribute to sustainable and profitable growth. We are looking for a Business Analyst and Developer who combines strong analytical capabilities, structured problem\-solving and hands\-on execution. You will work directly with the Head of Commercial Strategy \& Growth, supporting strategic decisions, coordinating key planning processes and contributing to selected growth and transformation projects.**What this position offers you*** You develop commercial analyses, financial models and business cases. You assess markets, sales channels and business models, evaluate scenarios and turn complex information into clear insights and recommendations* You prepare presentations and decision materials for senior management. You turn complex analyses into compelling narratives, structured options and actionable recommendations* You research international markets, competitors, customer segments and industry trends. You bring together internal and external information to build a reliable fact base for strategic decisions* You support the assessment of new geographic markets, strategic partnerships and business models. You analyse market attractiveness, competitive dynamics, go\-to\-market options and financial potential* You coordinate the annual market business\-planning process. You develop templates and guidelines, support markets throughout the cycle, consolidate submissions and prepare analytical reviews. You monitor deadlines, track follow\-up actions and support budget and medium\-term planning* You structure and analyse commercial and financial data, prepare recurring KPI reports and Business Review materials, investigate performance deviations and identify opportunities for improvement. You also help develop more efficient, data\-driven reporting and analysis processes* You independently coordinate delegated strategic projects and cross\-functional workstreams. You manage milestones, deliverables, dependencies and risks, engage stakeholders, monitor progress and ensure timely follow\-up and escalation when needed* You contribute to selected growth opportunities through initial assessments, business cases, partner research, pipeline tracking and the preparation of commercial decision materials**What you can bring to this position*** You ideally have 3 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, business analysis, commercial strategy, financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), or a comparable analytical role. You are comfortable working on complex business questions and independently delivering high\-quality results* You are highly proficient in Excel and use it to structure data, build financial models, analyse scenarios and develop business cases. You can turn large volumes of information into meaningful commercial insights* You have advanced PowerPoint skills and experience preparing presentations for senior management. You can build a compelling storyline, explain complex findings clearly and formulate concise recommendations* You confidently use modern AI\-powered tools to support research, data analysis, information structuring and presentation development. jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%--- Software Test Engineer 80–100%================================About machineMD---------------At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non\-invasive neuro\-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test.The Role--------You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.* **Pragmatic Improvements** – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.* **Automation Across the System** – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end\-to\-end scenarios beyond UI testing.* **Test Infrastructure** – build on and improve our physical and software\-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.* **Coordination \& Code Quality** – work hands\-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.* **Verification \& Validation** – contribute to V\&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.What We Look For----------------### Experience* Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well\-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.* Experience with some of our core technologies ( , C\#/.NET, C\+\+ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.* Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code.* Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.### Qualifications* Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.* Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.* Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1\); or French language skills are a plus for on\-site collaboration.How You Work------------* **Systems Thinker** – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.* **Curiosity \& a Detective’s Instinct** – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.* **Close the Gaps** – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand.* **Collaborative Spirit** – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.* **Shaper Mentality \& Growth Mindset** – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real\-world use cases.Working at machineMD--------------------* Based in Bern, Switzerland, with roughly 80% of your working time on\-site (approximately four days a week at full\-time employment) and Monday as our shared anchor day.* Collaborative, in\-person working, with flexibility to do your best work.Our Four Pillars of Integrity guide how we work together:* Radical Responsibility: Own our choices.* Feeling Our Feelings: Name and honour our emotions.* Candor: Speak and listen with honesty.* Clear Agreements: Make and keep clear commitments.Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics in a dynamic startup, let’s talk!How to Apply------------Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why.We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. jobs.title: Kok / Pizzabager søges - Skilled chef / pizza maker
jobs.description:
Kok / Pizzabager søges

Hos Esperia Pizzabae sætter vi en ære i at servere lækre pizzaer af høj kvalitet til vores mange faste og nye gæster. Lige nu søger vi en engageret kok/pizzabager, der har lyst til at blive en fast del af vores team.

Om jobbet

Som en del af vores køkkenteam får du en central rolle i den daglige drift. Dine primære opgaver vil være klargøring af ingredienser (prep), håndtering og bagning af pizzaer samt tilberedning af retter fra vores menukort. Derudover hjælper vi hinanden med at holde køkkenet rent, pænt og i overensstemmelse med fødevarestyrelsens regler.

Hvem er du?

• Du har erfaring med pizzabagning eller arbejde i et lignende køkken.

• Du arbejder effektivt og struktureret, selv når der er travlt.

• Du er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider (herunder aften- og weekendarbejde).

• Du taler og forstår dansk eller engelsk.

Praktisk info og ansøgning

• Arbejdstid: Fuldtid

• Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

• Arbejdssted: Farum Hovedgade 33, 3520

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til idrisaytac@hotmail.com mærket "Kok/Pizzabager". Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Idris Aytac på 31360960. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

WE ARE HIRING A SKILLED CHEF / PIZZA MAKER!

Are you passionate about crispy crusts, great ingredients, and a fast-paced kitchen? At Esperia Pizzabar in Farum we are busy and looking for our next star to join the team!

Your tasks will include:

• Preparing dough, ingredients, and daily kitchen prep.

• Baking pizzas and preparing other dishes from our menu.

• Ensuring high food quality and hygiene – even during peak rush hours.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from a pizzeria or a busy kitchen.

• Keep a cool head and a good mood when orders are flying in.

• Are reliable, responsible, and a great team player.

We offer:

• A great working environment with friendly and dedicated colleagues.

• Competitive salary based on qualifications and proper working conditions.

• A full time position starting as soon as possible.

Does this sound like you? Send a short message or your CV to idrisaytac@hotmail.com, call us at 31360960, or stop by the pizzeria for a casual chat!

jobs.description: Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability, and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, and rock processing. In 2025, the group had approximately 42.000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.OurSandvik Mining and Rock Solutions (SMR) IT Deliveryorganization supports end to end business processes with solutions by providing solution design & architecture, project implementation, and service operations.IT Delivery organization within Sandvik Mining supports end-to-end business processes with solutions by providing solution design & architecture, project implementation and service operations.We are now looking for SAP OM Functional Expert. development teams.· Bachelors or Masters degree in IT, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related fields· Fluent English language skills· Finnish language skills are beneficial but not required.Experience jobs.title: Market Ethics Manager AstraZeneca
jobs.description: Market Ethics Manager (Sweden) – Nordic Marketing Company - 6 months consultant assignment - AstraZenecaDo you want to help AstraZeneca combine innovation with the highest ethical and regulatory standards? Are you an experienced professional within the pharmaceutical industry who can provide clear guidance, enable compliant creativity and make well-balanced scientific and ethical decisions? Then AstraZeneca might be the place for you!Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, and build close collaboration and partnerships within healthcare.Introduction to role:We are seeking a Market Ethics Manager to join the our market ethics team. In this role, you will be responsible for the scientific and market ethical review and sign-off of marketing materials, activities and relevant non-promotional initiatves.You will ensure that materials and activities comply with national rules, regulations and practices, as well as AstraZeneca internal standards. By combining strong scientific judgement with a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical ethical code, you will help cross-functional teams develop high-quality, compliant and innovative communications and activities.The role operates within the country and collaborates closely with teams across the Nordic organisation, including Medical and Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, Communications, Compliance and Legal.Accountabilities:Scientific and Market Ethical Review    Perform timely scientific and market ethical review and sign-off of materials, assets and activities in accordance with applicable rules and processes.    Ensure that marketing materials, activities and relevant non-promotional initiatives comply with national requirements, local practice and AstraZeneca internal standards.    Engage relevant subject-matter experts when needed to ensure high-quality and well-informed sign-off decisions.    Apply sound judgement to optimise innovation while interpreting ethical and regulatory requirements.Guidance, Training and Capability Building    Provide practical advice, coaching and day-to-day guidance to colleagues on national market ethical rules, practices and AstraZeneca standards.    Develop and deliver training for relevant employees to strengthen understanding and consistent application of requirements.    Champion AstraZeneca ethical standards locally while supporting creativity and innovation through a deep understanding of applicable regulations.    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement company interpretations and guidance on challenging or complex compliance and ethics topics.Process, Compliance and Continuous Improvement    Stay up to date with external trends, ethical code updates and internal developments related to market ethical rules and practices.    Drive the development of market ethical practices relating to material development and activities.    Execute efficient and timely review workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational processes.    Support the preparation of technical documentation and evidence for complaint responses and appeals.    Contribute actively to the development of the function, team effectiveness and continuous improvement.    Ensure that all tasks are completed with the correct quality and in accordance with written procedures, current legal requirements and internal standards.    Maintain and further develop personal expertise within the market ethics area.Diversity & InclusionWe are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.Why AstraZeneca?At AstraZeneca, ethics and innovation go hand in hand. In this role, you will help teams navigate complex scientific, ethical and regulatory requirements while enabling high-quality communication and new ideas. Your guidance will directly support responsible decision-making and strengthen confidence in how AstraZeneca operates across the market.You will join a collaborative Nordic environment with broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape practices, build knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement across the organisation.So, what is next?Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Great, because we cannot wait to hear from you.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbial Single-Cell Genomics and Transcriptomics
jobs.description:
We are inviting applications for a full-time post-doctoral position of 24 months in the Social Systems Microbiology research group at the Section of Microbiology, Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen. The focus of the project will be on single-cell transcriptomics and genomics of prokaryotes and on optimising protocols to acquire extrachromosomal elements and their transcripts. The project the postdoc will work on is motivated by understanding phenotypic heterogeneity in microorganisms: how and why genetically identical cells form distinct phenotypic subpopulations, and what mechanisms give rise to this diversity. You will join an exploratory, method-driven project in this area, funded by the Villum Foundation. The work combines wet-lab method development with sequencing and data analysis across a range of bacteria and archaea. The project is basic research and open-ended by design, and you will have considerable freedom to shape how methods are developed and applied. Therefore, we are looking for a curious, driven and creative researcher who is motivated by both method development and discovery. Your tasks
  • Cultivate and work with a diverse set of bacteria and archaea
  • Develop and optimise protocols for isolating and sequencing extrachromosomal DNA and associated transcripts from bacteria and archaea
  • Apply and adapt single-cell transcriptomic and genomic approaches to prokaryotes
  • Quantify DNA and RNA using qPCR and digital PCR, and perform bulk DNA and RNA sequencing
  • Analyse sequencing data, publish results and contribute to the group's scientific environment
Your profile
  • PhD in microbiology, microbial biotechnology, molecular biology or a related field
  • Hands-on experience with molecular methods and DNA and/or RNA sequencing library preparation
  • Basic bioinformatic skills for analysing sequencing data (e.g. in R or Python)
  • Works independently while collaborating well in a team
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Experience with prokaryotic single-cell omics methods is a strong advantage
  • Experience with method development, troubleshooting and adapting protocols is a strong advantage
  • Experience with cultivating diverse bacteria and/or archaea is an advantage
We offer An international and collaborative research group studying the molecular biology, ecology and evolution of bacterial interactions, embedded in the Section of Microbiology with access to state-of-the-art facilities and a strong focus on a great working environment. We value ambitious science as much as a friendly, team-oriented workplace. You will join:
  • A supportive, international team where ideas are shared openly
  • A strong network of international and national collaborators within and beyond microbiology
  • An active social environment with a culture of helping each other succeed
  • A setting that encourages you to develop your own research ideas
The postdoc’s duties will include research within Microbial Single-Cell Genomics and Transcriptomics as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties. Further information on the Department is linked at https://www1.bio.ku.dk. Inquiries about the position can be made to Associate Professor Jonas Stenløkke Madsen (jsmadsen@bio.ku.dk). The position is open from 01-02-2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. Terms of employment The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Negotiation for salary supplement is possible. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Please include
  • A cover letter (Max. 1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
The deadline for applications is 19-11-2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held week 50-51

jobs.title: Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet i 2027? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i jan-feb 2027 - Book et kald idag.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i jan-feb 2027.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i januar 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kan se hele oversigten her: https://www.jobhuntworldwide.com/sabbataar-udlandet-gode-tips

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Professionel interviewforberedelse

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

  • Relocation‑support (fly, hotel, firmabolig m.m.)

  • Løbende kontakt med relevante virksomheder

  • Tryghed og støtte hele vejen til afrejse

Du kan booke en samtale med os allerede i dag, og så starter vi løbende interviews op med de virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker og din profil.

Book en samtale her: Book et kald

Eller kontakt os direkte: Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

jobs.title: Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet? No worries, vi har en plan "B" klar til dig i udlandet! Book et kald med os i dag!
jobs.description:
Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet - No worries – vi har en plan B klar til dig.

Du tjekkede optagelse.dk, loggede ind, og der stod det: ikke optaget. Surt, ja. Men lige nu har du faktisk flere muligheder, end du tror.

Spørgsmålet er bare: skal efteråret og vinteren gå med at vente på næste ansøgningsrunde – eller skal den bruges på noget, der faktisk rykker dig?

Forestil dig i stedet, at du pakker kufferten og tager til udlandet for at arbejde en periode. Varmere vejr. Nye mennesker. Oplevelser, du kommer til at fortælle om resten af livet.

Men hvad giver det egentlig dig, ud over sol og gode oplevelser?

Et arbejde i udlandet er ikke bare en pause fra hverdagen – det er faktisk noget af det, der skiller dig ud fra alle de andre ansøgere, næste gang du søger ind på studiet (eller søger job).

Det løfter dit CV markantArbejdsgivere og optagelsesudvalg elsker at se selvstændighed. At du har boet i et andet land, klaret dig selv, tilpasset dig en ny kultur og et nyt sprog – det viser, at du kan tage ansvar og løse problemer, uden at mor og far står lige bag dig. Det er præcis den type erfaring, der får et CV til at skille sig ud fra bunken.

Du bygger et netværk, der rækker ud over DanmarkDu kommer til at arbejde sammen med mennesker fra hele verden – andre unge i samme situation som dig, lokale kolleger, ledere med international erfaring. Det netværk kan du trække på resten af livet, uanset om det er til fremtidige jobs, praktikpladser eller bare venner, du kan besøge på den anden side af kloden.

Du udvikler kompetencer, du ikke lærer i et klasseværelseSprogkundskaber. Kulturel forståelse. Evnen til at begå dig i uvante situationer. Selvstændighed og ansvarlighed. Det er de "bløde" kompetencer, som rigtig mange arbejdsgivere efterspørger – og som er svære at få, hvis du bliver hjemme og venter.

Du finder ud af, hvad du faktisk vilMange af dem, vi sender ud, kommer hjem med en helt ny klarhed over, hvad de vil studere – eller opdager, at de brænder for noget helt andet, end de troede. Den erfaring er guld værd, når du skal træffe en beslutning, der påvirker de næste mange år af dit liv.

Kort sagt: den tid, du alligevel skal vente, kan enten gå med at se Netflix og tælle dage – eller den kan blive det, der gør dig til en stærkere kandidat, et mere selvstændigt menneske og en bedre version af dig selv, næste gang chancen byder sig.

Vi har jobmuligheder i bl.a.:

  • Spanien

  • Portugal

  • Grækenland

  • Bulgarien

  • Malta

  • Cypern

…og flere destinationer end det. Du står ikke med det hele selv – vi sørger for tryghed og fællesskab hele vejen, fra du lander til du rejser hjem igen.

Så: skal tiden bare gå? Eller skal du bruge den på noget, du faktisk får noget ud af?

Klar til at høre mere?

  • Skriv til mig på cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com, så finder vi ud af, hvad der passer til dig.

  • Eller book et opkald direkte på vores hjemmeside – jeg sidder klar på telefonen 10-18.

  • Du kan også kontakte mig via min TikTok

Læs min egen historie her om at rejse til udlandet og arbejde: Sådan finder du nye venner i udlandet

jobs.title: Master Thesis in Industrial design
jobs.description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Do you want to help us speed up the shift towards a more sustainable mining and construction industry? By doing your thesis in collaboration with Epiroc you will get the chance to be a part of this journey. You will work together with experienced and helpful colleagues in an atmosphere characterized by creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. In your specific project you have the chance to be a part of a challenging and educational experience while growing both professionally and personally. Available Thesis Topics ⚡ Electrification How can future mining and construction sites transition to electric operations? Explore solutions for charging, energy supply, and infrastructure that enable a safe and efficient shift from fossil-fuel-powered equipment to electrified machines. 🤖 Automation UX - Human & Autonomous Systems How will people collaborate with autonomous systems in the future? Explore user experiences and interface concepts that create trust, control, and effective collaboration between operators and automated solutions. 🎮 Automation UX - Remote Operations How can we create a stronger sense of presence when operating equipment remotely? Investigate new ways of designing user interfaces that support productivity, situational awareness, and decision-making from a distance. ⛏️ Autonomous Mine - Zero Humans What would a fully autonomous mine look like? Analyze the technologies, processes, and infrastructure needed to enable mining operations with little or no human presence underground. 🌱 Sustainability & Circular Solutions How can Epiroc contribute to a more sustainable future? Explore products, services, and business opportunities that support recycling, resource efficiency, and circular material flows. 🏗️ Future Infrastructure What new business opportunities could shape Epiroc's future? Identify emerging needs within infrastructure, construction, urban development, and recycling, and propose innovative products, services, or business models. 🚀 Space Mining How could mining be performed beyond Earth? Explore concepts for mineral exploration, extraction, and maintenance in extreme environments where human presence is limited or impossible. 💡 Open Topic Have an idea of your own? Propose a thesis topic related to mining, infrastructure, sustainability, or future technologies, and develop it together with our team into a project that creates value for the industry of tomorrow. Mission: The deliverables shall be a presentation explaining the thoughts behind the proposed solutions, the work process and a scaled model. The measurement will be done by the mentors appointed for the project. The exact task for the project will be set by you and your appointed mentors. Qualification: To be successful in this project you need to have an open mind for different possible solutions. You shall also Dare-To-Think-New. Challenge established conventions in the mining industry. Education background: Master Thesis student in Industrial Design Level of thesis project: Master Thesis. Functional area: Industrial Design Recruiting manager: Bengt Parkedal, Head of Industrial Design Phone: +46(0) 10 755 16 32, 0720-832 632 Email: bengt.parkedal@epiroc.com Other contacts: Anders Sandström, Experienced Designer. Number of students in the project: One or two students/project. How to apply: Does this sound interesting, and do you feel this is a match? Log in to the recruitment system. If you are new to the system, you need to start by making a profile. Do not forget to attach your CV, Portfolio and a short letter about your-self, describing why you are applying for this thesis and, make a pitch for your project according to the topic for the master thesis. In this process, we review applications continuously and the project can be completed before last day of application. We recommend sending your application as soon possible, but no later than December 05. Please note that we do not accept applications via email

jobs.title: Junior Business System Integrations Engineer
jobs.description: Ready to kick-start your career at the intersection of systems engineering, AI, and commercial business flows? On behalf of our client, a fast-growing, globally active Swedish medtech company, Academic Work is looking for a newly graduated engineer to automate and develop business-critical systems. With close mentorship from senior architects, you will quickly grow into a key role in an international environment based in central Stockholm. Apply today—we review applications on an ongoing basis!About the roleOur client is a leading global MedTech company developing clinically researched, objective testing software for ADHD evaluation. Used by thousands of clinicians worldwide, their technology helps healthcare providers make faster, more accurate diagnoses and improve patient outcomes.As a Junior Business System Integrations Engineer, you will join a tight-knit architecture team consisting of four employees. You will receive dedicated coaching and daily support from senior architects. Your main focus will be streamlining and automating internal processes through scripting, API integrations, and system configuration rather than traditional web or app development. Acting as a bridge between technology and business, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in Finance and Commercial, as well as maintain ongoing dialogue with external system vendors. The role is based at our client’s office near Humlegården in Stockholm, following a hybrid work model where you are expected to be on-site at least three days a week.This is initially a 6-month consulting assignment through Academic Work, with great opportunities for long-term employment with our client thereafterYou are offered    A unique opportunity to build valuable experience within the regulated and expanding global medtech industry.    Close mentorship and continuous support from senior architects in a welcoming, low-prestige environment.    Hands-on experience working at the forefront of modern AI tools for code generation and system automation.    An international workplace collaborating across global markets, including the UK and the US.Work tasksThis role focuses on backend development, business system integrations, and process automation rather than frontend or app development. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure data flows securely and efficiently across platforms.    Take technical ownership of the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of NetSuite and Salesforce.      Build and maintain integrations between business systems, the data lake, and the AWS platform using REST APIs (JSON payloads) and AWS Lambdas.      Automate manual workflows and commercial processes using Python and TypeScript scripts as well as low-code tools.      Leverage modern AI coding assistants to accelerate development, focusing on reviewing, understanding, and ensuring the quality of generated code.      Write and optimize database queries in SQL, SuiteQL, and SOQL to extract, validate, and reconcile business data.      Collaborate closely with Finance and Commercial teams to translate business requirements (from quote-to-order and contracts to usage and billing) into concrete technical solutions.      Ensure high data integrity, accurate numerical reconciliation, and strict compliance with data privacy and information security standards.      Coordinate and communicate with external system suppliers regarding ongoing integrations and system updates.We are looking for    A recently completed academic degree (M.Sc. or B.Sc.) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related technical field.    A solid foundation in programming (such as Python, Java, or TypeScript) and the ability to quickly grasp system architecture and codebases.    A basic understanding of commercial and financial flows, including quote-to-order, contracts, invoicing, and usage-based billing.    Fluency in English, both written and spoken, as English is the corporate language (Swedish is not required, though you must hold a valid work permit for Sweden).Prior experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or AWS is not required—what matters most is your technical foundation, business curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:    Business-minded and communicative: You enjoy interacting with people, feel comfortable initiating dialogue with colleagues and external vendors, and can turn vague requests into clear technical specifications.    Detail-oriented and quality-driven: You are meticulous with numbers, always double-check that data reconciles before handing it over, and respect the high standards of data privacy required in medtech.    Analytical problem-solver: You quickly understand cause and effect in complex environments and are motivated by building smart, automated solutions.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
