jobs.title: Global Nuclear Standards Manager
jobs.description: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.This position reports to: Nuclear Competence Cluster Lead.Lead with Vision. Inspire with Purpose. Build a Sustainable Future. Are you ready to make your mark and drive meaningful changes on a national, regional and global scale? We’re looking for a passionate Global Nuclear Standards Manager - someone who thrives on challenge, innovation, and cross-country collaboration. Who We Are At ABB, we are committed to meeting the world’s toughest challenges head-on. Our core values - care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - guide us every day as we work to empower our people and deliver sustainable solutions. Our culture of diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities ensure everyone has a chance to contribute and succeed. Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide*While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience match this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.This position does not require relocation. The selected candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB officeAbout the Role As Global Nuclear Standards Manager, you will be a part of ABB’s Nuclear Competence Cluster, and play a key role in building the quality, standards and assurance framework required for ABB to scale as a global nuclear supplier. The role will act as a global point of expertise for nuclear quality and standards, helping ABB establish a consistent approach across businesses and markets while ensuring that local requirements are appropriately addressed.     Own and continuously develop ABB’s global nuclear quality management system, standards framework and assurance model.     Lead ABB’s roadmap toward ISO 19443 readiness and ensure alignment with applicable nuclear quality and regulatory requirements.     Translate nuclear standards, regulations, industry and customer requirements into practical processes for engineering, procurement, manufacturing and project execution.     Establish and maintain governance for nuclear audits, corrective actions, supplier qualification, management review and continuous improvement.     Monitor evolving international and market-specific nuclear requirements and assess their impact on ABB’s operations and offering.     Provide expert guidance to ABB businesses and local Quality teams on nuclear standards, compliance and quality requirements.     Support customer audits, assessments and qualification activities including direct engagement with customers, representing ABB on nuclear quality and standards topics.     Drive nuclear safety culture and best-practice sharing across ABB’s nuclear organization.     Collaborate across Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and business teams to ensure consistent implementation of nuclear requirements globally.     You will be mainly accountable for:    Influencing and consulting with senior management across ABB global organizational units/functions to innovatively shape the design and development of your functional area, to improve the organization’s overall performance.    Ensuring customer-focused quality management, achieving high effectiveness in terms of customer satisfaction and efficiency in cost management, including processes and tools to ensure flawless and repeatable process execution, identifying gaps, and exploring opportunities for improvement.    Driving resolution of customer cases to completion, following robust root cause analysis, and implementing effective preventive and corrective actions.    Ensuring effective and efficient review of the quality management system by global leadership to sustain its continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness, and alignment with the strategic direction of the organization and to identify opportunities for improvement.What We Offer     A platform to lead with purpose and vision in a global technology leader.     The chance to shape the future of energy industries.     An inspiring and inclusive workplace culture rooted in innovation and continuous learning.     Opportunities to develop and grow, both personally and professionally. Who You Are     Relevant higher education and 10+ years of experience in quality/standard roles with the ability to develop a clear strategy      Experience working in the nuclear industry     Knowledge and understanding of regulations and authority requirements      Strong commercial acumen with experience across different go-to-market models and a proven ability to manage stakeholders and foster cross-country collaboration     A strategic thinker with demonstrated success in driving complex projects and exceptional customer outcomes     A customer-focused and results-oriented mindset, with passion for delivering through people     Excellent written and spoken communication capabilities, both internally and externally; fluent in English  *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.Ready to make an impact?Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: vi har ledig 2 100% vikariat som
jobs.description:
Bardu kommune med sine 4000 innbyggere ligger i vakre omgivelser sentralt i Indre Troms. Bardu har mange friluftsmuligheter, godt utbygd idrettsanlegg og et godt tjenestetilbud. Næringslivet kan friste med nye spisesteder og god handelsstand. 

Kommunens visjon er: Trivsel og kvalitet i friske omgivelser. 

Bo og oppfølging er en avdeling med ulike tjenesteområder som trenger engasjerte, faglig trygge og selvstendige medarbeidere. Vi jobber hver dag med å skape de beste tjenestene for våre tjenestemottakere og det beste arbeidsmiljøet for vårt medarbeiderskap. I dette arbeidet trenger vi flere positive, selvstendige og løsningsorienterte medarbeidere. Er det nettopp deg?

Stillingen er knyttet til «Bekkebo bo,- og avlastningssenter» tilknyttet unge voksne med utviklingshemming, og «Vekved bokollektiv» for mennesker med utviklingshemming. Avdelingen er godt etablert og som yter tjenester til mennesker med psykisk utviklingshemming, utviklingsforrstyrrelser og andre sosialt utfordringer. Vi yter tjenester i form av hjemmestjenester og vårt primære arbeidsoppdrag er å yte grunnleggende omsorg av høy kvalitet. I tillegg skal det tilrettelegges for trening og utvikling i dagliglivets ferdigheter. Dette gjøres ved å skape forutsigbarhet og struktur. 

Vi er særlig opptatt av at den enkelte tjenestemottaker skal ha et individuelt tilpasset tjenestetilbud og at våre medarbeidere skal ha et trygt, godt og utviklende arbeidsmiljø. 

Turnusordning: tredelt turnus, med arbeid hver tredje helg, nattevakter inngår.

Er dette noe for deg? Og kan du være med på å bidra til å løfte våre tjenester? Vi har fokus på god kvalitet i veien frem mot vår måloppnåelse.  

Vi har ledig:

1 vikariat i 100% stilling som sykepleier/vernepleier med mulighet for forlengelse. 

Varighet:

08.02.2027 - 31.12.2027

 

Bardu Kommune har vedtatt en egen plan for å rekruttere og beholde. For å rekruttere nye sykepleiere/vernepleiere gir vi ett rekrutteringstilskudd på 50.000 kr med bindingstid på 2 år. I tillegg utbetales 10.000 kr til årslønn for sykepleiere/vernepleiere/helsefagarbeidere/barne-og ungdomsarbeidere.

Bardu kommune er en del av sentralitetssone 5. Dette gir mulighet for sletting av studielån hos Lånekassen med kr 25.000,- pr. år etter gjeldende retningslinjer. 

Kommunens visjon er: Trivsel og kvalitet i friske omgivelser. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Legemiddelhåndtering 
  • Utarbeide og iverksette planer, rutiner, tiltak og prosedyrer for tjenestemottakerne.
  • God samhandling med pasienter, pårørende og andre samarbeidsparter
  • Veiledning av studenter med godtgjøring
  • Ansvar jamfør erfaring, og formell kompetanse.

Kvalifikasjoner:

Bachelor i vernepleie eller sykepleie, fagbrev som helsefagarbeider/barne-og ungdomsarbeider. 

Førerkort klasse B

God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Krav om bestått norskprøve 3

Egenskaper:

  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges og vil være avgjørende for ansettelse.
  • Du må være tilgjengelig, ansvarsbevisst og profesjonell.
  • Du må være engasjert og aktivt bidra til å løse utfordringer.
  • Jobbe selvstendig og mårettet
  • Godt humør samt bidra til godt arbeidsmiljø

Vi tilbyr:

  • Tilsetting i henhold til gjeldende reglement og tariffavtaler
  • Gunstig pensjonsordning, yrkesskade- og gruppelivsforsikring
  • En spennende jobb med gode mulighter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden

Generelt

Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatt skal gjenspeile befolkningen forøvrig.  Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. 

Etter søknadsfristens utløp, vil det bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste inneholdende navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosteds- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker. Det kan gjøres unntak fra innsyn for opplysninger om en søker dersom vedkommende selv ber om det. Opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge vil søkeren bli varslet om dette.

 

Søknaden skal inneholde:

  • Søknadsbrev og CV, attester 
  • Dersom du har tatt hele eller deler av utdanningen din i utlandet, anbefaler vi en autorisert oversettelse av dine papirer og godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet
  • 2-3 referanser (navn, tilknytning til søker, epostadresse og telefonnummer

Søknad skal sendes elektronisk i vårt rekrutteringssystem Easycruit.  

 

Andre opplysninger:

Aktuelle søkere vil bli innkalt til intervju.

Har du behov for bistand til søkeprosessen kan du sende henvendelse til: rekruttering@bardu.kommune.no

Dersom det fremgår av din søknad at du ønsker å bli unntatt offentlig søkerliste, gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søker kan gjøres offentlig likevel. Som søker vil du da få informasjon om dette - jf.offentleglova §25. 

Som søker til en offentlig stilling har også du krav på å få tilgang til utvidet søkerliste med informasjon om øvrige søkere. Utvidet søkerliste sendes ut ved forespørsel.  

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Avdelingen Bo og oppfølging yter ulike typer tjenester etter vedtak, i bofellesskap/ bokollektiv og i selvstendige boliger til personer med ulike funksjonsnedsettelser.

About Mercier Consultancy Group

Mercier Consultancy Group is a premier international staffing firm, recognized for bridging top-tier talent with industry-leading global brands. We specialize in navigating the complexities of the customer support services sector to provide unparalleled career opportunities across Europe.

Job Overview

We are currently seeking talented professionals to join our team for the German Speaking Netflix Customer Experts position in Greece. This is a unique opportunity to provide world-class support for a global entertainment leader while enjoying the vibrant lifestyle that comes with our exclusive German-speaking jobs in Greece.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional customer support services to Netflix subscribers in the DACH region.
  • Resolve technical and billing inquiries with precision, efficiency, and a high level of empathy.
  • Navigate complex streaming issues and provide clear, actionable solutions to ensure maximum customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of interactions within the support database for quality assurance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate trends and improve overall user experience in the customer support services industry.
  • Exceed performance metrics by providing a premium, personalized service experience for every customer.

Requirements

  • Valid EU passport (mandatory) to work within the European Economic Area.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively in a fast-paced customer support services environment.

Life in Greece

Embracing the Mediterranean lifestyle is one of the greatest benefits of accepting one of our German Speaking Netflix Customer Experts position in Greece. You will enjoy a climate renowned for its sunshine, a rich tapestry of ancient culture, and some of the most stunning coastal landscapes in Europe, making Greece a top-tier destination for international professionals.

Beyond the professional advancement of securing jobs in Greece, you will have the chance to immerse yourself in the world-famous local cuisine and a quality of life that prioritizes balance and well-being. Relocating to Greece allows you to join a thriving expatriate community, ensuring your transition is as rewarding as your new career.

How to Apply

If you are ready to elevate your career and embark on an unforgettable adventure, we invite you to apply today. Click the Apply Now button to join Mercier Consultancy Group and take the next step toward your future in Greece. We look forward to reviewing your application.

jobs.title: BOUWKUNDIG TEKENAAR
jobs.description:
Voor een technisch productiebedrijf in Oisterwijk zoeken we een Bouwkundig Tekenaar. Je werkt aan klant specifieke prefaboplossingen voor daken, wanden en dakkapellen. Van de eerste bouwtekening tot de productietekening: jij zorgt ervoor dat het ontwerp technisch klopt én geproduceerd kan worden. De functieAls Bouwkundig Tekenaar ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige technische tekenproces van jouw projecten. Concreet:

  • Je maakt bouwkundige tekeningen in AutoCAD.
  • Je werkt productietekeningen uit in HSB-Cad.
  • Je tekent prefab daken, wanden en dakkapellen uit.
  • Je vertaalt bouwplannen naar technisch uitvoerbare prefaboplossingen.
  • Je modelleert volgens BIM/IFC.
  • Je controleert maatvoering, aansluitingen en technische details.
  • Je maakt bestellijsten vanuit HSB-Cad.
  • Je zorgt dat het tekenwerk correct wordt overgedragen naar het bedrijfsbureau en de productie.
  • Je verwerkt wijzigingen en technische opmerkingen tijdens het project.
  • Je overlegt met opdrachtgevers over technische specificaties en zoekt mee naar haalbare oplossingen.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van werkvoorbereiding, bedrijfsbureau en productie.
We zoeken een technisch sterke tekenaar die bouwkundige plannen kan vertalen naar een concreet product.Je beschikt over:
  • Een MBO-opleiding Bouwkunde of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met bouwkundig tekenwerk.
  • Ervaring met HSB-Cad is een grote plus, maar geen vereiste.
  • Goede kennis van AutoCAD.
  • Ervaring met HSB, prefab of houtbouw is een sterke troef.
  • Affiniteit met BIM/IFC.
  • Een goed bouwkundig en ruimtelijk inzicht.
  • Nauwkeurigheid en oog voor technische details.
  • Een planmatige manier van werken.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden om technische zaken met klanten en collega's af te stemmen.

jobs.description: Prima omsorg i Norden AB är en assistansanordnare som strävar efter att hålla högsta tänkbara kvalitet på utförandet av assistansen. Vår målsättning är alltid högsta möjliga livskvalitet för de assistansanvändare som valt oss som anordnare. Vägen dit är utbildning och handledning. Det är vi övertygade om. Därför kan du som medarbetare hos Prima Omsorg förvänta dig att få mycket nyttig kunskap och kontinuerlig handledning kring dina arbetsuppgifter.Nu behöver vi en ny assistent till vårt härliga team runt vår finurliga uppdragsgivare. Vi söker dig som vill arbeta heltid, med dygnspass. Vår uppdragsgivare är en rullstolsburen kvinna som är i 40 års åldern och bor i en egen lägenhet i Svenljunga.Hon har autism och intellektuell funktionsnedsättning. Hon är glad, positiv, oväntat finurlig och älskar livet. Gillar att hitta på aktiviteter både inne i hemmet och ute. Hon kommunicerar med hjälp av tal, bilder, schema, tecken och kroppsspråk. Hon har en egen bil som du som assistent kör, körkort är därför ett krav. Under vardagar följer du som assistent med till daglig verksamhet där du assisterar vår uppdragsgivare. Om dig:Vi söker dig som har gillar att vara aktiv och som bjuder mycket på dig själv. Du ska gilla att arbeta med människor, du behöver vara flexibel och ha en god samarbetsförmåga. Det är bra om du är skojfrisk, då skapar du en god relation med vår uppdragsgivare. Du kommer arbeta dygnspass med ca 1-2 pass i veckan. Det är viktigt att du har möjlighet att hoppa in extra vid behov, även kunna byta pass när det krävs utifrån bemanningen. Har du kunskap kring AKK/TAKK/teckenspråk är det meriterande. Du behöver tala, skriva och förstå svenska obehindrat.Utöver ovan är det framför allt viktigt att du har god självkännedom, är trygg i dig själv, är lyhörd, tar ansvar och samarbetar väl med alla du möter. Du är flexibel, öppen och ser möjligheter i stället för hinder. Du behöver vara fysiskt frisk för att klara arbetet då det ingår viss form av lyft, aktiva promenader och träning enligt schema. Rökfri är ett krav. Ledord för att lyckas i arbetet är: Glad, trygg, ordningsam och stabil!

jobs.title: Warehouse work for peak season in Ringsted
jobs.description:
Ready for peak season? Join our warehouse team in Ringsted!

Black Friday is just around the corner – and we’re gearing up for our busiest time of the year!

At HumanizeR, we’re looking for energetic and reliable warehouse workers to join our logistics team in Ringsted as peak season kicks off. With Black Friday marking the start of an intense period, we need extra hands to keep thousands of parcels moving and ensure deliveries get where they need to be.

Looking for extra work, a flexible schedule, or a chance to get your foot in the door? This could be the perfect opportunity!

What will you be doing?

You’ll be part of a hardworking team keeping the logistics operation running smoothly. Your tasks will include:

  • Sorting parcels and preparing shipments.
  • Loading and unloading trailers.
  • Helping keep the flow of parcels moving during our busiest season.

No previous warehouse experience is required, training will be provided.

Choose your shift
  • Afternoon shifts: 12:00 - 22:00 (start time may change a bit)

Please note that end times may vary slightly depending on the daily workload.

Why join HumanizeR?
  • Flexible work: Choose when and where you want to work, depending on available shifts and assignments.
  • Earn extra money: Perfect if you’re studying or looking to boost your income ahead of the holidays.
  • Get valuable experience: Develop your skills in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Opportunities for the future: Show us what you can do and you may have the chance to move into a permanent position.
  • Great benefits: Including pension and holiday pay.
Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who:

  • Are reliable, motivated, and ready to get stuck in.
  • Bring positive energy and enjoy being part of a team.
  • Are comfortable working independently when needed.
  • Are physically fit and able to handle tasks involving heavy lifting.

Previous warehouse experience is a plus, but not a requirement. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter most!

Be part of the Black Friday rush!

Peak season is approaching fast, and we’re getting ready for the busiest time of the year. Join the HumanizeR team in Ringsted, gain valuable experience, and earn extra money while helping keep Denmark’s parcels moving.

Ready to get started? Apply today and join us for peak season!

jobs.description: A great breakfast to start the day. A seamless conference lunch or a thoughtful room service experience. At Sheraton Stockholm, these moments matter, and we’re looking for a Hotel F&B Manager who can bring out the best in the people who create them. This is a temporary position for at least 1,5 years covering a parental leave. About Sheraton Stockholm HotelSheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place.Your OpportunityWe are looking for an experienced and engaged Hotel F&B Manager for a temporary cover position lasting at least one year. From a busy breakfast service to the final details of a conference dinner, you will work closely with your teams to deliver consistent quality, smooth operations and a warm, professional welcome.Your scope covers the hotel’s F&B services, with our restaurant and bar managed separately by our Head of Restaurant & Bar.Your RoleYou will take responsibility for daily operations, team leadership and financial performance within your areas. By planning staffing around business needs, following up on revenue, costs and productivity, and maintaining clear service routines, you will create the conditions for both excellent guest experiences and a well-run operation.As a visible and approachable leader, you will support your teams during service, set clear expectations and help people develop. Recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, training and performance reviews are part of your responsibility, alongside building a working environment where people feel involved and take pride in what they do.You will work closely with the Kitchen, Front Office, Housekeeping and the meetings and events teams to ensure that every detail comes together. Guest feedback will guide improvements, while food safety, hygiene, sustainability and a safe working environment will be part of your everyday priorities. You combine sound financial judgement with a practical understanding of daily operations.Above all, you know how to lead people. You give clear direction, offer constructive feedback and build trust through your actions. You are comfortable stepping into service when needed, making decisions when the pace picks up and helping your team stay focused and motivated.You bring structure, attention to detail and a genuine interest in hospitality. You understand that strong results come from thoughtful planning, close collaboration and a team that feels supported.What We OfferYou will join an iconic Stockholm hotel at an exciting stage in its development, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on our hotel F&B operations and guest experience.We offer a supportive team environment, opportunities for learning and development, and the chance to work within an international hospitality network - all in the heart of Stockholm.Join UsReady to lead from the floor, develop your team and make every guest experience count? jobs.title: QA Supplier Quality Specialist
jobs.description: At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story through science, innovation, and strong partnerships. We are now looking for a QA Supplier Quality Specialist to join our Supplier Control team in Uppsala. This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal stakeholders across the organization to ensure compliance, quality, and continuous improvement throughout our supply chain.You will represent Galderma in supplier audits and quality discussions, acting as a trusted quality partner while contributing to the development of our supplier quality processes.If you enjoy building relationships, driving quality excellence, and taking ownership of complex supplier-related quality activities in a global and regulated environment, this could be the right opportunity for you. Your teamYou will join Galderma's Supplier Quality team, a collaborative and highly engaged group within Quality Assurance. The team plays a critical role in ensuring that suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers consistently meet Galderma's quality and compliance expectations.Working closely with colleagues across QA, Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Regulatory Affairs, you will contribute to building a robust supplier network that supports both operational excellence and patient safety. Your missionAs QA Supplier Quality Specialist, your mission is to ensure that Galderma's suppliers and external partners operate in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements. Through proactive supplier oversight, audits, quality agreements, and continuous improvement initiatives, you will help safeguard product quality throughout the supply chain.You will act as a trusted quality partner, representing Galderma in supplier interactions and helping to strengthen the quality culture both internally and externally. Key Responsibilities    Manage supplier qualification, supplier control, and supplier lifecycle activities.    Plan, conduct, and follow up quality audits of suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers.    Represent Galderma during supplier audits and quality reviews.    Act as a key point of contact for supplier quality-related questions and support suppliers in meeting Galderma's quality expectations.    Analyze audit outcomes, identify compliance gaps related to GMP and GDP requirements, and ensure timely follow-up of observations and corrective actions.    Review and manage supplier change notifications and assess potential quality impacts.    Investigate and manage deviations related to materials and external services.    Establish, maintain, and update quality agreements with suppliers and business partners.    Drive continuous improvements within supplier quality processes and programs.    Collaborate closely with Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other Quality functions to ensure robust supplier oversight.    Build strong and sustainable relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Your profileWe are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance professional who enjoys working in a role with a high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and external exposure. As a trusted representative of Galderma, you will interact closely with suppliers and partners, lead quality discussions, and contribute to building strong and sustainable supplier relationships.You are comfortable taking ownership of complex quality matters, investigating issues, and driving activities through to completion. At the same time, you understand the importance of collaboration and are able to build strong relationships across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and self-driven professional who combines a structured and analytical approach with sound judgement and a continuous improvement mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by delivering high-quality results. Required Qualifications· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality Management, or another relevant field.· Several years of experience working within a GMP-regulated environment.· Experience from the pharmaceutical industry.· Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.· Strong knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements.· Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive activities to completion.· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Preferred Qualifications    Experience planning, conducting, and following up supplier audits.    Experience representing a company during external audits and supplier quality reviews.    Experience with supplier qualification programs and supplier lifecycle management.    Experience from Quality Assurance. Location and informationThis position is based onsite in Uppsala, Sweden. The role includes regular travel within Europe to supplier sites and business partners. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio

  • ynskjer å påverke tenestene og utgjere ein forskjell for brukarane
  • trivst med å arbeida både på eigehand og i team
  • har "stå på vilje", engasjement, ansvarsbevisst og eit ynskje om å hjelpe andre
  • er fleksibel

Ved intern tilsetjing kan anna fast stillingsprosent verte aktuelt.

Me tilbyr

  • Stillingsbrøk: To stillingar på 14% helgearbeid. Dagvakter og seinvakter
  • gode vilkår for fagleg utvikling
  • eit godt tverrfagleg samarbeid og sosialt miljø
  • gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordningar
  • løn etter kommunalt avtaleverk og elles tilsetjing på vanlege kommunale vilkår 

Søknad

Me ynskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre tilsette skal gje eit bilete av folkesetnaden generelt. Me oppmodar alle som er kvalifisert til å søkja jobb hjå oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller kulturell bakgrunn.Etter søknadsfristen vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste som inneheld namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. I fylgje offentlegheitslova § 25 2. ledd kan opplysningar om søkjaren verta offentleggjort sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å verta oppført på søkjarlista. Søkjaren vert varsla dersom førespurnaden ikkje vert teken til fylgje.Legg ved vitnemål og attestar som vedlegg til søknaden.

Velkommen til å søkje stillinga – vi ser fram til å få deg på laget.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vossingane er stolte, av seg sjølve, av bygda, av maten og kulturen. Vil du verta ein av oss, skal me ta godt vare på deg. Her får du lov til å lukkast. Me garanterer at du finn noko å driva med, også når du har fri. Treng du andre impulsar, er vegen kort til både Bergen og fjorden. No kan du verta ein del av laget, me treng deg. Verdiane våre er: Profesjonell Påliteleg Skapande Inkluderande

jobs.title: Reinsvoll- Jente to år søker omsorgsfulle og gode assistenter!
jobs.description:
Er du omsorgsfull og glad i sang og lek? Da ser vi etter deg!

Vi er en familie på fem, hvor vår yngste datter trenger assistanse i hverdagen. Nå ser vi etter to nye engasjerte og omsorgsfulle assistenter til vår fantastiske jente på tre år som vil bli en del av vårt fine team!

Hun er en blid og nysgjerrig jente med masse sjarm, som elsker oppmerksomhet, lek, sang og moro. Hun har track som hun puster gjennom. Hun får drikke via P.E.G, men ellers spiser hun på vanlig måte. Hun er døv, men hører godt med høreapparat. Du vil få opplæring i tegn til tale, da dette er en fin måte å kommunisere med henne på. Ellers er hun som de fleste andre 3-åringer. Løper rundt, leker og elsker å rote ut av alle hyller. Grunnet track trenger hun tilsyn 24/7. For å få et normalt familieliv til å gå opp trenger vi hjelp til å ivareta grunnleggende behov som lek, mat, søvn, hygiene og omsorg med hjelp fra gode assistenter. Hun vil til høsten begynne i barnehage, så noe av arbeidsdagen vil foregå der.

 

Andre arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Håndtere medisinsk utstyr (Du vil få god opplæring)
  • Spise- og drikketrening
  • Bistå på bilturer, avtaler og reiser
  • Følge til barnehagen og bistå henne der
  • Bistå i hjemmet med huslige oppgaver
  • Lek og aktivisering, både hjemme og på andre arenaer

 

Hvem søker vi etter

  • Det er ikke krav til formell utdannelse og vi ser etter deg som er positiv, trygg, tålmodig og glad i å være med barn.
  • Du tar initiativ og er fleksibel.
  • Ikke røyker 
  • Ikke allergisk mot dyr, siden vi har både hund og katt
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både skriftlig og muntlig

 

Stillinger:

50%: 0900-2100 mandag og tirsdag annenhver uke. 0900-2100 lørdag og søndag hver fjerde uke.

33%: 0900-2100 lørdag og søndag annenhver helg.

I begge stillingene er det mulighet for å jobbe ekstra ved sykdom

Utdyp i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker på!

Hva vi tilbyr:

Vi tilbyr en meningsfull jobb der du får være en del av et lite barns utvikling og glede. God kommunikasjon og samarbeid med oss som familie er avgjørende for at vi alle skal ha en god hverdag. Personlig kjemi og egnethet vil bli vektlagt. Du vil bli en del av et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og oppleve at du har en meningsfull og motiverende jobb som fremmer likestilling. 

Arbeidsdagene vil variere, noen dager er det mye å gjøre, andre ganger har du mer ledig tid.

Gode arbeids- og lønnsbetingelser gjennom tariffavtale 

Egen kontaktperson ved lokalkontoret hos Prima Assistanse Innlandet

Kurs og opplæring som trygger deg i rollen som assistent

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli invitert til intervju fortløpende. Så ikke nøl med å sende inn en søknad :)

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Mann på 58 år søker BPA-assistenter
jobs.description:
Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en positiv og imøtekommende mann på 58 år. Jeg har cerebral parese og er helt avhengig av bistand fra assistenter for å kunne leve et aktivt, selvstendig og godt liv.

Jeg bor i en tilpasset leilighet på Hovseter, som er tilrettelagt etter mine behov. På grunn av min funksjonshemning trenger jeg hjelp til absolutt alt av fysiske oppgaver, både praktiske og personlige. Som assistent vil du derfor være en viktig del av hverdagen min og bidra til at jeg kan gjøre de aktivitetene jeg ønsker og leve et aktivt liv på mine premisser.

Som person er jeg sosial og imøtekommende, har glimt i øyet og setter pris på gode samtaler. Jeg trives også godt i eget selskap. Jeg liker å diskutere og holder meg gjerne oppdatert på det som skjer i samfunnet. Jeg er en mann av mange interesse, blant annet sport og politikk. Jeg setter også pris på å kjøre bil og komme meg ut på ulike aktiviteter.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg søker engasjerte, pålitelige og pliktoppfyllende assistenter som ønsker å bidra til en trygg, aktiv og god hverdag.Det er svært viktig for meg at du er punktlig og møter til avtalt tid. Som assistent er du en viktig del av hverdagen min, og jeg er derfor avhengig av at du er stabil, ansvarsbevisst og tar oppgavene dine på alvor.

Det er en fordel om du har jobbet eller jobber innen helse- og omsorgssektoren, men det er ikke et krav. Du trenger heller ikke å ha erfaring fra BPA fra før. Du vil få nødvendig opplæring og veiledning, slik at du blir trygg i rollen.Jeg søker assistenter til faste deltids-stillinger, samt tilkallingsassistenter til BPA-ordningen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som assistent vil du blant annet bistå med:

  • Av- og påkledning
  • Forflytning
  • Personlig hygiene og toalettbesøk
  • Assistanse under måltider
  • Matlaging og husarbeid
  • Åpne, lese og eventuelt sortere post
  • Følge meg til avtaler og aktiviteter
  • Praktiske oppgaver i hverdagen
  • Bistand i forbindelse med reiser og aktiviteter

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere ut fra hva jeg skal gjøre i løpet av dagen. En viktig del av rollen er derfor å være fleksibel og kunne tilpasse seg ulike situasjoner og behov.

Arbeidstid

Arbeidstidene er per i dag hovedsakelig:

  • Kl. 10.00–17.00
  • Kl. 17.00–00.00

Det må også påregnes reisedøgn som en del av arbeidstiden.

Kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper

Jeg ser etter deg som:

  • Har godt humør og bidrar til en hyggelig arbeidshverdag
  • Er pliktoppfyllende, pålitelig og lojal
  • Er punktlig og møter til avtalt tid
  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Kan arbeide selvstendig og ta ansvar
  • Har norskkunnskaper tilsvarende minimum nivå B1, da jeg har behov for lese- og skrivehjelp
  • Har førerkort klasse B
  • Er fylt 23 år, på grunn av forsikringsvilkårene for bruk av bil

Det er en fordel om du er trygg på å jobbe selvstendig og har evne til å se hva som trenger å gjøres, samtidig som du respekterer at det er jeg som bestemmer hvordan jeg ønsker å ha det og hvordan hverdagen min skal være.

Jeg verdsetter mangfold og oppfordrer alle som kjenner seg igjen i beskrivelsen, til å søke.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Sosionom
jobs.description:
Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste tilbyr helse- og omsorgstjenester til en variert brukergruppe med komplekse og varierende behov. Flere av våre brukere har behov for støtte og veiledning i kontakten med offentlige tjenester, og mange pårørende har en viktig rolle i oppfølgingen av sine nærstående.

Vi ønsker å styrke tilbudet til våre pasienter og pårørende og derfor oppretter vi en stilling som sosionom. Nå søker vi en engasjert sosionom som vil være med på å utvikle og forme rollen, og bidra til at pårørende får god støtte, veiledning og oppfølging. at pasientene får råd og veiledning og hjelp, både på våre omsorgsboliger på seminaret og korttidsplasser på Seminaret, Helsehuset og Inga Sparbosvei.  Fysio- og ergoterapi tjenesten trenger også en samarbeidspartner til store komplekse boligkartlegginger

Som pårørendekontakt vil du få en viktig rolle i å bidra til bedre sammenheng i oppfølgingen av brukere og deres pårørende, samt at du vil bistå våres helsefaglig personell med råd og veiledning. Du blir en trygg støtte og samarbeidspartner for pårørende, og skal bidra til god dialog og samhandling mellom brukere, pårørende, hjemmetjenesten og øvrige offentlige tjenester. Du får en variert arbeidshverdag med stor bredde i oppgavene, hvor relasjonsbygging, koordinering og samarbeid står sentralt.Om ossMidtbyen hjemmetjeneste har base på Seminaret, og består av ni avdelinger som tilbyr tjenester til brukere i egne hjem og i omsorgsboliger. Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste fokuserer på tverrfaglig samarbeid med blant annet fysio- og ergoterapeuter, farmasøyt og saksbehandler. Det tverrfaglige samarbeidet skal bidra til å ta vare på beboernes ressurser slik at de klarer seg selv i så stor grad som mulig.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gi psykososial støtte og støttesamtaler til pårørende.
  • Kartlegge belastninger og behov hos pårørende.
  • Bidra til kartlegging av bolig og hjelpe med søknader om boligendringer for pasientene, slik at de kan bo i sine boliger, til tross for fysiske begrensninger
  • Veilede om rettigheter, søknader, avlastning og kommunale tjenester.
  • Bidra til samarbeid mellom pasient, pårørende og hjelpeapparatet.
  • Ha et helhetlig blikk på sosiale, økonomiske og familiære forhold som påvirker situasjonen
  • Bidra i kartlegging av pasienter på korttidsplasser
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Bachelor i sosialt arbeid / sosionom
  • Ønskelig erfaring med pårørende arbeid, helsetjeneste
  • Kjennskap til offentlige tjenester og rettigheter
  • Ved tilsetting vil relevant erfaring og personlig egnethet vektlegges.
Personlige egenskaper
  • God i kommunikasjon
  • Liker å arbeide selvstendig og har samtidig en tydelig stemme inn i det tverrfaglige teamet
  • Strukturert og har god arbeidsmetodikk
  • Like nye utfordringer, er løsningsorientert
  • God på relasjoner oppbygging
  • Fleksibel, tåle stress og kan prioritere
  • Engasjert og har interesse for fagutvikling
Vi tilbyr
  • Stillingen er plassert i stillingskode 7534, sosionom. Årslønn kr. 545 400 - 639 900.
  • Selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver med gode, faglige utviklingsmuligheter.
  • Tilhørighet i et tverrfaglig og lærerikt miljø.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Gode kollektivforbindelser, sentral arbeidsplass.
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste.
  • Velferdsordninger.
  • Flyttegodtgjørelse.

Annet

  • Tilsetting skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og tariffavtaler.
  • Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.
  • Ved tilsetting må gyldig politiattest iht. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven §5-4 fremlegges.
  • Ved tilsetting kreves tuberkuloseundersøkelse for søkere som i løpet av de siste tre årene har oppholdt seg sammenhengende mer enn tre måneder i land med høy forekomst av tuberkulose iht. tuberkuloseforskriftens § 3.1 og 3.2.
  • Attester og vitnemål legges ved søknad før intervju.
  • Referanser registreres på forespørsel etter intervju.
  • Søknad sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter.
KontaktinformasjonSolbjørg Hennie Edvardsen, Enhetsleder, 481 55 745, solbjorg.hennie.edvardsen@tromso.kommune.no Stephanie Langlois, Personalkonsulent, 902 22 747, stephanie.langlois@tromso.kommune.no ArbeidsstedSeminarbakken 1 9008 TROMSØ Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Tromsø kommune Referansenr.: 5187037226 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 24.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste er en enhet innen seksjon for hjemmetjenester i avdeling for helse og omsorg. Det er fem avdelinger i enheten. Tre avdelinger arbeider innen omsorgsboliger, og to avdelinger arbeider med utetjenester. Enheten tilbyr hjemmetjenester til brukere i egne hjem sentralt i byen, Nordbyen og i omsorgsboliger. Vi har primært eldre, men også en del yngre brukere med varierte behov. I tillegg til de fem avdelingene er fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten for voksne organisatorisk lagt under Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste. De tilbyr tjenester til alle kommunens innbyggere over 18 år. Våre lokaler ligger i Seminaret bo- og rehabiliteringssenter ved bruhodet sentralt på Tromsøya. Vi skal fokusere på å skape tjenester som hjelper brukerne våre til å bli så selvstendig og uavhengig som mulig.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Renholdere / hushjelpere søkes i Stavanger / Haugesund!
jobs.description:
Hushjelp søkes! Er du en av dem som liker å gjøre hverdagen litt bedre for andre?

Stavanger, Haugesund og Egersund

 

Noen mennesker ser støv. Andre ser muligheter for å skape trivsel. Og noen klarer til og med å gjøre begge deler med et smil! 😃

 

Hos Kvitsøy Hushjelp er vi på jakt etter flere gode hjelpere som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell i hverdagen til kundene våre.

 

For oss handler ikke jobben bare om å vaske gulv, tørke støv og få badet til å skinne. Vi ønsker å gi kundene våre den gode følelsen av å komme hjem til et rent, ryddig og trivelig hjem.

 

Og det er nettopp her du kommer inn i bildet!

Vi leter etter deg som ser det lille ekstra!

Kanskje er du en av dem som ikke klarer å gå forbi en sofapute som ligger feil, eller som synes det er litt tilfredsstillende å se en bunke klær bli pent brettet?

 

Da kan det hende vi har funnet hverandre!

Hos oss setter vi stor pris på hushjelper som tar initiativ og ser hva som kan gjøre hverdagen enklere for kundene.

 

Det kan være å brette noen klær, rydde litt på kjøkkenet, sette ting pent på plass eller gjøre den lille ekstra innsatsen som får kunden til å tenke: «Å, så deilig å komme hjem!»

 

Vi forventer ikke at du skal gjøre alt mulig utenom de avtalte oppgavene, men vi ønsker oss mennesker som bryr seg og liker å yte god service.

 

For det er ofte de små tingene som gjør den store forskjellen.

Ingen dager er helt like

Den ene dagen hjelper du kanskje en travel småbarnsfamilie som gjerne skulle hatt noen ekstra timer i døgnet.

 

Den neste dagen besøker du en eldre kunde som setter stor pris på både hjelpen og et hyggelig smil.

Andre ganger kan det være en kunde som ønsker at hjemmet skal være ekstra rent og pent før helgen.

 

Du får møte mange forskjellige mennesker og oppleve hvor stor betydning jobben din faktisk har.

Og når du blir godt kjent med kundene, vet du etter hvert akkurat hvordan de liker å ha det hjemme hos seg.

Hvem passer inn hos oss?

Vi tror de beste hushjelpene er mennesker som liker å hjelpe andre, har sans for orden og kjenner litt stolthet når de ser resultatet av jobben sin.

 

Du trenger ikke ha mange års erfaring fra renhold. Kanskje har du jobbet i butikk, på hotell, i helsevesenet eller med andre serviceyrker? Eller kanskje er du rett og slett en person som liker å holde det rent og ryddig rundt deg?

 

Det viktigste er at du er pålitelig, selvstendig og har lyst til å gjøre en god jobb.

 

Du må kunne kommunisere godt på norsk eller engelsk, og det er en fordel om du har førerkort og tilgang til egen bil, siden oppdragene våre er på forskjellige adresser.

 

Og så må du naturligvis like mennesker!

 

Vi kommer tett på hverdagen til kundene våre, og mange gir oss tillit til å være alene i hjemmet deres. Den tilliten tar vi på alvor.

Frihet, ansvar og gode relasjoner

Hos Kvitsøy Hushjelp får du en variert arbeidsdag med stor grad av selvstendighet.

 

Vi ønsker å legge til rette for en fleksibel arbeidshverdag der du får ansvar for egne oppdrag og muligheten til å bygge gode relasjoner med faste kunder.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI-Assisted Legacy Modernisation
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description: Job ID: 6886We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Black Ops unit on a full-time, permanent basis. This is the right role for you if you enjoy understanding complex legacy applications and using AI-assisted engineering to modernize them for strategically supported platforms. You combine hands-on development skills with the analytical judgement to challenge AI-generated changes, verify that application behaviour is preserved and deliver maintainable, production-ready software. Ideally, you will also help develop our framework for grounding and constraining AI-generated changes to reduce hallucinations and unsupported assumptions.About our teamMeet the Black Ops team. We support the internal customers and engineers working with Nordea’s Internal Developer Platform, helping teams resolve complex technical challenges when expectations meet reality. You will play a senior, hands-on role in using agentic AI to refactor legacy applications and help development teams adopt modern platforms and DevOps practices. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the framework that makes our AI-assisted workflows more controlled, verifiable and reliable. In this role, your main responsibilities will be:    Analyse legacy applications, including Java systems, to understand their behaviour, dependencies and constraints before refactoring    Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to refactor legacy code for strategically supported platforms while preserving required functionality    Independently review AI-generated changes, challenge unsupported assumptions and verify correctness through code analysis and automated testing    Build and strengthen regression tests to validate application behaviour before and after refactoring    Build and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines that integrate AI-assisted development with automated builds, testing and deployment    Support the rollout of our agentic AI solution across development teams and help them adopt effective, responsible engineering practices    Provide feedback on AI-generated results and help improve the framework’s context grounding, constraints and validation checks to reduce hallucinations and unintended changes    Collaborate with application developers, architects and platform teams to resolve complex modernisation challenges and reduce legacy dependencies    Develop DevOps practices within Service Domains and help teams become independent in building, deploying and operating modernised applications    Ensure refactored applications meet Nordea Quality Standards, including security, maintainability and operational readinessWe follow hybrid model of working (up to 40 % remote). This role is open in Poland (Tri-city or Warsaw), Finland (Helsinki), Sweden (Stockholm), Denmark (Taastrup), or Norway (Oslo). We offer employment with various benefits based on your location, which may include private health and life insurance, learning opportunities, holiday subsidies, bonuses and more.Who you areYou are an experienced engineer who combines strong software development skills with curiosity, initiative and sound technical judgement. You see AI as an engineering tool, not a substitute for understanding the system or taking responsibility for the result. You are confident but humble, solution-driven and comfortable questioning generated code. You understand that software quality goes beyond code quality to include correct behaviour, security, reliable delivery and operability. You enjoy helping others adopt new tools and ways of working.This is the right role for you if you:    Have a solid system engineering and development background    Are comfortable reading unfamiliar legacy code and validating AI-generated changes against application requirements    Have practical experience moving legacy applications or code to modern cloud environments    Stay one step ahead by identifying technical risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities    Are comfortable switching between hands-on engineering, troubleshooting and stakeholder discussions    Can stand your ground when needed while remaining open to different perspectives    Communicate and pitch technical solutions clearly to Service Domain leads and engineering teams    Enjoy guiding and mentoring others through technical and organisational changeYour background and skills include:    Strong hands-on Java development experience, including Spring and Spring Boot, and the ability to understand and refactor legacy applications; familiarity with Node.js    Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to critically review generated code and verify changes through unit, integration and regression testing    Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Git/Bitbucket and tools such as Tekton, Argo CD or Jenkins, together with infrastructure automation using Terraform or Ansible    Strong Linux and Windows system administration and troubleshooting skills, with experience operating systems in virtualised, cloud or containerised environments    A solid understanding of Google Cloud Platform and how to deploy, operate and modernise applications in a Google Cloud environment    Familiarity with container-based application architecture and infrastructure using Docker and KubernetesIt would be ideal if you also have:    Experience developing AI-assisted engineering frameworks or agentic workflows, including repository context grounding, constrained tool use, automated validation and human review to reduce hallucinations and unsupported changes     Experience with AWS    Knowledge of Groovy    Change management mindsetIf this sounds like you, get in touch!Next stepsSubmit your application no later than 02/12/2026. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact recruiter Sanna Frisk at sanna.frisk@nordea.com.For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

jobs.title: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

  • Good communication and collaborative skills

  • Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

  • Can work independently and have a good overview

  • IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

  • Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Indian Tandoor Cook
jobs.description:
Indian Tandoor Chef for Pippali Indian Grill

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced Indian Tandoor Chef to join our kitchen team.

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant dedicated to serving authentic Indian cuisine with a strong focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking techniques.

We are looking for a skilled, experienced and reliable Indian Tandoor Chef who specialises in traditional North Indian tandoori cooking, including preparing and cooking dishes in a clay tandoor oven.

As our new Tandoor Chef, you will be responsible for preparing authentic Indian tandoori specialities, including tandoori chicken, chicken tikka, seekh kebabs, naan, roti and other traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian tandoori dishes. You will play an important role in maintaining the authenticity, consistency and high quality of our food.

Your main tasks will include:

  • Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian tandoori dishes using a traditional clay tandoor oven

  • Preparing and baking Indian breads, including naan, garlic naan, butter naan and tandoori roti

  • Preparing traditional tandoori specialities such as chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, seekh kebabs, paneer tikka and other grilled dishes

  • Preparing authentic Indian marinades, spice blends and seasoning mixtures

  • Managing tandoor temperatures and ensuring proper cooking techniques

  • Ensuring consistent food quality, flavour, texture and presentation

  • Maintaining hygiene, food safety and cleanliness standards in the kitchen

  • Assisting with daily kitchen preparation, ingredient handling and cleaning

  • Cooperating with the kitchen team to ensure efficient service during busy periods

We expect that you:

  • Have relevant culinary education or equivalent documented professional experience as a Tandoor Chef or Indian cook

  • Have practical experience working with a traditional Indian clay tandoor oven, preferably in a professional Indian restaurant kitchen

  • Have strong knowledge of authentic North Indian tandoori cuisine and traditional cooking methods

  • Can independently prepare a wide range of tandoori dishes, kebabs and Indian breads

  • Have experience preparing traditional marinades, spice blends and tandoori seasoning

  • Understand tandoor temperature control, cooking times and proper food preparation techniques

  • Can maintain consistent food quality and presentation in a busy restaurant environment

  • Are reliable, flexible, quality-conscious and able to work both independently and as part of a team

  • Understand and follow hygiene and food safety procedures

  • Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.

Documentation of qualifications

Applicants should be able to document their professional qualifications and experience through relevant culinary certificates, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation demonstrating education and/or practical experience as a Tandoor Chef.

Practical experience with traditional tandoor cooking and preparing authentic North Indian tandoori dishes will be particularly relevant.

We offer:

  • A full-time position as an Indian Tandoor Chef

  • The opportunity to specialise in authentic North Indian tandoori cuisine

  • A professional restaurant kitchen with a focus on traditional cooking techniques and high-quality ingredients

  • The opportunity to contribute your professional skills and culinary experience to Pippali Indian Grill

jobs.title: Associate Professors in AI Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Industrial Software in Sønderborg, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more positions within AI Engineering. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is December 7, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Industrial Software is research and education in software engineering, embedded systems, cyber-security and AI engineering. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and embedded software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how new technologies change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the AI engineering research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI Engineering (e.g. multi-modal machine learning)

  • AI integration in mobile, wearable and embedded platforms

  • Human-AI collaboration in the context of mobile, wearable and embedded platforms

  • Domain-oriented AI Engineering (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing).

 

Who we are looking for

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in artificial intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline. For associate professors we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field. If your work is more domain oriented and you therefore publish in leading venues within a specific domain, you are also very welcome to apply.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense, Sønderborg and Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Sønderborg.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the positions, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Cover letter shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max. 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max. 10 files of max. 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is December 7, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment as an associate professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Mechatronic Design for Remotely Operated Vehicles
jobs.description:
Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites application for an 18-month postdoc position within Mechatronic Design for Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs). The position is available from March 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed upon with the successful candidates.

 

What we offer 

Successful candidates will join an interdisciplinary engineering research environment at SDU Sønderborg and contribute to the development of ROVs and associated subsea mechatronics. The work combines engineering design, numerical modelling, prototyping, fabrication, integration, and experimental validation in laboratory and marine environments.

The positions offer opportunities to:

  • Develop and evaluate mechatronic components, subsystems, and integrated ROV platforms.

  • Design underwater actuation mechanisms, transmissions, structural components, and pressure-resistant enclosures, including sealing and mechanical interfaces.

  • Integrate underwater sensors, actuators, embedded electronics, and control hardware.

  • Perform CAD modelling, engineering analysis, simulations, design optimisation, and prototype fabrication.

  • Conduct laboratory and field testing to improve the performance, reliability, and robustness of subsea mechatronic technologies.

  • Publish research in international scientific journals and conferences, collaborate with research partners, and contribute to student supervision where relevant.

 

What we expect 

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, robotics, marine engineering, or a closely related discipline at the time of employment. We seek motivated researchers with strong mechatronic design skills and hands-on experience in developing, integrating, and testing electromechanical systems.

Applicants should have demonstrated expertise in mechatronic design and practical experience in several of the following areas:

  • Mechanical and mechatronic design, including actuation, transmissions, structural design, and electromechanical integration.

  • CAD and engineering modelling or analysis, such as finite element analysis, multibody dynamics, or related methods.

  • Integration of sensors, actuators, embedded electronics, and control hardware.

  • Rapid prototyping, additive manufacturing, machining, assembly, and experimental development.

  • Experimental testing, instrumentation, data acquisition, system characterisation, and troubleshooting.

  • Basic programming and control using tools such as Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, or ROS/ROS 2.

Experience in subsea engineering, ROV development, underwater actuation, pressure-resistant enclosures, waterproofing, sealing, or marine instrumentation is an advantage but not a requirement. Applicants should have a publication record appropriate to their career stage, sound scientific judgement, good written and spoken English, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

 

Workplace description 

The positions will be based at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), Department of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, in Sønderborg. The research environment brings together expertise in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, modelling, control, and experimental engineering.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Sønderborg. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact:
