jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 employees across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.de/careers) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description: Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.Your responsibilities:Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership TeamContribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function. Your background:Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controlsResults-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skillsStrong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organizationAbility to translate financial and operational insights into actions10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilitiesDigital mindset with proof record on digital innovationsYour benefits:Attractive compensation & benefitsEmployee Assistance Program GlobalParental Leave ProgramWe look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.Accelleron Data Privacy Statement: accelleron.com/privacy-notice/candidate

Kui tunned, et see pakkumine on just Sulle, kandideeri juba täna ja tule aita kaasa parema elukeskkonna loomisele! jobs.title: Mekanisk montør
jobs.description:
Vær med til at bygge robotløsninger fra montage og test til indkøring hos kunden. Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi.

Vi søger en erfaren mekanisk montør, der kan samle, justere og teste de mekaniske dele i vores robot- og automationsløsninger. Du arbejder med kundetilpassede anlæg, hvor din faglighed og sans for detaljerne har betydning for, hvordan den samlede løsning fungerer.

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der:

  • Brænder for mekanisk montage og motiveres af at få maskiner og udstyr til at fungere i praksis.

  • Trives i et tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde, vidensdeling og faglig sparring er en del af arbejdet.

  • Motiveres af afvekslende projektopgaver med skræddersyede automatiseringsløsninger efter kundernes behov.

Stillingen

Du bliver en del af vores projektteam, hvor du i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer udvikler kundetilpassede robot- og automationsløsninger til industrien. I stillingen er du med i projektforløbet fra montage og test hos Danrobotics til idriftsættelse hos kunden. 

Du kan forvente en afvekslende arbejdsdag med tæt kontakt til både kunder, samarbejdspartnere og kollegaer. Som Mekanisk montør varetager du den fulde opgave med montage og samling af maskiner, robotter og udstyr. 

Eksempler på arbejdsopgaver:

  • Mekanisk montage af maskiner, robotter og anlæg.

  • Samling og justering af komponenter.

  • Fejlfinding, test og kvalitetssikring.

  • Konfigurering af systemparametre.

  • Kabeltræk og montering af stik.

  • Dokumentation og brug af IT-systemer i hverdagen.

  • På sigt opstart og indkøring af robotanlæg.

  • Bidrage med forbedringsforslag og være med til at indføre standarder inden for dit fagområde.

Jobbet omfatter kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere samt rejseaktivitet i begrænset omfang. Rejser med overnatning vil typisk være i forbindelse med opsætning, idriftsættelse eller service af robotløsninger hos kunder samt messeaktiviteter.

Din profil

Du trives i en mindre organisation, hvor der arbejdes i tværfaglige teams. Du er en teamplayer, men kan også arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar. Du arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst og tager ansvar for at følge dine opgaver til dørs. Du har øje for detaljerne og bevarer samtidig overblikket over den samlede montageopgave. Du lytter, får afklaret tekniske spørgsmål og bidrager til, at anlægget effektivt bliver klar til indkøring og aflevering hos kunden. 

Din faglighed: 

Du har erfaring med mekanisk montage af industrianlæg. Du er eksempelvis uddannet mekaniker, klejnsmed, automatikmontør, automationstekniker eller industrielektriker eller har en tilsvarende relevant faglig baggrund.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har teknisk forståelse og kan læse og anvende mekaniske tegninger.

  • Har forståelse for sikkerhedssystemer.

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk og engelsk.

  • Erfaring med robotløsninger er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 

Vi tilbyder

Hos Danrobotics får du et afvekslende job med ansvar for dine egne montageopgaver og indflydelse på, hvordan de bliver løst. Du arbejder med forskellige robot- og automationsanlæg og får mulighed for at følge dit arbejde fra de enkelte komponenter til en samlet løsning.

Du får tæt samarbejde og faglig sparring med kolleger på tværs af virksomheden. Samtidig kan du bidrage med din praktiske erfaring til at forbedre vores løsninger og arbejdsmetoder.

Vi prioriterer fleksibilitet, personlig og faglig udvikling af den enkeltes kompetencer, medarbejderinddragelse og tillidsbaserede relationer – både internt og eksternt. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og tilbyder løbende udvikling og uddannelse.

Lønnen aftales efter dine kvalifikationer.

Praktisk information

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Bodil Koertsen: bk@danrobotics.dk.

Du er velkommen til at ringe og høre nærmere om stillingen ved Bodil Koertsen, telefon +45 61 24 33 89.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Kort om Danrobotics

Danrobotics har hovedkontor i Middelfart, tæt på motorvejen, og et datterselskab i Neumünster, Tyskland. Vi leverer robotløsninger til industrien – fra simple automatiseringsopgaver til store, komplekse løsninger, der omfatter hele produktionslinjer. Derudover tilbyder vi service og vedligeholdelse af alle typer robotanlæg.

Vi er 38 engagerede medarbejdere, der brænder for at udvikler, installerer og servicerer værdiskabende løsninger inden for robotteknologi og automatisering til industrivirksomheder i både Danmark og udlandet. Vi samarbejder med nogle af branchens førende leverandører for at sikre vores kunder de bedste løsninger. Læs mere om Danrobotics her.

jobs.title: Teknisk Projektarkitekt
jobs.description:
Nyoprettet stillling | Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi.

Vi søger en erfaren teknisk profil, der kan omsætte kundens behov til gennemtænkte automationsløsninger og sikre, at de forskellige fagområder spiller sammen. Du får indflydelse på de tidlige løsningsvalg og på den tekniske kvalitet ved projektets centrale milepæle.

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der:

  • Brænder for at løse komplekse tekniske opgaver og skabe løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

  • Trives i et tværfagligt team, hvor tæt samarbejde, vidensdeling og faglig sparring fører til bedre løsninger for kunderne.

  • Motiveres af afvekslende projektopgaver med skræddersyede automatiseringsløsninger og mulighed for at bruge din erfaring på tværs af projekter.

Stillingen

Sæt den tekniske retning, og skab sammenhæng fra tilbud til færdig løsning. Som Teknisk Projektarkitekt arbejder du mellem salg, konstruktion og projektafvikling. Du kvalificerer løsnings-konceptet, afklarer tekniske forudsætninger og identificerer risici, inden de får konsekvenser længere fremme i projektet.

Du har ansvaret for den tekniske kvalitet ved klart definerede milepæle. I tæt samarbejde med salg, projektleder og fagansvarlige sikrer du sammenhæng mellem mekanik, el, PLC, robot, sikkerhed og software.

Projektlederen har ansvaret for kunderelationen, tidsplanen, økonomien, ressourcerne og den samlede fremdrift. Din indsats er knyttet til den tekniske afklaring, kvalitetssikring og udvalgte problemstillinger.

Eksempler på dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Deltage som teknisk ansvarlig i udvalgte salgsmøder og afklare kundens behov, tekniske forudsætninger og grænseflader.

  • Kvalitetssikre tilbuddenes tekniske løsning, omfang og afgrænsning samt synliggøre risici, inden tilbuddet sendes.

  • Gennemføre teknisk projektopstart sammen med projektleder og fagansvarlige og få afklaret manglende kundeoplysninger og åbne tekniske spørgsmål.

  • Afholde tekniske design reviews og vurdere, om løsningen er klar til konstruktion, indkøb, montage og fabriksaccepttest (FAT).

  • Sparre med konstruktører og programmører om vanskelige tekniske problemstillinger og deltage i udvalgte fejlfindings- og udviklingsopgaver.

• Udvikle standardløsninger og tjeklister og sikre, at erfaringer fra ét projekt bliver brugt i de næste.

Din profil

Du skaber overblik i komplekse opgaver og får stillet de spørgsmål, der afklarer usikkerheder tidligt. Du kan udfordre en løsning fagligt, forklare dine vurderinger og finde en brugbar vej frem sammen med kollegerne.

Du lytter til de enkelte specialister og samler deres viden til en sammenhængende løsning. Samtidig er du tydelig om tekniske risici og om, hvad der skal være afklaret, før projektet går videre.

Din faglighed:

Du har en relevant teknisk baggrund inden for automation. Du har erfaring med at udvikle eller realisere komplekse maskin- og automationsløsninger og forstår samspillet mellem de forskellige fagområder.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har teknisk bredde og forståelse for mekanik, el, styring, robotter og software.

  • Kan vurdere løsningskoncepter, tekniske risici og grænseflader mellem fagområder.

  • Har erfaring med teknisk afklaring, design reviews eller kvalitetssikring af projekter.

  • Kan omsætte praktisk erfaring til fælles standarder og arbejdsmetoder.

Vi tilbyder

Hos Danrobotics får du en rolle med indflydelse på både de enkelte robotløsninger og den måde, vi udvikler projekter på. Du får tæt samarbejde med specialister på tværs af fagområder og mulighed for at bruge din erfaring dér, hvor de tekniske valg har stor betydning. Du er du med til at sætte retningen for teknisk kvalitet, standardisering og læring på tværs af virksomheden.

Vi prioriterer fleksibilitet, personlig og faglig udvikling af den enkeltes kompetencer, medarbejderinddragelse og tillidsbaserede relationer – både internt og eksternt. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og tilbyder løbende udvikling og uddannelse.

Lønnen aftales efter dine kvalifikationer.

Praktisk information

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Bodil Koertsen: bk@danrobotics.dk

Du er velkommen til at ringe og høre nærmere om stillingen ved Bodil Koertsen, telefon +45 61 24 33 89.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Kort om Danrobotics

jobs.description: Primary location:KOKKOLAHaemme katsastajaa vahvistamaan Automaa Katsastuksen tiimiä KokkolassaAutomaa on täyden palvelun autotalo. Edustamme Volvoa, Polestaria ja Fordia ja olemme osa Osuuskauppa KPOta. Tarjoamme uusien ja käytettyjen autojen myynnin lisäksi huolto- ja korjaamopalvelut, vauriokorjauksen, katsastuksen ja rengaspalvelut. Toimimme Kokkolassa ja Vaasassa ja työllistämme yli 90 autoalan ammattilaista.Automaa Katsastus palvelee Kokkolassa sekä kevyen että raskaan kaluston asiakkaita. Meillä katsastus on osa suurempaa autotalon kokonaisuutta: saman organisaation sisältä löytyvät myös automyynti, huolto, varaosat ja vauriokorjaamo. Työ on monipuolista, asiakkaita riittää ja ympärilläsi on kokenut autoalan porukka.Voit olla jo valmis katsastaja tai autoalan ammattilainen, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallaan. Jos täytät Traficomin katsastajakoulutukselle asettamat koulutus- ja työkokemusvaatimukset, voimme rakentaa sinulle koulutuspolun katsastajaksi.Mitä työ sisältää?Työtehtäväsi muodostuvat osaamisesi ja katsastusoikeuksiesi mukaan esimerkiksi:- kevyiden ajoneuvojen määräaikaiskatsastuksista- raskaan kaluston katsastuksista- rekisteröinti- ja muutoskatsastuksista- asiakkaiden neuvonnasta ja palvelemisesta- katsastustoiminnan päivittäisestä kehittämisestä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Raskaan kaluston ja erikoiskatsastusten oikeudet katsomme eduksi. Jos niitä ei vielä ole, mutta sinulla on halua kehittyä, voimme keskustella oikeuksien laajentamisesta myöhemmin.Voit olla etsimämme henkilö, jos- sinulla on voimassa olevat katsastusoikeudet tai Traficomin vaatimuksiin soveltuva koulutus- ja työkokemustausta- työskentelet huolellisesti, itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti- osaat kohdata asiakkaan asiallisesti ja ymmärrettävästi- sinulla on vähintään B-luokan ajokortti- haluat oppia uutta ja kehittää myös yhteistä tekemistä.C-luokan ajokortti, raskaan kaluston osaaminen sekä ruotsin tai englannin kielen taito ovat tehtävässä eduksi.Jos sinulla ei vielä ole katsastusoikeuksia, tutustu Traficomin sivuilta katsastajaksi kouluttautumisen edellytyksiin: Mitä ajoneuvokatsastajalta edellytetään?Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Tarjoamme vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn vakaassa yrityksessä sekä mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisesti kevyen ja raskaan kaluston parissa. Saat tueksesi osaavan katsastustiimin ja laajan autotalon muun henkilöstön. Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja laajentaa katsastusoikeuksiasi tehtävässä.Automaa on osa Osuuskauppa KPO:ta, joten saat käyttöösi KPO:n ja koko S-ryhmän poikkeuksellisen laajat henkilöstöedut. Niihin kuuluvat muun muassa:- henkilöstöalennukset yli 2 000 S-ryhmän toimipaikassa- laajat työterveyspalvelut- Epassi-edut- vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus- S-Pankin henkilöstöedut- KPO:n lomamökkien ja henkilöstötapahtumien kaltaiset muut edut.- ja paljon muutaKiinnostuitko?Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi viimeistään 30.11.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Martin BjörkqvistTeknisen palvelun johtajapuh. 050 524 1912120- vuotias Osuuskauppa KPO on lähes 1,2 miljardin euron vuosimyynnillään Suomen suurimpia alueosuuskauppoja. Toimimme Ylivieskan, Kokkolan, Pietarsaaren ja Vaasan talousalueilla. Olemme alueemme marketkaupan markkina- ja hintajohtaja sekä markkinajohtajia polttoneste-, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa. Lisäksi harjoitamme autokauppaa. Meillä on lähes 140 000 asiakasomistajaa ja työllistämme noin 2 300 palvelualan ammattilaista. Toimintamme taloudellinen menestys päätyy kokonaisuudessaan palveluidemme kehittämiseen ja asiakasomistajiemme eduksi.

jobs.title: Job i Malaga - Kundeservicemedarbejder - Hybrid job med mulighed for at arbejde fra Danmark i kortere perioder.
jobs.description:
Vi søger fastboende kundeservice/tekniske supportere til vores danske team i Málaga. Du får mulighed for at arbejde remote fra Danmark i kortere perioder.

Du er den første kontakt for medarbejdere, der har brug for IT‑hjælp. Din hverdag vil bestå af dialog, problemløsning og teknisk support. Du hjælper brugere via telefon, mail og chat, hvor du besvarer spørgsmål, guider dem gennem tekniske udfordringer og sikrer, at deres systemer fungerer korrekt. Du arbejder med fejlsøgning, IT‑tickets, brugersupport og samarbejde med andre IT‑teams. Rollen er varieret og giver dig indblik i mange forskellige systemer og processer.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et internationalt miljø, hvor du hjælper medarbejdere på tværs af organisationen og sikrer, at deres IT‑oplevelse er professionel og effektiv.

Rollen er attraktiv, fordi du får mulighed for at arbejde remote hvis du skal hjem til Danmark i en kortere periode. Du kan også arbejde remote når du har tidlige eller sene vagter. Du planlægger det selv. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar.

Hvordan er kontormiljøet?

Du bliver en del af et internationalt team med dansk‑ og engelsktalende kolleger. Kontoret ligger i Málaga og har moderne faciliteter, professionelle arbejdsstationer og et stærkt socialt miljø. Der er fokus på samarbejde, udvikling og trivsel, og du får mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med både danske og internationale medarbejdere.

Dit ansvar:

  • 1st level IT‑support via telefon, mail og chat og hjælper brugerne videre, når de oplever tekniske udfordringer

  • Hjælper medarbejdere med at navigere i systemer, programmer og hardware

  • Arbejder med fejlsøgning og identificerer årsagerne til tekniske problemer

  • Håndterer IT‑tickets og sikrer, at sagerne bliver prioriteret korrekt

  • Benytter interne vidensdatabaser til at finde løsninger hurtigt og effektivt

  • Bidrager til en professionel og serviceminded oplevelse for alle brugere

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Native dansk i både skrift og tale og kommunikerer sikkert på engelsk (C1)

  • Har interesse for IT og gerne erfaring med supportopgaver

  • Kender til Windows 10, Office 365 og føler dig hjemme i digitale miljøer

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan holde overblik, selv når der er flere opgaver i gang

  • Trives i en rolle, hvor service, hjælpsomhed og tydelig kommunikation er i fokus

  • Har en analytisk tilgang og kan løse tekniske udfordringer på en systematisk måde

  • Er nysgerrig, lærevillig og motiveret for at arbejde i et internationalt team

  • Kan arbejde alle dage om ugen, med vagter placeret mellem 7-23 (39 timer om ugen)

Løn og benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidskontrakt (indefinido) med spansk kontraktsret

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn på 1800 Euro/ Brutto (2000 Euro/Brutto efter et år)

  • Spansk social sikring, pension og betalt ferie

  • Mulighed for delvist hjemmearbejde efter oplæring

  • Moderne kontormiljø i solrige omgivelser

  • Vi tror på at frihed under ansvar er den bedste arbejdskultur

  • Vi passer på dig og du passer på vores kunder

Den perfekte kandidat:

Den ideelle kandidat til denne rolle er en person, der trives i et miljø, hvor service, problemløsning og kommunikation går hånd i hånd. Du er typen, der bliver nysgerrig, når noget ikke virker, og som gerne vil forstå, hvad der ligger bag en teknisk udfordring. Samtidig er du god til mennesker og formår at skabe ro og tryghed, når du hjælper andre gennem en IT‑udfordring. Du arbejder struktureret, holder hovedet koldt, når der er flere opgaver i spil, og du har en naturlig lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dine kompetencer. Det er vigtigt, at du er samarbejdsorienteret og trives i et internationalt miljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden og deler viden. Hvis du både kan lide at arbejde med mennesker og teknologi, og du motiveres af at gøre en forskel for brugerne, vil du passe perfekt ind i teamet.

Hvad får du ud af at arbejde hos virksomheden?

  • Solrigt klima, lavere leveomkostninger og afslappet livsstil

  • Arbejdsdage der slutter tidligt og lang weekend hver uge

  • Mulighed for at netværke med internationale kolleger

  • Kombination af professionel vækst og personlig trivsel

  • Et stærkt fællesskab i et moderne, åbent kontormiljø med fokus på diversitet

Er du en fastboende i Málaga området vil vi gerne i kontakt med dig.

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

jobs.title: Join our team of Tour Guides in Bergen!
jobs.description:
Make Bergen your everyday workplace. Meet guests from around the world, share local stories, and join a diverse international team. Gain valuable professional experience while enjoying the culture and social life of a vibrant city, with mountains and nature on your doorstep.

Hva vi ser etter

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking curious, service-minded, and reliable individuals who enjoy connecting with people and working in a dynamic environment.

Requirements:

  • Fluency in English and at least one of the following languages: German, Spanish, Italian, French, Norwegian, Dutch, Chinese, Greek or Polish. Proficiency in two or more of these languages in addition to English is considered a strong advantage.
  • If you are not a Norwegian citizen, you must be an EU/EEA citizen or already have a valid Norwegian work permit.
  • Interest in Norwegian history, culture, and nature.
  • Guide Certification (or willingness to obtain one).

Not Certified Yet?

As a part of our quality guarantee to our clients, our guides must hold at minimum a Guide Certification ensuring high professional standards. Several certification options are available in Norway.

We work together with and recommend the Guide Academy Certification Programme , which includes an engaging online course (completed remotely) and an intensive on-site training session in Bergen starting April the 12th 2027.

No prior guiding experience is required, only passion and enthusiasm!

We sponsor the certification fee for candidates who commit to working a full season exclusively with Norwegian Guide Service.

Du rådgiver kunderne om blandt andet indretning, materialer, funktionalitet og løsninger og hjælper dem med bedst muligt at træffe de mange valg, der følger med et nyt køkken. Det kræver, at du er god til at skabe relationer og tillid og kan guide kunden trygt gennem hele processen.

Stillingen har primært fokus på privatkunder, men du vil også få berøring med erhvervssalg, som Rotpunkt Esbjerg ønsker at udvikle yderligere over tid.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Whole-Ship Energy Modelling and Maritime Decarbonization
jobs.description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for an 18-month postdoctoral position in thermodynamics-based whole-ship energy modelling. The position is expected to start in March 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

What we offer

You will join a research project titled Thermodynamics-Based Whole-Ship Energy Mapping for Retrofit-Oriented Maritime Decarbonization (STERN) funded by Den Danske Maritime Fond. STERN addresses a practical maritime engineering challenge: improvements to individual components do not necessarily result in optimal energy performance for the vessel as a whole. The project will develop physically consistent steady-state and dynamic energy models to quantify interactions among propulsion, auxiliary equipment, cooling and heating systems, waste heat and energy storage under representative operating conditions.

The postdoc will work within an interdisciplinary SDU team led by Assistant Professor Baris Burak Kanbur, together with Professor Marie Lützen and Associate Professor Paride Gullo, and collaborate with maritime partners including the shipping company Hafnia, DESMI and Fredericia Maskinmesterskole (FMS). ShippingLab will support maritime knowledge exchange and outreach. The position offers opportunities for independent scientific development, high-quality publications and close interaction with industry.

 

Main research activities

  • Develop modular steady-state thermodynamic and energy-balance models for whole-ship energy mapping, covering fuel input, propulsion, auxiliary power, thermal loads, heat rejection and recoverable energy streams.

  • Extend these models to dynamic energy simulations representing time-varying engine loads, operational profiles, mode transitions and relevant subsystem interactions.

  • Model and analyze selected marine subsystems and energy-integration pathways, including propulsion-related energy demand, waste heat recovery, HVAC, cooling/heating optimization, thermal storage and battery storage.

  • Use representative vessel and component data, engineering correlations and partner feedback to check model assumptions, quantify uncertainty and compare baseline and retrofit-oriented scenarios in terms of energy use and emissions.

  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, project meetings, reporting and dissemination of non-confidential results.

 

Required qualifications

  • A PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Thermal Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline (completed by the date of employment).

  • A strong foundation in thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics (thermo-fluids) and energy-system analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience in numerical thermodynamic or energy-system modelling, including steady-state analysis and time-dependent/dynamic simulation.

  • Programming or modelling skills in MATLAB, Python or comparable scientific computing environments, with the ability to develop and document reproducible models.

  • Knowledge of waste heat recovery, refrigeration/HVAC, cooling and heating networks, energy storage or component performance maps.

  • Ability to conduct independent research, work with an interdisciplinary team and communicate research results effectively in English.

 

Qualifications considered an advantage

  • Experience with marine engines, propulsion systems, ship energy systems or vessel operating profiles.

  • Experience with dynamic simulation and control environment like MATLAB Simulink, Modelica/Dymola or equivalent modelling frameworks can also be considered.

  • Knowledge of advanced control engineering, optimization or model-based control approaches, and experience collaborating with industrial partners.

 

Workplace description 

The position is full-time at SDU ME and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. 

The research environment combines thermo-fluid science, energy engineering and computational modelling, with collaboration across SDU and external maritime partners. The successful candidate will contribute to an industry-informed research project while working closely with academic colleagues and maritime experts. The research group is also part of the broader maritime research community at SDU, providing opportunities for transdisciplinary collaboration across faculties through the SDU Maritime Centre.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For academic enquiries about the position and the STERN project, please contact Assistant Professor Baris Burak Kanbur (babk@sdu.dk ) SDU Mechanical Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • One page motivation letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Three publications most relevant to the position.

  • Name of three references.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is January 1, 2027, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 18-month period. The preferred start date is in early 2027 (exact date to be confirmed). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Assistant, Tenure-track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Interactive Technology and AI Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more positions within interaction technology and AI engineering. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Interactive Technology and Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the interaction technology and AI engineering research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • Human-Computer Interaction and Design

  • Interactive Systems Engineering

  • AI-based User Interface Technology (e.g. generative user interfaces)

  • Human-AI collaboration (e.g. robotics)

  • Human-Centred Technology Ethics and Human-Centred AI Ethics

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Domain-oriented Interaction Technology (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing)

  • User Interaction Technologies (e.g., augmented reality and wearable technology)

  • AI Engineering (e.g. multi-modal machine learning)

  • Domain-oriented AI Engineering (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing).

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as CHI (Human Factors in Computing Systems), DIS (Designing Interactive Systems), CSCW (Computer-Supported Cooperative Work), NordiCHI, UIST (User Interface Software & Technology), IUI, HRI (Human-Robot Interaction), TEI (Tangible Embedded Embodied Interaction), IDC (Interaction Design & Children), UbiComp (Ubiquitous Computing), PerCom, EICS, AAAI, WWW, ACM CIKM; and in journals such as IMWUT and IEEE TASE. If your work is more domain oriented and you therefore publish in leading venues within a specific domain, you are also very welcome to apply.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship.

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

Hear about the vision behind SDU Vejle - and why you as a researcher should consider joining the journey.

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Noura Lena Howell: nouh@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Aparna Varde: apva@mmmi.sdu.dk

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDUThe Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: Dansk job i Valencia - Business Development Representative til dansk handelsvirksomhed.
jobs.description:
Forretningsudvikler til dansk handelsvirksomhed i Valencia.

Vil du være den kommercielle motor i en dansk distributionsvirksomhed? Vi søger en ny kollega, der vil vinde nye kunder, udvide eksisterende kundeforhold og bygge de partnerskaber, der får forretningen til at vokse.

Du bliver en del af gruppens kontor i Valencia centrum og arbejder tæt sammen med lageret i Danmark. Du rapporterer direkte til direktøren og har et fast ugentligt møde med CFO'en i Danmark. Det giver korte beslutningsveje og reel indflydelse på strategien.

Det her er ikke et callcenterjob med manuskript. Du er specialist i et professionelt corporate miljø og har ansvar for hele kundeforløbet, fra det første kolde opkald til tilbud, ordre og opfølgning. Samtidig har du direkte kontakt med internationale leverandører. Du får frihed til at drive tingene fremad, men også forventninger om resultater, du kan måles på.

Dine ansvarsområder:

Nysalg

  • Opsøgende salg og cold calling til danske entreprenører, udlejningsvirksomheder og offentlige indkøbere

  • Booking og afholdelse af egne Teams-møder med potentielle kunder

  • Håndtering af indgående henvendelser, som du omsætter til tilbud og ordrer

  • Lead generering og markedsopsøgning

Key Account-håndtering

  • Faste opkald til eksisterende kunder for at skabe gentagne ordrer og øge din andel af deres indkøb

  • Besøg hos nøglekunder i Danmark og repræsentation på messer

  • Ordrebekræftelser og opfølgning

Forretningsudvikling

  • Opbygning af partnerskaber med leverandører og virksomheder, herunder workshops og fælles aktiviteter

  • Rekruttering og understøttelse af forhandlere

  • Deltagelse i strategiplanlægning og koordinering mellem stakeholders på alle niveauer

Indkøb og forsyning

  • Daglig kontakt med internationale leverandører og producenter

  • Forhandling af priser, vilkår og leveringstider

  • Planlægning af transport til Danmark (fragt, Incoterms) og opfølgning, til varerne er på lageret

Marketing og drift

  • Drift af sociale medier (primært LinkedIn) og opdatering af hjemmesiden

  • Understøttelse af SEO gennem linkbuilding

  • Lagerstyring sammen med lageret i Danmark

Din hverdag:Rollen har høj og målbar aktivitet. Vejledende er målet cirka 40 kundedialoger om dagen: ca. 10 indgående opkald, 20 samtaler med nye kunder og 10 opkald til eksisterende kunder. Resten af dagen bruges på Teams-møder, opfølgning, leverandører, forsendelser og sociale medier.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk i tale og skrift (alle kundesamtaler foregår på dansk)

  • Engelsk på business level, som du bruger dagligt med internationale leverandører

  • Dokumenteret B2B-salgserfaring med cold calling og resultater i at vinde nye kunder. Erfaring fra salgsbureau eller telemarketing er et stort plus

  • Styrke som forhandler over for både kunder og leverandører

  • Komfort med højt opkaldsvolumen og målbare mål

  • Hurtig på mail, struktureret og god til at multitaske

  • Evne til at håndtere stakeholders på alle niveauer

  • Godt kendskab til MS 365

  • Professionel og velpræsenteret fremtoning, der passer ind i et corporate miljø (skjorte og pæne bukser eller tilsvarende)

  • Dynamisk, proaktiv og selvkørende

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fast fra kontoret i Valencia og rejse til Danmark

  • Ønske om at blive i rollen i 2-3 år eller mere

  • Lyst til at lære, eller viden om, hvordan man køber ind internationalt og sender varer til Danmark (fragt, Incoterms og import)

Det er et plus, hvis du har

  • Erfaring fra byggebranchen, udstyrsudlejning, generatorer, pumper eller værktøj

  • Erfaring med at opbygge forhandler- eller partnerkanaler

  • Erfaring med indkøb eller import/logistik

  • CRM-disciplin, erfaring med LinkedIn-indhold og grundlæggende kendskab til SEO/linkbuilding

  • Kørekort, da der er kundebesøg i Danmark

Måske kommer du fra et salgsbureau, telemarketing eller et BPO-miljø og er klar til næste skridt: en specialistrolle, hvor du ejer relationerne og får indflydelse på resultaterne.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast grundløn på 2.000-2.600 EUR/md brutto, afhængigt af erfaring

  • Provision på dækningsbidrag: bonuspotentiale på 500-1.500 EUR/md uden loft

  • Targetløn op til 4.000 EUR/md brutto inkl. bonus

  • Fastansættelse på Contrato Indefinido

  • Direkte adgang til direktøren og indflydelse på strategien

  • Kontorliv i Valencia kombineret med jævnlige rejser til Danmark

Om virksomhedenVi er en dansk distributionsvirksomhed, der leverer udstyr og materialer til bygge- og anlægsbranchen. Vi har specialiseret os i generatorer siden 2013 og samarbejder med førende europæiske producenter. Vores kunder er entreprenører, kommuner samt offentlige og private virksomheder i Danmark og Grønland, og vi betjener dem fra eget lager i Danmark. Vi er en del af en større virksomhedsgruppe, som ledes fra Valencia.

Ansøgning.

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan også allerede nu booke en snak med os via dette link: Book et kald

With a workforce of nearly 17,000 professionals, the company delivers advanced solutions across communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum computing, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor sectors for clients in over 100 countries.Work tasksKey Responsibilities- Direct large-scale deployment initiatives, aligning efforts across internal and client engineering teams.- Take end-to-end ownership of intricate deployment defects—from initial triage to verified resolution—serving as the primary technical authority for the assigned program or account.- Collaborate closely (both remotely and onsite) with wireless client development teams during critical feature rollouts.- Examine signaling flows, system traces, timing metrics, and performance data to pinpoint root causes across internal and client-side implementations.- Author and update application-level and protocol-stack software, alongside necessary supporting software and firmware tailored to the client's infrastructure.- Build and expand Python APIs used for client-side system integration.- Design and implement automated workflows directly within the client's existing operational pipelines.- Engineer custom diagnostic instrumentation whenever standard tooling falls short.- Create, verify, and ship controlled patches, feature flags, and interim software releases in alignment with internal release governance.- Execute rapid prototyping cycles alongside clients to test and refine new capabilities using real-time feedback.- Bridge field operations and core R&amp;D by translating on-the-ground deployment challenges into actionable product requirements and defect reports.We are looking for- Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) paired with multiple years of relevant background in software or systems engineering.- Proven software engineering background spanning multiple software stacks.- Deep specialization in at least one protocol domain (PHY/L1, MAC/RLC/PDCP at L2, or RRC/NAS at L3), complemented by practical familiarity with neighboring layers and end-to-end 4G, 5G, and 5G-Advanced system operations.- Hands-on proficiency in C/C++, Python (including API diagnostics.- Working knowledge of 3GPP standards, including the practical distinctions between standard compliance, interoperability, and real-world implementation behavior.- Background working with design/test instrumentation and test emulation platforms.- Capability to write production-ready code suitable for direct inclusion in client builds.- High discretion and professional poise required to discussions and architectural reviews with clients.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is jobs.title: Floor Manager søges til Restaurant Sukaiba
jobs.description:
Har du en stærk faglighed inden for service og ledelse — og et ønske om at præge driften i et af Københavns mest spektakulære restauranter?

På toppen af Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en del af Norrlyst-koncernen og et hus, hvor gastronomi, udsigt og atmosfære bindes sammen i en helstøbt gæsteoplevelse. Her mødes asiatisk inspireret gastronomi, et ambitiøst drikkeprogram og et professionelt team, der hver dag arbejder for at løfte standarderne for moderne restaurantdrift.

Vi søger nu en dedikeret og erfaren Floor Manager, der med naturligt lederskab og skarpt overblik kan understøtte den daglige drift og sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen altid lever op til vores høje niveau.

Rollen

Som Floor Manager vil du være en central del af restaurantens ledelsesteam. Du vil samarbejde tæt med restaurantchefen og få ansvar for at:

  • Sikre en stabil og professionel drift på gulvet i alle serviceperioder

  • Lede og motivere personalet, så der skabes et trygt, disciplineret og engageret arbejdsmiljø

  • Være til stede i driften som rollemodel, sparringspartner og problemløser

  • Bidrage til oplæring, udvikling og kvalitetssikring af teamet

  • Understøtte planlægning af vagter, struktur og arbejdsrutiner

  • Gå forrest i at opretholde den høje standard, vores gæster forventer af Sukaiba

Dette er en hands-on stilling, hvor både servicefaglighed, nærvær og ledelseskompetence er afgørende.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har minumum 2 års erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen og mindst et år i en ledende eller superviserende rolle

  • Trives i et miljø, hvor tempoet er højt, og hvor kvalitet aldrig kompromitteres

  • Har en naturlig autoritet og formår at skabe ro, retning og motivation omkring dig

  • Kommunikerer klart, professionelt og nærværende

  • Har øje for detaljer og en stærk forståelse for, hvad førsteklasses service kræver

  • Er ambitiøs, driftssikker og klar til at tage ansvar for både mennesker og processer

Vi tilbyder

  • En nøgleposition i en af Københavns mest spektakulære restauranter

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med høje standarder og stærke værdier

  • Et professionelt team med stor faglighed og ambition

  • En kultur, hvor medarbejdertrivsel, kvalitet og udvikling vægtes højt

  • Karriere- og udviklingsmuligheder i en organisation i vækst

  • En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og ordentlige arbejdsvilkår

Om dig

Du bevæger dig med både overblik og beslutsomhed.Du er løsningsorienteret, struktureret og stærk i din kommunikation.Du trives i rollen som leder og er motiveret af at udvikle både mennesker og drift.Du bringer professionalisme, ansvarlighed og en passion for service ind i alt, hvad du gør.

Praktisk

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Associate professor in Artificial Intelligence for Medical Applications at SDU Robotics
jobs.description:
To support our advancements in deep learning and AI methods for medical image and clinical data analysis SDU Robotics invites applications for one or more associate professor position(s). The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

 

Job descriptionThe successful candidates will contribute to the unit’s current and future research projects and teaching activities. Key responsibilities include, for example to:

  • Be able to collaborate with our experts and colleagues from SDU Robotics in the further development of our core technologies. 

  • Be deeply involved in our regular coordination and joint evolvement of research and project activities. 

  • Raise funding and manage research projects. 

  • Design and conduct lab experiments. 

  • Participate in the practicalities of actual industrial applications. 

  • Organize, plan and conduct excellent teaching for undergraduate and graduate courses. 

  • Independently supervise project courses, and BSc, MSc and PhD thesis projects. 

The position as an associate professor involves primary responsibilities related to research (including the obligation to publish and disseminate scientific knowledge) and research-based teaching (including examination duties) – research and teaching obligations equally. Additionally, the role may encompass knowledge exchange with society, including participation in public debates. Furthermore, it may entail responsibilities such as research management, curriculum development, guidance, supervision, and scholarly assessment. The university determines the specific allocation of tasks, and the emphasis on these tasks may vary over time.

 

Profile and requirementsThe candidates will participate in SDU Robotics' comprehensive research, and the position requires research experience within artificial intelligence and deep learning for medical applications. This includes documented knowledge within some of the following technologies/areas:

  • Deep learning-based classification, segmentation and detection in 2D and 3D medical images.

  • Machine learning methods for analysis of clinical data.

  • Explainable and interpretable AI methods for medical decision support.

The candidates must have a relevant PhD degree (e.g. in computer science, engineering or a related field) and are expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

  • Experience in acquiring and coordinating publicly and/or privately funded projects.

  • Strong track record of directly engaging with clinical or industrial partners in application-oriented projects and/or a relevant international network for research and collaboration activities.

  • Experience with teaching and independently supervising project courses, and BSc and MSc thesis projects.

  • Experience in teaching AI courses for medical image analysis.

Preferably, the candidates have experience with:

  • Medical image analysis

  • Analysis of clinical and healthcare data

  • Explainable AI

  • Experimental design and validation of AI-based systems

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team. 

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have high self-motivation to learn. 

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Have excellent communication skills in English speaking and writing. 

In the assessment of candidates, consideration will be given to: 

  • Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

  • Experience in interdisciplinary research collaboration.

  • Teaching experience.

  • A relevant international network for research and collaboration activities, research experience abroad.

  • Experience in attracting funding for research projects and demonstrated experience in research leadership.

 

Research environment The candidate will be integrated into the unit SDU Robotics, which is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We are a team of currently appr. 60 researchers and engineers specialized in research and development of robot solutions and advanced robot systems within the medical, welfare and industrial domain. 

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. 

The aim of the group is to solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We participate in implementing the results achieved in real solutions with end users like national hospitals, LEGO, Novo Nordisk and Universal Robots.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

Further informationFurther information about this position is available via email from professor Thiusius R. Savarimuthu trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. 

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is January 11, 2027, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae including personal contact information.

  • Research statement with ideas for research and development activities (max. 4 pages).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates/diplomas (copy of original and in official English translation).

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant for the position. 

  • Reference and a statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process 

Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Employment as an associate professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor. Employment as associate professor is a permanent position. 

The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

jobs.title: Vedligeholdsteknikere til mekanisk vedligehold – dag- eller aftenhold
jobs.description:
Er du skarp til mekanik, fejlfinding og reparationer? Og trives du med at holde produktionsudstyr kørende? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Thorn Vikar & Rekruttering søger 4 dygtige vedligeholdsteknikere til en større produktionsvirksomhed i området omkring Brørup. Der er tale om 2 stillinger på daghold og 2 på aftenhold med opstart hurtigst muligt og mulighed for fastansættelse.Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af vedligeholdelsesteamet, hvor du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre stabil drift af virksomhedens produktionsudstyr. Du kommer til at arbejde med både forebyggende vedligehold, fejlfinding og reparationer på mekaniske og hydrauliske anlæg.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Mekanisk vedligehold af produktionsudstyr og maskinanlæg

  • Fejlfinding og reparationer på mekaniske og hydrauliske systemer

  • Forebyggende vedligehold med fokus på at minimere driftsstop

  • Dokumentation af udført vedligeholdelsesarbejde

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at sikre en stabil og effektiv produktion

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en håndværksmæssig eller teknisk baggrund som eksempelvis landbrugsmaskinmekaniker, landbrugssmed, klejnsmed, mekaniker, entreprenørmaskinmekaniker eller lignende.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med mekanisk vedligehold af produktions- og maskinanlæg

  • Har god teknisk forståelse og er stærk inden for fejlfinding

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og løsningsorienteret

  • Har et godt humør og trives med at samarbejde med andre

Vi tilbyder

  • Timeløn på 210–220 kr. afhængigt af kvalifikationer

  • Fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • Mulighed for enten daghold eller aftenhold

  • En alsidig hverdag med spændende tekniske udfordringer

  • Gode muligheder for fastansættelse hos virksomheden

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
