jobs.title: Regional Marketing Manager, Finland
jobs.description: We are seeking a **Regional Marketing Manager**!**Your role**As the **Regional Marketing Manager** in Finland, you are responsible for creating, leading, overseeing and executing all local marketing activities in Finland by ensuring consistent and well-coordinated communication, aligned with global strategy and broader regional business objectives. In this role, you also play a key part in ensuring the flow of internal information and the implementation of our strategy through active internal communication.Based on your experience, you have a comprehensive and holistic understanding of marketing, communication and branding. This role operates at both strategic and operational levels and supports Saabs positioning and business growth in Finland and other European markets by communicating our purpose, values, and offerings in a clear, credible, and distinctive way to all relevant key stakeholders.You are based in Finland (Tampere or Helsinki) and will work closely with the Finnish team and various European market teams, Business Areas and Group Communication functions, to ensure cohesive and impactful marketing initiatives. This role will require occasional travel within Europe to engage with local teams and markets.**Key Responsibilities**- Develop, implement and execute marketing strategies aligned with the needs and priorities of the Finnish market and other European markets, and with Group Communication objectives and guidelines. - Ensure relevant communication with customer value and credibility, while contributing to consistent brand appeal across all channels. - Design, support and execute sales and brand awareness campaigns covering earned, owned and paid media platforms, including performance reporting and media monitoring. - Produce business- and market-relevant content, including landing pages, articles, press releases, social media, intranet and event materials. - Manage content production for local events in coordination with all relevant stakeholders and partners, including invitations, event announcements, listings, and other communication materials as required - Plan and coordinate internal communications, and maintain and develop internal communications channels - Accountable for monitoring marketing budget allocations, to ensure spending aligns with approved plans and organizational priorities. Please note that some of the tasks in this position are connected to defence secrecy. A drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act (726/2014) are required for the selected applicant.**Your profile**To thrive in this role, you are purpose-driven, well-structured and proactive, and can identify and address key drivers of business success. You have an analytical approach and the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-paced and technically demanding environment. You are interested in social and political developments in Europe with focus on Finland, with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences while considering political, geopolitical, cultural, project, and product-specific aspects.**Required skills**- You hold a relevant University degree or equivalent qualifications. - You bring experience from similar role(s), ideally within an international B2B or B2G company. - You have a strong track record in external and internal communication at both strategic and operational levels. - You demonstrate a strong decision-making ability and effective self-management within the assigned mandate. - You are service-minded and a good team player, and you excel at building and maintaining strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. - You are fluent in Finnish, and you have excellent communication skills in English, both orally and writing. Proficiency in Swedish is also seen as an asset in this role. If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply!**What you will be part of**Saab is one of the world's leading defence and security companies, specializing in air, land, and naval defence, civil security, and commercial aerospace. Our everyday work is motivated by a clear target: **to keep people and society safe.**Teamwork is our strength. In fact, without it, we wouldn't have come this far. Join us and be part of a friendly, sharp and supportive workforce guided by common goals. But for us, it's more than just reaching our destination. It's about how we navigate the path together; with respect, thoughtfulness and always a bit of fun. Welcome to a workplace where your voice will be heard and where you feel safe to be your true self.On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options.We value work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely 1-2 days per week when business needs allow.We hope to welcome you to the team in January 2027 or as soon as possible. We understand that candidates have different notice periods and circumstances, so we are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.**Interested?**Take your chance to build your future career at Saab by submitting your CV and application via Saab Careers already now! Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that we might start interviews before the closing date of the advertisement.For further information regarding the position, please contact **Emma Paavonen, Chief of Staff, +358 44 590 0232**, available at the following times:\- Mon 16 Nov, 13:00-16:00\- Fri 20 Nov, 14:00-16:00\- Mon 23 Nov, 9:00-11:00_One of the greatest aspects of working with us is the diverse range of career paths we offer, along with varied and challenging job tasks. The world is constantly evolving, and so is Saab. To stay ahead and meet the needs of our customers, we need enthusiastic employees who are eager to grow and evolve with us._

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager – Industrial Digitalization Solutions
jobs.description: Are you passionate about industrial digitalization sales and a persistent customer value builder – do you have an innovative and proactive approach in driving business growth, bringing new perspectives and finding new solutions for industrial companies?Etteplan is growing and we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join us. The purpose is to drive growth within selected strategic industrial manufacturing and production customers globally, including defense, energy, mining and autonomous vehicles as particular focus sectors. We place great emphasis on personal qualities and will be happy to hear from you – a curious person with a positive attitude and a passion for industrial digitalization, willing to take the next step in your career. We at Etteplan love to hire innovative and skilled people with a passion for creating smart solutions to tough challenges. We are a growing international technology service company with decades of experience partnering with companies in a wide range of industries.Your Role As a Senior Sales Manager, you will drive sales by discovering relevant customer needs, leading and developing opportunities, and building offers for existing and new accounts. You will focus on Finnish and international industrial manufacturing companies, helping them to advance their R&amp;D, production and aftersales processes through industrial digitalization solutions ranging from consulting to turn-key projects and continuous services. You will work together with our other sales managers, delivery teams and global organization consisting of service-minded professionals. - Drive sales growth through value and solution-based sales approach, rooted on strong understanding of customers business needs and objectives - Develop and execute customer sales plans to penetrate strategic accounts, engage multiple stakeholders, and leverage internal resources to drive sales - Participate in sales campaigns at both regional and global levels - Accountability of your sales targets.The preferred location is Helsinki area, Finland – you will be part of our Espoo office. Up to 20% of travelling will be needed in this role, mainly in Finland and Central Europe.Your profile and way of working We expect you to be passionate about building customer value centric growth and business solutions in teamwork with talented experts. You get energy from working with customers, and act as an example to inspire your colleagues to meet customer expectations. - A minimum of five years of proven success in international business solution sales within the engineering or technology services industry, specifically in selling to industrial customers in manufacturing, production, and R&amp;D environments. - Proven B2B sales track record in industrial platform and software solutions. Demonstrated success in selling industrial digitalization, data&amp;AI solutions and tailored SW solutions to industrial customers, particularly in manufacturing, production, R&amp;D and aftersales process environments is a must-have. Scope includes ERP, MES, MOM, PLM, and SCADA systems, industrial data platforms, IIoT solutions, smart factory and production system integrations, as well as industrial AI and analytics solutions. Scope of platform and SW offering ranges from initial concept and roadmap development to full deployment, integration, and lifecycle management. - Wide network of contacts among industrial manufacturing companies. We value particularly your professional network among manufacturing companies operating in defense, energy, mining, heavy machinery and autonomous vehicles sectors. - Strong end-to-end sales capability covering the full sales lifecycle; Building and actively managing a healthy sales pipeline, driving proactive customer engagement and consultative dialogue, leading and coordinating bid teams across disciplines, shaping competitive, value-based commercial and technical offers, delivering compelling executive- and technical-level presentations, and leading contract negotiations and closing agreements. - Strong domain expertise in industrial software and platform technologies as foundation for industrial digitalization. Solid understanding of industrial IT/OT environments and platform solution domains, enabling credible, value-driven engagement with customers. Ability to translate technical capabilities into business value, positioning solutions in the context of customers production strategies, aftersales processes, digitalization roadmaps, and competitiveness goals. - A natural relationship builder with a proactive, hands-on, analytical, and customer-centric approach to work - Masters degree in technology or economics or other relevant academic degree - Fluency in both Finnish and English is a must-have, proficiency in German or Swedish appreciated.Your way of working is best described as proactive, working well under pressure and being eager to achieve successful sales results – you work with integrity, transparency and trust. - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for new solutions - A motivated person able to energize others in a positive manner and create solutions - Creative and open-minded with skills to work across boundaries with the sales team and the operative organization - A self-starter with the initiative to make things happen.What to expect This is a great opportunity to work in an exciting, international growth company with nice colleagues. You will have the opportunity to work at a company with an inspiring and coaching way of leading that challenges traditional ways of working in the consulting service business. A strong network of contacts as well as extensive experience from various industries await you, giving you a unique opportunity to develop yourself further. You will gain rapid personal development in value-adding sales through coaching, training and exchange of experience.We are an open organization with a flat hierarchy. Whats more, we are an organization in transition to find new ways to do things better, bringing value and efficiency to our customers.You will report to the Software and Embedded Solutions Finland Sales Director and be a part of the global sales team.At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of worki

jobs.title: Customer Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As s Customer Quality Specialist you will own and drive the end-to-end customer claims process across our business unit. This means ensuring timely resolution of customer quality issues, reduction of claim costs, prevention of recurrence, and continuous improvement of customer satisfaction. You will lead the end-to-end customer claims process and work cross-functionally to improve customer experience, strengthen quality performance, and drive sustainable business improvements.  The role has cross-functional exposure and you will work closely with Operations, Product & Portfolio Management, R&D / Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, Service, and Quality.  Key responsibilities:     Ownership of the end-to-end customer claims process towards full portfolio.     Standardize claim management practices across the BU.     Strengthen cross-functional accountability for corrective actions.     Increase customer confidence through proactive claim and escalation management     Follow up on claims and quality situations by making statistics, analysis and creating claims and quality reports.     Drive and manage quality improvement projects/activities.  Long term goals will be:     Reduce customer claim costs and quality-related business risks and enable leadership to focus on strategic priorities rather than operational intervention.     Drive systemic quality improvements through trend analysis and prevention.     Establish a scalable and sustainable claims management framework.  Networking and stakeholder engagement are important aspects of this role, which includes occasional domestic and international travel. You will be part of a team of three and report to Kubra Kucuk, who leads with trust, welcome creativity and are open to ideas to continuously develop our ways of working.  Who are you We are looking for you with a commercial mindset who is proactive, structured and have a curious mind to constantly find ways forward, driving for solutions and gaining results. This is not only an administrative role - but you will also have a big impact on business and customer satisfaction. The scope of this role is broad and diverse, requiring the ability to effectively prioritize competing demands while remaining resilient in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. If you enjoy engaging with people, building strong stakeholder relationships, and working in a global environment, you will thrive in this role.   What you know This is a role for you with some experience of process ownership in a similar role and who are used to stakeholder management in a larger, preferably international cross-functional environment. Requirements:     Work experience in Quality, Customer Quality, Customer Claims, Manufacturing Quality, or a similar role.     Root cause analysis and problem solving (8D, 5 Why, CAPA).     Experience in data analysis and KPI reporting.     Quality management systems (QMS) understanding.     Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technical Education - mechanical/chemical/production, or a related field and/or many years of working with customer claims in for the role related field.     Excellent communication and presentation skills in English Merit:    Power BI and digitalization skills     Experience in engineered products, manufacturing, or industrial equipment.  For more information, please contact Kubra Kucuk Aydemir, Head of Governance & QHSE, PPMI  or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner  We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than December 2, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area. Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games. #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Cultural Consultant
jobs.description:
Danish Relief and Development seeks a Cultural Consultant to advise on our upcoming citizenship initiatives in the MENA region. This position is ideal for an professional with deep insight into Arabic culture who wishes to apply their expertise to create tangible social impact within an international NGO framework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver comprehensive cultural insights and guidance on Arabic social norms, communication practices, and community values to ensure effective project design.

  • Contribute to the planning, implementation, and evaluation of citizenship programs tailored to minorities and to advance social cohesion in the MENA region.

  • Design and conduct structured workshops to strengthen cross-cultural competency and organizational awareness.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • A completed Master’s degree.

  • Native or full professional fluency in Arabic, combined with an advanced command of English.

  • A thorough, nuanced understanding of local traditions, social dynamics, and the structural challenges faced by minorities in the MENA region.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex cultural contexts into structured, actionable project strategies.

What We Offer

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description: **About the Role**We are looking for a **Financial Controller** to join our finance team in Tampere. This is a full-time, permanent position.In this role, you will be at the center of our revenue, fixed asset and working capital processes, working closely with our local Financial Manager, our global accounting team and both local and global colleagues across Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement.With us you will learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company working in an interesting field.**Location:** Tampere, onsite**Key responsibilities**- Coordinate sales invoicing and accounts receivable. Making sure invoices are accurate, follow up on payment terms and advance payments, and support collections. - Ensure correct revenue recognition and cut-off, reconcile sales revenue, and prepare sales-related accruals and provisions. - Maintain the fixed asset register for tangible and intangible assets, including additions, disposals, write-offs, transfers and depreciation plans. - Work with the Financial Manager on capitalization decisions, assets under construction, capitalized development costs and impairment testing. - Monitor capital expenditure against budget and run physical fixed asset counts and controls. - Prepare financial reporting, payment claims and audit documentation for publicly funded projects, including cost eligibility checks and personnel cost calculations, together with project managers and auditors. - Monitor and report on net working capital, especially inventory, together with Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement. Spot improvement opportunities and escalate them where needed. - Support the purchase process by developing the process flow, monitoring payments and maintaining the purchase approval tool. - Contribute to month-end and year-end closing, including reconciliations, and support our global accounting team. **What we require**To succeed in this role, you should have:- A degree in accounting, finance or business administration. - Around 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience, including month-end and year-end closing. - Solid knowledge of Finnish accounting standards (FAS). Familiarity with IFRS, especially revenue recognition, fixed assets and impairment. - Experience with accounts receivable, revenue cut-off, accruals and reconciliations. - Understanding of fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation and assets under construction. - Experience with ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is an advantage). - An analytical, accurate and well-organized approach, with the ability to handle several deadlines at once. - Good communication and cooperation skills for working with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, managers and auditors. - Fluent English and Finnish language skills. **What we see as a plus**- Experience in international / multi-entity structures **What We Offer****Paid Time Off**You are entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the tax-free limit as a fringe benefit. - Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies. - Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support. - Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care. - Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time. - Business Travel Insurance: coverage for work-related travel. - Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks. **Work Model**- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00. - No-Crunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed. - Meeting-Light Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings. **Growth & Innovation**- High-End Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals. **Travel & Mobility**- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation. - Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum tax-free Vero rates. **Impact & Culture**- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement. **Culture Statement**Don't meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.**Some questions?**If there is something in your mind, you can send your question to careers\_finland@sineeng.com. Please note that we don't accept applications via email.

jobs.title: Junior Key Account Manager – Renewable Energy Solutions
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technical sales, building customer relationships and the future of renewable energy?

At Photomate, we are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior Key Account Manager to join our team in Denmark.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset and commercial drive who wants to develop their sales career in the fast-growing renewable energy sector.

About Photomate

Photomate is an international renewable energy company specializing in solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging and smart energy solutions.

We support our business partners with innovative technologies, technical expertise and reliable service. As our business in Denmark continues to grow, we are looking for a new colleague to strengthen our commercial team.

Your Responsibilities

As a Junior Key Account Manager, you will work with both existing customers and new business opportunities in the Danish market.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Building and developing relationships with customers and business partners.

  • Identifying and approaching potential new B2B customers.

  • Participating in customer meetings and presenting our technical products and solutions.

  • Following up on quotations, sales opportunities and customer inquiries.

  • Working closely with our technical team to understand customer needs and identify suitable solutions.

  • Maintaining customer information and sales activities in our CRM system.

  • Supporting Photomate's business growth in Denmark.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a commercially minded person who is genuinely interested in technology, enjoys understanding how technical solutions work and is motivated by developing customer relationships.

Ideally, you:

  • Have initial experience in technical B2B sales, account management or a customer-facing role within a technical industry, or have a relevant technical education combined with strong commercial motivation.

  • Have a genuine interest in technical products and enjoy learning how different solutions work.

  • Enjoy building relationships and actively approaching new customers.

  • Are structured, proactive and results-oriented.

  • Are curious, eager to learn and comfortable discussing technical topics with customers and colleagues.

  • Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken (mandatory).

  • Are willing to travel within Denmark for customer meetings.

Experience in solar energy, battery storage, electrical distribution, EV charging, HVAC, industrial equipment or other technically driven B2B sectors is highly valued.

Direct experience in renewable energy is not essential, but a technical mindset and genuine enthusiasm for technology are key requirements. We are looking for someone who wants to understand the products they sell, not just sell them.

What We Offer

  • An exciting opportunity in a growing international renewable energy company.

  • Product training and support from experienced sales and technical colleagues.

  • The opportunity to develop your own customer portfolio and grow into a Key Account Management role.

  • Professional development and increasing responsibility.

  • An international and collaborative working environment.

  • The chance to contribute to the green energy transition.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you are commercially driven, technically curious and want to build your career in renewable energy sales, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Denmark – Copenhagen

Start date: By agreement

Apply: career@photomate.eu

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: We need 2 rescue zookeeper in rescue zoo
jobs.description:
Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

  • One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

  • One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

  • A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

  • Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

  • Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

  • A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

  • Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

  • Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

  • Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

jobs.title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
jobs.description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

  • Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
  • Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
  • Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Treasury Analyst, Markets & Analytics
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in an international investment fund promoting economic and social progress through commercial investments?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor. We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

 

About the role

We are looking for a Treasury Analyst to join our Treasury team. The role sits at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analysis, trading and technology. You will support treasury decision-making, execute and analyse financial transactions, develop and use the tools and data infrastructure used by the Treasury function.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Negotiate, execute and support FX, money-market, interest-rate and derivative transactions, including swaps and hedging activities.

  • Perform quantitative analysis of FX, interest-rate and liquidity risk via statistics and scenario analyses.

  • Develop models for cash-flow forecasting, liquidity management, pricing and risk/position management.

  • Develop and maintain Treasury analytics and reporting using SQL, Python, Power BI and/or Excel/VBA.

  • Extract, structure and analyse data from Treasury Risk/Position Systems, Investment Management Systems, ERP systems and market-data platforms.

  • Automate Treasury processes and controls and contribute to improvements in the Treasury IT architecture.

  • Support and pursue implementation and valuation of new financial products.

jobs.title: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
jobs.description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

  • Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

  • Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

  • Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

  • Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

  • Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

  • An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

  • Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

  • Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

  • The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

  • An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

  • An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

  • A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

  • Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

  • The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

  • Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

Please use the reference “Engineer or Aircraft Technician – 2026” when submitting your application.

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Interviews will take place at our offices in Sønderborg, Denmark.

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you to the AIR ALSIE team!

jobs.title: Digital marketing professional – ready to build a brand of your own?
jobs.description: **I'm looking for a new entrepreneur and owner for Anna aikaa.**What if, instead of giving more things, we gave more time, well-being and meaningful experiences?This is the idea behind Anna aikaa (Finnish for "Give Time") – a digital gift card marketplace whose first service category is modern, dry-steam home cleaning.Through the platform, customers can give their loved ones the gift of an easier everyday life, while local cleaning entrepreneurs deliver the services.But why stop at cleaning?Anna aikaa has the potential to become a nationwide marketplace for experience and service-based gifts. Beauty treatments, wellness services, experiences, everyday assistance and unforgettable moments. The possibilities are endless.**The foundation is built. Now it needs someone who sees its potential.**What will you acquire?- An established brand and visual identity. - A digital gift card marketplace and its underlying technology. - An integrated payment and automated gift card system. - First cleaning service providers in existing network - A scalable, commission-based business model. - Full onboarding and ongoing collaboration with a cleaning industry specialist. The business does not require physical premises, inventory or its own service delivery staff. It can be operated remotely from anywhere.Who is this opportunity for?Someone who understands digital marketing, social media and consumer behaviour. Someone who knows how to create engaging content, connect with people emotionally and turn visibility into sales.Perhaps you have spent your career growing other people's brands and are now ready to build your own.You do not need any professional experience in the cleaning industry. You can focus on growing the business and developing new service categories.Why am I looking for a new owner?My professional focus is shifting towards cleaning industry expertise, training and equipment sales. jobs.description: Meillä Varhalla pääset osaksi mukavaa ja kehittymismyönteistä työyhteisöä, jossa arvostamme osaamistasi ja tuemme ammatillista kasvuasi. Tule mukaan!TehtäväsiSuuhygienistinä työskentelet itsenäisesti suun terveyden edistämisen ja hoidon parissa. Toimit oman alasi asiantuntijana ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä suun terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämistä ja opiskelijoiden käytännön harjoittelun ohjaamista.Pääasiallinen työpisteesi sijaitsee Kaarinan suun terveydenhuollossa, mutta työskentelet tarvittaessa myös Varhan muilla vastaanotoilla. Halutessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään myös liikkuvissa palveluissamme, mikä tuo mukavaa vaihtelua ja monipuolisuutta työhösi.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Meillä pääset osaksi energistä ja toimintaansa aktiivisesti kehittävää moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Varhan suun terveydenhuollossa työskentelee yli 700 alan ammattilaista, joten ympärilläsi on laaja joukko osaavia kollegoita, joiden kanssa voit jakaa kokemuksia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden jatkuvan tuen. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja osallistumaan myös toimintamme kehittämiseen. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi, voit hyvin ja saat mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokenut suuhygienisti. Tärkeintä meille on, että suhtaudut työhösi innostuneesti ja haluat olla mukana tarjoamassa potilaillemme mahdollisimman hyvää hoitoa.Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joustavaa työskentelyotetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Monipuolinen kokemus suuhygienistin työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta sitoutumista työhösi, oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista yhteiseen tekemiseen.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus (suuhygienisti AMK tai aikaisempi vastaava tutkinto).Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa.Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kehittyvään työyhteisöömme! Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
jobs.description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

ACCESS AND QUEUE CONTROL: VERIFY THAT GUESTS ACCESS LIFTS WITH A VALID SKI PASS AND MANAGE WAITING AREAS IN AN ORDERLY, SMOOTH, AND FRIENDLY MANNER. SITE MAINTENANCE: CLEAR SNOW AND ICE FROM LOADING AND UNLOADING RAMPS, ENSURING THAT PLATFORMS REMAIN LEVEL, SAFE, AND OBSTACLE-FREE THROUGHOUT THE OPERATING DAY. INTERNAL COORDINATION: PROMPTLY REPORT ANY DETECTED MECHANICAL ANOMALIES TO THE TECHNICAL TEAM OR CENTRAL DISPATCH, AND COLLABORATE WITH THE SKI PATROL TEAM DURING WEATHER OR SAFETY INCIDENTS. CANDIDATE PROFILE: EDUCATION: HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA OR EQUIVALENT QUALIFICATION, BASIC KNOWLEDGE OF OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND SAFETY IS A PLUS. EXPERIENCE: PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE IN CUSTOMER SERVICE, TOURISM, OR OUTDOOR PHYSICAL WORK IS APPRECIATED (PRIOR SKI LIFT EXPERIENCE IS NOT REQUIRED, AS ROLE-SPECIFIC TRAINING WILL BE PROVIDED). KEY STRENGTHS: STRONG FOCUS AND SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY, A FRIENDLY AND EMPATHETIC ATTITUDE, EASE IN OPERATING BASIC CONTROL PANELS AND MANUAL TOOLS, GOOD PHYSICAL FITNESS, AND A WILLINGNESS TO WORK OUTDOORS UNDER CHANGING HIGH-MOUNTAIN WEATHER CONDITIONS. jobs.title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
jobs.description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer. 

  • Drift: Drift og pleje af arealer med træer. Renholdelse af beplantninger, beskæring, gødskning. Vi driver alle vores arealer økologisk. 

  • Høst: Høst af nødder, bær, frugt, gavntræ, biomasse. 

  • Planteskole: Bistå i driften af vores planteskole – fra indkøb af frømateriale og stiklinger til podning og klargøring af salgsklare træer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter. 

  • Rundvisninger: Faciliteter rundvisninger og markvandringer for diverse grupper (landbrugsskoler, kommuner, virksomheder, ERFA, ). 

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

  • Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø hvor hoved og hænder skal arbejde sammen. Du kan planlægge en beplantning om morgenen og sidde på traktoren eller beskære træer om eftermiddagen. 

  • Du har maskinerfaring og er vant til at side bare rattet i større maskiner. 

  • Ideelt set bor du omkring Kolding, Vejle eller Skanderborg, da det er herfra vi har flest aktiviteter. 

Vi tilbyder

  • En absolut nøglerolle i en af Danmarks mest ambitiøse landbrugsvirksomheder. 

  • Muligheden for at bygge og forme morgendagens landbrugs-infrastruktur fra bunden.

  • Et dynamisk, uformelt miljø, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og stor mulighed for at vokse med virksomheden, når vi skalerer mod 500+ hektar skovlandbrug under drift. 

Ansøgning Send dit CV og en kort, mail om, hvorfor du er den rette til at drive vores marker. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: SANTEHNIĶIS
jobs.description:
Sertificēts būvniecības un remontdarbu uzņēmums 

SIA  3 baloži(reģ. Nr.: 42103093609), 

sakarā ar darbības paplašināšanos aicina darbā SANTEHNIĶUS. ​

Darbs Liepājā un rajonā.

Prasības:

  • Atbilstošas zināšanas 
  • Darba pieredze.  ​

Darba pienākumi: 

  • Veikt ūdensapgādes, kanalizācijas, apkures, ventilācijas un citu santehnikas sistēmu montāžu, apkopi un remontu.

  • Uzstādīt un pieslēgt santehnikas iekārtas – izlietnes, vannas, tualetes podus, dušas kabīnes, radiatorus, boilerus, sūkņus u.c.

  • Montēt cauruļvadus (metāla, plastmasas, vara u.c. materiālu), veicot nepieciešamos lodēšanas, līmēšanas vai metināšanas darbus.
  • Nodrošināt santehnikas sistēmu pārbaudi, regulēšanu un hermētiskuma testēšanu pēc uzstādīšanas vai remonta.
  • Veikt bojājumu diagnostiku un novēršanu esošajās santehnikas sistēmās.
  • Veikt profilaktiskos uzturēšanas darbus, lai novērstu noplūdes, aizsērējumus vai citas sistēmu darbības problēmas.
  • Nodrošināt darbu atbilstību būvprojekta prasībām, tehniskajām specifikācijām un normatīvajiem aktiem.
  • Strādāt droši, ievērojot darba aizsardzības, ugunsdrošības un vides aizsardzības noteikumus.
  •  Sadarboties ar citiem speciālistiem (elektriķiem, būvniekiem, apkures meistariem u.c.) kopīgu projektu īstenošanā.
  • Uzturēt kārtību un tīrību darba vietā, taupīgi izmantot materiālus un instrumentus.
  • Pildīt citus tiešā vadītāja norādījumus, kas saistīti ar santehnikas uzstādīšanu un uzturēšanu, atbilstoši darbinieka kvalifikācijai.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect - UAE
Content Creator - YouTube
jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.
